name: MulAction.isTopologicallyTransitive_iff
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem MulAction.isTopologicallyTransitive_iff :
    IsTopologicallyTransitive M α ↔ ∀ {U V : Set α}, IsOpen U → U.Nonempty → IsOpen V →
    V.Nonempty → ∃ m : M, ((m • U) ∩ V).Nonempty
proof: := ⟨fun h ↦ h.1, fun h ↦ ⟨h⟩⟩

name: MulAction.isTopologicallyTransitive_iff_dense_iUnion
statement:
@[to_additive /
if for any nonempty open subset `U` of `α` the union over the elements of `M` of images of `U` is
dense in `α`. -/]
theorem MulAction.isTopologicallyTransitive_iff_dense_iUnion :
    IsTopologicallyTransitive M α ↔
    ∀ {U : Set α}, IsOpen U → U.Nonempty → Dense (⋃ m : M, m • U)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [isTopologicallyTransitive_iff, inter_comm, dense_iff_inter_open, inter_iUnion,
    nonempty_iUnion]
  exact ⟨fun h _ h₁ h₂ _ h₃ h₄ ↦ h h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄, fun h _ _ h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄ ↦ h h₁ h₂ _ h₃ h₄⟩

name: MulAction.isTopologicallyTransitive_iff_dense_iUnion_preimage
statement:
@[to_additive /
if for any nonempty open subset `U` of `α` the union of the preimages of `U` over the elements of
`M` is dense in `α`. -/]
theorem MulAction.isTopologicallyTransitive_iff_dense_iUnion_preimage :
    IsTopologicallyTransitive M α ↔
    ∀ {U : Set α}, IsOpen U → U.Nonempty → Dense (⋃ m : M, (m • ·) ⁻¹' U)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dense_iff_inter_open, inter_iUnion, nonempty_iUnion, ← image_inter_nonempty_iff]
  exact ⟨fun h _ h₁ h₂ _ h₃ h₄ ↦ h.1 h₃ h₄ h₁ h₂, fun h ↦ ⟨fun h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄ ↦ h h₃ h₄ _ h₁ h₂⟩⟩

name: IsOpen.dense_iUnion_smul
proof:
:=
  (isTopologicallyTransitive_iff_dense_iUnion M).mp h hUo hUne

name: IsOpen.dense_iUnion_preimage_smul
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem IsOpen.dense_iUnion_preimage_smul [h : IsTopologicallyTransitive M α]
    {U : Set α} (hUo : IsOpen U) (hUne : U.Nonempty) : Dense (⋃ m : M, (m • ·) ⁻¹' U)
proof:
:=
  (isTopologicallyTransitive_iff_dense_iUnion_preimage M).mp h hUo hUne

name: IsOpen.dense_of_preimage_smul_invariant
statement:
@[to_additive /
`U` is a nonempty open subset of `α` and `(m +ᵥ ·) ⁻¹' U ⊆ U` for all `m : M` then `U` is dense in
`α`. -/]
theorem IsOpen.dense_of_preimage_smul_invariant [IsTopologicallyTransitive M α] {U : Set α}
    (hUo : IsOpen U) (hUne : U.Nonempty) (hUinv : ∀ m : M, (m • ·) ⁻¹' U ⊆ U) : Dense U
proof:
:=
  .mono (by simpa only [iUnion_subset_iff]) (hUo.dense_iUnion_preimage_smul M hUne)

name: MulAction.isTopologicallyTransitive_iff_dense_of_preimage_invariant
statement:
@[to_additive /
argument is topologically transitive if and only if any nonempty open subset `U` of `α` with
`(m +ᵥ ·) ⁻¹' U ⊆ U` for all `m : M` is dense in `α`. -/]
theorem MulAction.isTopologicallyTransitive_iff_dense_of_preimage_invariant
    [h : ContinuousConstSMul M α] : IsTopologicallyTransitive M α ↔
    ∀ {U : Set α}, IsOpen U → U.Nonempty → (∀ m : M, (m • ·) ⁻¹' U ⊆ U) → Dense U
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ _ h₀ h₁ h₂ ↦ h₀.dense_of_preimage_smul_invariant M h₁ h₂, fun h₄ ↦ ?_⟩
  refine (isTopologicallyTransitive_iff_dense_iUnion_preimage M).mpr ?_
  refine fun hU _ ↦ h₄ (isOpen_iUnion fun a ↦ hU.preimage (h.1 a)) ?_ fun b _ ↦ ?_
  · exact nonempty_iUnion.mpr ⟨1, by simpa only [one_smul]⟩
  · simp only [preimage_iUnion, mem_iUnion, mem_preimage, smul_smul, forall_exists_index]
    exact fun c hc ↦ ⟨c * b, hc⟩

name: omegaLimit_def
statement: theorem omegaLimit_def : ω f ϕ s = ⋂ u ∈ f, closure (image2 ϕ u s)
proof: := rfl

name: omegaLimit_subset_of_tendsto
statement:
theorem omegaLimit_subset_of_tendsto {m : τ → τ} {f₁ f₂ : Filter τ} (hf : Tendsto m f₁ f₂) :
    ω f₁ (fun t x ↦ ϕ (m t) x) s ⊆ ω f₂ ϕ s
proof:
:= by
  refine iInter₂_mono' fun u hu ↦ ⟨m ⁻¹' u, tendsto_def.mp hf _ hu, ?_⟩
  rw [← image2_image_left]
  exact closure_mono (image2_subset (image_preimage_subset _ _) Subset.rfl)

name: omegaLimit_mono_left
statement: theorem omegaLimit_mono_left {f₁ f₂ : Filter τ} (hf : f₁ ≤ f₂) : ω f₁ ϕ s ⊆ ω f₂ ϕ s
proof:
:=
  omegaLimit_subset_of_tendsto ϕ s (tendsto_id'.2 hf)

name: omegaLimit_mono_right
statement: theorem omegaLimit_mono_right {s₁ s₂ : Set α} (hs : s₁ ⊆ s₂) : ω f ϕ s₁ ⊆ ω f ϕ s₂
proof:
:=
  iInter₂_mono fun _u _hu ↦ closure_mono (image2_subset Subset.rfl hs)

name: isClosed_omegaLimit
statement: theorem isClosed_omegaLimit : IsClosed (ω f ϕ s)
proof:
:=
  isClosed_iInter fun _u ↦ isClosed_iInter fun _hu ↦ isClosed_closure

name: mapsTo_omegaLimit'
proof:
:= by
  simp only [omegaLimit_def, mem_iInter, MapsTo]
  intro y hy u hu
  refine map_mem_closure hgc (hy _ (inter_mem hu hg)) (forall_mem_image2.2 fun t ht x hx ↦ ?_)
  calc
    ϕ' t (ga x) ∈ image2 ϕ' u s' := mem_image2_of_mem ht.1 (hs hx)
    _ = gb (ϕ t x) := ht.2 hx |>.symm

name: mapsTo_omegaLimit
proof:
:=
  mapsTo_omegaLimit' _ hs (Eventually.of_forall fun t x _hx ↦ hg t x) hgc

name: omegaLimit_image_eq
statement:
theorem omegaLimit_image_eq {α' : Type*} (ϕ : τ → α' → β) (f : Filter τ) (g : α → α') :
    ω f ϕ (g '' s) = ω f (fun t x ↦ ϕ t (g x)) s
proof: := by simp only [omegaLimit, image2_image_right]

name: omegaLimit_preimage_subset
statement:
theorem omegaLimit_preimage_subset {α' : Type*} (ϕ : τ → α' → β) (s : Set α') (f : Filter τ)
    (g : α → α') : ω f (fun t x ↦ ϕ t (g x)) (g ⁻¹' s) ⊆ ω f ϕ s
proof:
:=
  mapsTo_omegaLimit _ (mapsTo_preimage _ _) (fun _t _x ↦ rfl) continuous_id

name: mem_omegaLimit_iff_frequently
statement:
theorem mem_omegaLimit_iff_frequently (y : β) :
    y ∈ ω f ϕ s ↔ ∀ n ∈ 𝓝 y, ∃ᶠ t in f, (s ∩ ϕ t ⁻¹' n).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [frequently_iff, omegaLimit_def, mem_iInter, mem_closure_iff_nhds]
  constructor
  · intro h _ hn _ hu
    rcases h _ hu _ hn with ⟨_, _, _, ht, _, hx, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, ht, _, hx, by rwa [mem_preimage]⟩
  · intro h _ hu _ hn
    rcases h _ hn hu with ⟨_, ht, _, hx, hϕtx⟩
    exact ⟨_, hϕtx, _, ht, _, hx, rfl⟩

name: mem_omegaLimit_iff_frequently
statement:
theorem mem_omegaLimit_iff_frequently₂ (y : β) :
    y ∈ ω f ϕ s ↔ ∀ n ∈ 𝓝 y, ∃ᶠ t in f, (ϕ t '' s ∩ n).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [mem_omegaLimit_iff_frequently, image_inter_nonempty_iff]

name: mem_omegaLimit_singleton_iff_mapClusterPt
statement:
theorem mem_omegaLimit_singleton_iff_mapClusterPt (x : α) (y : β) :
    y ∈ ω f ϕ {x} ↔ MapClusterPt y f fun t ↦ ϕ t x
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [mem_omegaLimit_iff_frequently, mapClusterPt_iff_frequently, singleton_inter_nonempty,
    mem_preimage]

name: omegaLimit_inter
statement: theorem omegaLimit_inter : ω f ϕ (s₁ ∩ s₂) ⊆ ω f ϕ s₁ ∩ ω f ϕ s₂
proof:
:=
  subset_inter (omegaLimit_mono_right _ _ inter_subset_left)
    (omegaLimit_mono_right _ _ inter_subset_right)

name: omegaLimit_iInter
statement: theorem omegaLimit_iInter (p : ι → Set α) : ω f ϕ (⋂ i, p i) ⊆ ⋂ i, ω f ϕ (p i)
proof:
:=
  subset_iInter fun _i ↦ omegaLimit_mono_right _ _ (iInter_subset _ _)

name: omegaLimit_union
statement: theorem omegaLimit_union : ω f ϕ (s₁ ∪ s₂) = ω f ϕ s₁ ∪ ω f ϕ s₂
proof:
:= by
  ext y; constructor
  · simp only [mem_union, mem_omegaLimit_iff_frequently, union_inter_distrib_right, union_nonempty,
      frequently_or_distrib]
    contrapose!
    simp only [← subset_empty_iff]
    rintro ⟨⟨n₁, hn₁, h₁⟩, ⟨n₂, hn₂, h₂⟩⟩
    refine ⟨n₁ ∩ n₂, inter_mem hn₁ hn₂, ?_, ?_⟩
    · gconvert h₁; exact inter_subset_left
    · gconvert h₂; exact inter_subset_right
  · rintro (hy | hy)
    exacts [omegaLimit_mono_right _ _ subset_union_left hy,
      omegaLimit_mono_right _ _ subset_union_right hy]

name: omegaLimit_iUnion
statement: theorem omegaLimit_iUnion (p : ι → Set α) : ⋃ i, ω f ϕ (p i) ⊆ ω f ϕ (⋃ i, p i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [iUnion_subset_iff]
  exact fun i ↦ omegaLimit_mono_right _ _ (subset_iUnion _ _)

name: omegaLimit_eq_iInter
statement: theorem omegaLimit_eq_iInter : ω f ϕ s = ⋂ u : ↥f.sets, closure (image2 ϕ u s)
proof:
:=
  biInter_eq_iInter _ _

name: omegaLimit_eq_biInter_inter
statement:
theorem omegaLimit_eq_biInter_inter {v : Set τ} (hv : v ∈ f) :
    ω f ϕ s = ⋂ u ∈ f, closure (image2 ϕ (u ∩ v) s)
proof:
:=
  Subset.antisymm (iInter₂_mono' fun u hu ↦ ⟨u ∩ v, inter_mem hu hv, Subset.rfl⟩)
    (iInter₂_mono fun _u _hu ↦ closure_mono <| image2_subset inter_subset_left Subset.rfl)

name: omegaLimit_eq_iInter_inter
statement:
theorem omegaLimit_eq_iInter_inter {v : Set τ} (hv : v ∈ f) :
    ω f ϕ s = ⋂ u : ↥f.sets, closure (image2 ϕ (u ∩ v) s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [omegaLimit_eq_biInter_inter _ _ _ hv]
  apply biInter_eq_iInter

name: omegaLimit_subset_closure_image2
statement:
theorem omegaLimit_subset_closure_image2 {u : Set τ} (hu : u ∈ f) :
    ω f ϕ s ⊆ closure (image2 ϕ u s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [omegaLimit_eq_iInter]
  intro _ hx
  rw [mem_iInter] at hx
  exact hx ⟨u, hu⟩

name: eventually_closure_subset_of_isCompact_absorbing_of_isOpen_of_omegaLimit_subset'
proof:
:= by
  rcases hc₂ with ⟨v, hv₁, hv₂⟩
  let k := closure (image2 ϕ v s)
  have hk : IsCompact (k \ n) :=
    (hc₁.of_isClosed_subset isClosed_closure hv₂).diff hn₁
  let j u := (closure (image2 ϕ (u ∩ v) s))ᶜ
  have hj₁ : ∀ u ∈ f, IsOpen (j u) := fun _ _ ↦ isOpen_compl_iff.mpr isClosed_closure
  have hj₂ : k \ n ⊆ ⋃ u ∈ f, j u := by
    have : ⋃ u ∈ f, j u = ⋃ u : (↥f.sets), j u := biUnion_eq_iUnion _ _
    rw [this, sdiff_subset_comm, sdiff_iUnion]
    rw [omegaLimit_eq_iInter_inter _ _ _ hv₁] at hn₂
    simp_rw [j, sdiff_compl]
    rw [← inter_iInter]
    exact Subset.trans inter_subset_right hn₂
  rcases hk.elim_finite_subcover_image hj₁ hj₂ with ⟨g, hg₁ : ∀ u ∈ g, u ∈ f, hg₂, hg₃⟩
  let w := (⋂ u ∈ g, u) ∩ v
  have hw₂ : w ∈ f := by simpa [w, *]
  have hw₃ : k \ n ⊆ (closure (image2 ϕ w s))ᶜ := by
    apply Subset.trans hg₃
    simp only [j, iUnion_subset_iff, compl_subset_compl]
    intro u hu
    unfold w
    gcongr
    refine iInter_subset_of_subset u (iInter_subset_of_subset hu ?_)
    all_goals exact Subset.rfl
  have hw₄ : kᶜ ⊆ (closure (image2 ϕ w s))ᶜ := by
    simp only [compl_subset_compl]
    exact closure_mono (image2_subset inter_subset_right Subset.rfl)
  have hnc : nᶜ ⊆ k \ n ∪ kᶜ := by rw [union_comm, ← inter_subset, sdiff_eq, inter_comm]
  have hw : closure (image2 ϕ w s) ⊆ n :=
    compl_subset_compl.mp (Subset.trans hnc (union_subset hw₃ hw₄))
  exact ⟨_, hw₂, hw⟩

name: eventually_closure_subset_of_isCompact_absorbing_of_isOpen_of_omegaLimit_subset
statement:
theorem eventually_closure_subset_of_isCompact_absorbing_of_isOpen_of_omegaLimit_subset [T2Space β]
    {c : Set β} (hc₁ : IsCompact c) (hc₂ : ∀ᶠ t in f, MapsTo (ϕ t) s c) {n : Set β} (hn₁ : IsOpen n)
    (hn₂ : ω f ϕ s ⊆ n) : ∃ u ∈ f, closure (image2 ϕ u s) ⊆ n
proof:
:=
  eventually_closure_subset_of_isCompact_absorbing_of_isOpen_of_omegaLimit_subset' f ϕ _ hc₁
    ⟨_, hc₂, closure_minimal (image2_subset_iff.2 fun _t ↦ id) hc₁.isClosed⟩ hn₁ hn₂

name: eventually_mapsTo_of_isCompact_absorbing_of_isOpen_of_omegaLimit_subset
statement:
theorem eventually_mapsTo_of_isCompact_absorbing_of_isOpen_of_omegaLimit_subset [T2Space β]
    {c : Set β} (hc₁ : IsCompact c) (hc₂ : ∀ᶠ t in f, MapsTo (ϕ t) s c) {n : Set β} (hn₁ : IsOpen n)
    (hn₂ : ω f ϕ s ⊆ n) : ∀ᶠ t in f, MapsTo (ϕ t) s n
proof:
:= by
  rcases eventually_closure_subset_of_isCompact_absorbing_of_isOpen_of_omegaLimit_subset f ϕ s hc₁
      hc₂ hn₁ hn₂ with
    ⟨u, hu_mem, hu⟩
  refine mem_of_superset hu_mem fun t ht x hx ↦ ?_
  exact hu (subset_closure <| mem_image2_of_mem ht hx)

name: eventually_closure_subset_of_isOpen_of_omegaLimit_subset
statement:
theorem eventually_closure_subset_of_isOpen_of_omegaLimit_subset [CompactSpace β] {v : Set β}
    (hv₁ : IsOpen v) (hv₂ : ω f ϕ s ⊆ v) : ∃ u ∈ f, closure (image2 ϕ u s) ⊆ v
proof:
:=
  eventually_closure_subset_of_isCompact_absorbing_of_isOpen_of_omegaLimit_subset' _ _ _
    isCompact_univ ⟨univ, univ_mem, subset_univ _⟩ hv₁ hv₂

name: eventually_mapsTo_of_isOpen_of_omegaLimit_subset
statement:
theorem eventually_mapsTo_of_isOpen_of_omegaLimit_subset [CompactSpace β] {v : Set β}
    (hv₁ : IsOpen v) (hv₂ : ω f ϕ s ⊆ v) : ∀ᶠ t in f, MapsTo (ϕ t) s v
proof:
:= by
  rcases eventually_closure_subset_of_isOpen_of_omegaLimit_subset f ϕ s hv₁ hv₂ with ⟨u, hu_mem, hu⟩
  refine mem_of_superset hu_mem fun t ht x hx ↦ ?_
  exact hu (subset_closure <| mem_image2_of_mem ht hx)

name: nonempty_omegaLimit_of_isCompact_absorbing
statement:
theorem nonempty_omegaLimit_of_isCompact_absorbing [NeBot f] {c : Set β} (hc₁ : IsCompact c)
    (hc₂ : ∃ v ∈ f, closure (image2 ϕ v s) ⊆ c) (hs : s.Nonempty) : (ω f ϕ s).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  rcases hc₂ with ⟨v, hv₁, hv₂⟩
  rw [omegaLimit_eq_iInter_inter _ _ _ hv₁]
  apply IsCompact.nonempty_iInter_of_directed_nonempty_isCompact_isClosed
  · rintro ⟨u₁, hu₁⟩ ⟨u₂, hu₂⟩
    use ⟨u₁ ∩ u₂, inter_mem hu₁ hu₂⟩
    constructor
    all_goals exact closure_mono (image2_subset (inter_subset_inter_left _ (by simp)) Subset.rfl)
  · intro u
    have hn : (image2 ϕ (u ∩ v) s).Nonempty :=
      Nonempty.image2 (Filter.nonempty_of_mem (inter_mem u.prop hv₁)) hs
    exact hn.mono subset_closure
  · intro
    apply hc₁.of_isClosed_subset isClosed_closure
    grw [inter_subset_right, hv₂]
  · exact fun _ ↦ isClosed_closure

name: nonempty_omegaLimit
statement: theorem nonempty_omegaLimit [CompactSpace β] [NeBot f] (hs : s.Nonempty) : (ω f ϕ s).Nonempty
proof:
:=
  nonempty_omegaLimit_of_isCompact_absorbing _ _ _ isCompact_univ ⟨univ, univ_mem, subset_univ _⟩ hs

name: isInvariant_omegaLimit
statement: theorem isInvariant_omegaLimit (hf : ∀ t, Tendsto (t + ·) f f) : IsInvariant ϕ (ω f ϕ s)
proof:
:= by
  refine fun t ↦ MapsTo.mono_right ?_ (omegaLimit_subset_of_tendsto ϕ s (hf t))
  exact
    mapsTo_omegaLimit _ (mapsTo_id _) (fun t' x ↦ (ϕ.map_add _ _ _).symm)
      (continuous_const.flow ϕ continuous_id)

name: omegaLimit_image_subset
statement:
theorem omegaLimit_image_subset (t : τ) (ht : Tendsto (· + t) f f) :
    ω f ϕ (ϕ t '' s) ⊆ ω f ϕ s
proof:
:= by
  simp only [omegaLimit_image_eq, ← map_add]
  exact omegaLimit_subset_of_tendsto ϕ s ht

name: omegaLimit_image_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem omegaLimit_image_eq (hf : ∀ t, Tendsto (· + t) f f) (t : τ) : ω f ϕ (ϕ t '' s) = ω f ϕ s
proof:
:=
  Subset.antisymm (omegaLimit_image_subset _ _ _ _ (hf t)) <|
    calc
      ω f ϕ s = ω f ϕ (ϕ (-t) '' ϕ t '' s) := by simp [image_image, ← map_add]
      _ ⊆ ω f ϕ (ϕ t '' s) := omegaLimit_image_subset _ _ _ _ (hf _)

name: omegaLimit_omegaLimit
statement: theorem omegaLimit_omegaLimit (hf : ∀ t, Tendsto (t + ·) f f) : ω f ϕ (ω f ϕ s) ⊆ ω f ϕ s
proof:
:= by
  simp only [subset_def, mem_omegaLimit_iff_frequently₂, frequently_iff]
  intro _ h n hn u hu
  rcases mem_nhds_iff.mp hn with ⟨o, ho₁, ho₂, ho₃⟩
  rcases h o (IsOpen.mem_nhds ho₂ ho₃) hu with ⟨t, _ht₁, ht₂⟩
  have l₁ : (ω f ϕ s ∩ o).Nonempty :=
    ht₂.mono
      (inter_subset_inter_left _
        ((isInvariant_iff_image _ _).mp (isInvariant_omegaLimit _ _ _ hf) _))
  have l₂ : (closure (image2 ϕ u s) ∩ o).Nonempty :=
    l₁.mono fun b hb ↦ ⟨omegaLimit_subset_closure_image2 _ _ _ hu hb.1, hb.2⟩
  have l₃ : (o ∩ image2 ϕ u s).Nonempty := by
    rcases l₂ with ⟨b, hb₁, hb₂⟩
    exact mem_closure_iff_nhds.mp hb₁ o (IsOpen.mem_nhds ho₂ hb₂)
  rcases l₃ with ⟨ϕra, ho, ⟨_, hr, _, ha, hϕra⟩⟩
  exact ⟨_, hr, ϕra, ⟨_, ha, hϕra⟩, ho₁ ho⟩

name: MulAction.dense_orbit
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem MulAction.dense_orbit [IsMinimal M α] (x : α) : Dense (orbit M x)
proof:
:=

name: denseRange_smul
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem denseRange_smul [IsMinimal M α] (x : α) : DenseRange fun c : M ↦ c • x
proof:

name: IsOpen.exists_smul_mem
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem IsOpen.exists_smul_mem [IsMinimal M α] (x : α) {U : Set α} (hUo : IsOpen U)
    (hne : U.Nonempty) : ∃ c : M, c • x ∈ U
proof:
:=
  (denseRange_smul M x).exists_mem_open hUo hne

name: IsOpen.iUnion_preimage_smul
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem IsOpen.iUnion_preimage_smul [IsMinimal M α] {U : Set α} (hUo : IsOpen U)
    (hne : U.Nonempty) : ⋃ c : M, (c • ·) ⁻¹' U = univ
proof:
:=
  iUnion_eq_univ_iff.2 fun x ↦ hUo.exists_smul_mem M x hne

name: IsOpen.iUnion_smul
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem IsOpen.iUnion_smul [IsMinimal G α] {U : Set α} (hUo : IsOpen U) (hne : U.Nonempty) :
    ⋃ g : G, g • U = univ
proof:
:=
  iUnion_eq_univ_iff.2 fun x ↦
    let ⟨g, hg⟩ := hUo.exists_smul_mem G x hne
    ⟨g⁻¹, _, hg, inv_smul_smul _ _⟩

name: IsCompact.exists_finite_cover_smul
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem IsCompact.exists_finite_cover_smul [IsMinimal G α] [ContinuousConstSMul G α]
    {K U : Set α} (hK : IsCompact K) (hUo : IsOpen U) (hne : U.Nonempty) :
    ∃ I : Finset G, K ⊆ ⋃ g ∈ I, g • U
proof:
:=
  (hK.elim_finite_subcover (fun g ↦ g • U) fun _ ↦ hUo.smul _) <| calc
    K ⊆ univ := subset_univ K
    _ = ⋃ g : G, g • U := (hUo.iUnion_smul G hne).symm

name: dense_of_nonempty_smul_invariant
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem dense_of_nonempty_smul_invariant [IsMinimal M α] {s : Set α} (hne : s.Nonempty)
    (hsmul : ∀ c : M, c • s ⊆ s) : Dense s
proof:
:=
  let ⟨x, hx⟩ := hne
  (MulAction.dense_orbit M x).mono (range_subset_iff.2 fun c ↦ hsmul c ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩)

name: eq_empty_or_univ_of_smul_invariant_closed
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem eq_empty_or_univ_of_smul_invariant_closed [IsMinimal M α] {s : Set α} (hs : IsClosed s)
    (hsmul : ∀ c : M, c • s ⊆ s) : s = ∅ ∨ s = univ
proof:
:=
  s.eq_empty_or_nonempty.imp_right fun hne ↦
    hs.closure_eq ▸ (dense_of_nonempty_smul_invariant M hne hsmul).closure_eq

name: isMinimal_iff_isClosed_smul_invariant
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem isMinimal_iff_isClosed_smul_invariant [ContinuousConstSMul M α] :
    IsMinimal M α ↔ ∀ s : Set α, IsClosed s → (∀ c : M, c • s ⊆ s) → s = ∅ ∨ s = univ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro _ _
    exact eq_empty_or_univ_of_smul_invariant_closed M
  refine fun H ↦ ⟨fun _ ↦ dense_iff_closure_eq.2 <| (H _ ?_ ?_).resolve_left ?_⟩
  exacts [isClosed_closure, fun _ ↦ smul_closure_orbit_subset _ _,
    (nonempty_orbit _).closure.ne_empty]

name: newtonMap_apply
statement:
theorem newtonMap_apply :
    P.newtonMap x = x - (Ring.inverse <| aeval x (derivative P)) * (aeval x P)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: newtonMap_apply_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem newtonMap_apply_of_isUnit (h : IsUnit <| aeval x (derivative P)) :
    P.newtonMap x = x - h.unit⁻¹ * aeval x P
proof:
:= by
  simp [newtonMap_apply, Ring.inverse, h]

name: newtonMap_apply_of_not_isUnit
statement:
theorem newtonMap_apply_of_not_isUnit (h : ¬ (IsUnit <| aeval x (derivative P))) :
    P.newtonMap x = x
proof:
:= by
  simp [newtonMap_apply, Ring.inverse, h]

name: isNilpotent_iterate_newtonMap_sub_of_isNilpotent
statement:
theorem isNilpotent_iterate_newtonMap_sub_of_isNilpotent (h : IsNilpotent <| aeval x P) (n : ℕ) :
    IsNilpotent <| P.newtonMap^[n] x - x
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [iterate_succ', comp_apply, newtonMap_apply, sub_right_comm]
    refine (Commute.all _ _).isNilpotent_sub ih <| (Commute.all _ _).isNilpotent_mul_left ?_
    simpa using Commute.isNilpotent_add (Commute.all _ _)
      (isNilpotent_aeval_sub_of_isNilpotent_sub P ih) h

name: isFixedPt_newtonMap_of_aeval_eq_zero
statement:
theorem isFixedPt_newtonMap_of_aeval_eq_zero (h : aeval x P = 0) :
    IsFixedPt P.newtonMap x
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsFixedPt, newtonMap_apply, h, mul_zero, sub_zero]

name: isFixedPt_newtonMap_of_isUnit_iff
statement:
theorem isFixedPt_newtonMap_of_isUnit_iff (h : IsUnit <| aeval x (derivative P)) :
    IsFixedPt P.newtonMap x ↔ aeval x P = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsFixedPt, newtonMap_apply, sub_eq_self, Ring.inverse_mul_eq_iff_eq_mul _ _ _ h, mul_zero]

name: aeval_pow_two_pow_dvd_aeval_iterate_newtonMap
statement:
theorem aeval_pow_two_pow_dvd_aeval_iterate_newtonMap
    (h : IsNilpotent (aeval x P)) (h' : IsUnit (aeval x <| derivative P)) (n : ℕ) :
    (aeval x P) ^ (2 ^ n) ∣ aeval (P.newtonMap^[n] x) P
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have ⟨d, hd⟩ := binomExpansion (P.map (algebraMap R S)) (P.newtonMap^[n] x)
      (-Ring.inverse (aeval (P.newtonMap^[n] x) <| derivative P) * aeval (P.newtonMap^[n] x) P)
    rw [eval_map_algebraMap, eval_map_algebraMap] at hd
    rw [iterate_succ', comp_apply, newtonMap_apply, sub_eq_add_neg, neg_mul_eq_neg_mul, hd]
    refine dvd_add ?_ (dvd_mul_of_dvd_right ?_ _)
    · convert! dvd_zero _
      have : IsUnit (aeval (P.newtonMap^[n] x) <| derivative P) :=
        isUnit_aeval_of_isUnit_aeval_of_isNilpotent_sub h' <|
        isNilpotent_iterate_newtonMap_sub_of_isNilpotent h n
      rw [derivative_map, eval_map_algebraMap, ← mul_assoc, mul_neg, Ring.mul_inverse_cancel _ this,
        neg_mul, one_mul, add_neg_cancel]
    · rw [neg_mul, even_two.neg_pow, mul_pow, pow_succ, pow_mul]
      exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right (pow_dvd_pow_of_dvd ih 2) _

name: existsUnique_nilpotent_sub_and_aeval_eq_zero
statement:
theorem existsUnique_nilpotent_sub_and_aeval_eq_zero
    (h : IsNilpotent (aeval x P)) (h' : IsUnit (aeval x <| derivative P)) :
    ∃! r, IsNilpotent (x - r) ∧ aeval r P = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [(neg_sub _ x).symm, isNilpotent_neg_iff]
  refine existsUnique_of_exists_of_unique ?_ fun r₁ r₂ ⟨hr₁, hr₁'⟩ ⟨hr₂, hr₂'⟩ ↦ ?_
  · 
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := id h
    refine ⟨P.newtonMap^[n] x, isNilpotent_iterate_newtonMap_sub_of_isNilpotent h n, ?_⟩
    rw [← zero_dvd_iff, ← pow_eq_zero_of_le (n.lt_two_pow_self).le hn]
    exact aeval_pow_two_pow_dvd_aeval_iterate_newtonMap h h' n
  · 
    have ⟨u, hu⟩ := binomExpansion (P.map (algebraMap R S)) r₁ (r₂ - r₁)
    suffices IsUnit (aeval r₁ (derivative P) + u * (r₂ - r₁)) by
      rwa [derivative_map, eval_map_algebraMap, eval_map_algebraMap, eval_map_algebraMap,
        add_sub_cancel, hr₂', hr₁', zero_add, pow_two, ← mul_assoc, ← add_mul, eq_comm,
        this.mul_right_eq_zero, sub_eq_zero, eq_comm] at hu
    have : IsUnit (aeval r₁ (derivative P)) :=
      isUnit_aeval_of_isUnit_aeval_of_isNilpotent_sub h' hr₁
    rw [← sub_sub_sub_cancel_right r₂ r₁ x]
    refine IsNilpotent.isUnit_add_left_of_commute ?_ this (Commute.all _ _)
    exact (Commute.all _ _).isNilpotent_mul_left <| (Commute.all _ _).isNilpotent_sub hr₂ hr₁

name: IsDynCoverOf.closure
statement:
lemma IsDynCoverOf.closure (h : Continuous T)
    (V_uni : V ∈ 𝓤 X) (s_cover : IsDynCoverOf T F U n s) :
    IsDynCoverOf T (closure F) (V ○ U) n s
proof:
:= by
  rcases (hasBasis_symmetric.mem_iff' V).1 V_uni with ⟨W, ⟨W_uni, W_symm⟩, W_V⟩
  refine IsDynCoverOf.of_entourage_subset (SetRel.comp_subset_comp_left W_V) fun x hx ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨y, hxy, hy⟩ := mem_closure_iff_nhds.1 hx _ (ball_dynEntourage_mem_nhds h W_uni n x)
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hyz⟩ := s_cover hy
  exact ⟨z, hz, dynEntourage_comp_subset _ _ _ _ ⟨y, hxy, hyz⟩⟩

name: coverMincard_closure_le
statement:
lemma coverMincard_closure_le (h : Continuous T) (F : Set X) (U : SetRel X X)
    (V_uni : V ∈ 𝓤 X) (n : ℕ) :
    coverMincard T (closure F) (V ○ U) n ≤ coverMincard T F U n
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_top_or_lt_top (coverMincard T F U n) with h' | h'
  · exact h' ▸ le_top
  obtain ⟨s, s_cover, s_coverMincard⟩ := (coverMincard_finite_iff T F U n).1 h'
  exact s_coverMincard ▸ (s_cover.closure h V_uni).coverMincard_le_card

name: coverEntropyInf_closure

    coverEntropyInf T (closure F) = coverEntropyInf T F
proof:

  refine (iSup₂_le fun U U_uni ↦ ?_).antisymm (coverEntropyInf_monotone T subset_closure)
  obtain ⟨V, V_uni, V_U⟩ := comp_mem_uniformity_sets U_uni
  exact le_iSup₂_of_le V V_uni ((coverEntropyInfEntourage_antitone T (closure F) V_U).trans
    (coverEntropyInfEntourage_closure h F V V_uni))

  obtain ⟨V, V_uni, V_U⟩ := comp_mem_uniformity_sets U_uni
  exact le_iSup₂_of_le V V_uni ((coverEntropyEntourage_antitone T (closure F) V_U).trans
    (coverEntropyEntourage_closure h F V V_uni))

name: IsDynCoverOf.union
statement:
lemma IsDynCoverOf.union (hs : IsDynCoverOf T F U n s) (ht : IsDynCoverOf T G U n t) :
    IsDynCoverOf T (F ∪ G) U n (s ∪ t)
proof: := SetRel.IsCover.union hs ht

name: coverMincard_union_le
statement:
lemma coverMincard_union_le (T : X → X) (F G : Set X) (U : SetRel X X) (n : ℕ) :
    coverMincard T (F ∪ G) U n ≤ coverMincard T F U n + coverMincard T G U n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases eq_top_or_lt_top (coverMincard T F U n) with hF | hF
  · rw [hF, top_add]; exact le_top
  rcases eq_top_or_lt_top (coverMincard T G U n) with hG | hG
  · rw [hG, add_top]; exact le_top
  obtain ⟨s, s_cover, s_coverMincard⟩ := (coverMincard_finite_iff T F U n).1 hF
  obtain ⟨t, t_cover, t_coverMincard⟩ := (coverMincard_finite_iff T G U n).1 hG
  rw [← s_coverMincard, ← t_coverMincard, ← ENat.natCast_add]
  apply (IsDynCoverOf.coverMincard_le_card _).trans (WithTop.coe_mono (s.card_union_le t))
  rw [s.coe_union t]
  exact s_cover.union t_cover

name: coverEntropyEntourage_union
statement:
lemma coverEntropyEntourage_union :
    coverEntropyEntourage T (F ∪ G) U
      = max (coverEntropyEntourage T F U) (coverEntropyEntourage T G U)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · apply le_of_le_of_eq (expGrowthSup_monotone fun n ↦ ?_) expGrowthSup_add
    rw [Pi.add_apply, ← ENat.toENNReal_add]
    exact ENat.toENNReal_mono (coverMincard_union_le T F G U n)
  · exact max_le (coverEntropyEntourage_monotone T U subset_union_left)
      (coverEntropyEntourage_monotone T U subset_union_right)

name: coverEntropy_union
statement:
lemma coverEntropy_union :
    coverEntropy T (F ∪ G) = max (coverEntropy T F) (coverEntropy T G)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coverEntropy, ← iSup_sup_eq]
  exact biSup_congr fun _ _ ↦ coverEntropyEntourage_union

name: coverEntropyInf_iUnion_le

lemma coverEntropyInf_iUnion_le (T : X → X) (F : ι → Set X) :

name: coverEntropy_iUnion_le

name: coverEntropy_biUnion_finset

lemma coverEntropy_biUnion_finset {T : X → X} {F : ι → Set X} {s : Finset ι} :

name: IsDynCoverOf.image
statement:
lemma IsDynCoverOf.image (h : Semiconj φ S T) (h' : IsDynCoverOf S F (map φ φ ⁻¹' V) n s) :
    IsDynCoverOf T (φ '' F) V n (φ '' s)
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := h' hx
  refine ⟨_, Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hy, show (x, y) ∈ map φ φ ⁻¹' dynEntourage T V n from ?_⟩
  rwa [h.preimage_dynEntourage V n]

name: IsDynCoverOf.preimage
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty X with _ | _
  · exact ⟨∅, eq_empty_of_isEmpty F ▸ ⟨isDynCoverOf_empty, Finset.card_empty ▸ zero_le⟩⟩
  
  
  
  
  obtain ⟨s, s_cover, s_card, s_inter⟩ := h'.nonempty_inter
  choose! g g_rel g_mem using fun (x : Y) (h : x ∈ s) ↦ nonempty_def.1 (s_inter x h)
  choose! f _ φ_f using fun (y : Y) (hy : y ∈ φ '' F) ↦ hy
  refine ⟨s.image (f ∘ g), fun x hx ↦ ?_, Finset.card_image_le.trans s_card⟩
  simp only [Finset.coe_image, comp_apply, mem_image, SetLike.mem_coe, ← h.preimage_dynEntourage,
    mem_preimage, map_apply, exists_exists_and_eq_and]
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := s_cover (Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hx)
  refine ⟨y, hy, dynEntourage_comp_subset _ _ _ _ ⟨_, hxy, ?_⟩⟩
  rw [φ_f _ (g_mem _ hy)]
  exact g_rel _ hy

name: le_coverMincard_image
statement:
lemma le_coverMincard_image (h : Semiconj φ S T) (F : Set X) [V.IsSymm] (n : ℕ) :
    coverMincard S F ((map φ φ) ⁻¹' (V ○ V)) n ≤ coverMincard T (φ '' F) V n
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_top_or_lt_top (coverMincard T (φ '' F) V n) with h' | h'
  · exact h' ▸ le_top
  obtain ⟨t, t_cover, t_card⟩ := (coverMincard_finite_iff T (φ '' F) V n).1 h'
  obtain ⟨s, s_cover, s_card⟩ := t_cover.preimage h
  rw [← t_card]
  exact s_cover.coverMincard_le_card.trans (WithTop.coe_le_coe.2 s_card)

name: coverMincard_image_le
statement:
lemma coverMincard_image_le (h : Semiconj φ S T) (F : Set X) (V : SetRel Y Y) (n : ℕ) :
    coverMincard T (φ '' F) V n ≤ coverMincard S F ((map φ φ) ⁻¹' V) n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases eq_top_or_lt_top (coverMincard S F ((map φ φ) ⁻¹' V) n) with h' | h'
  · exact h' ▸ le_top
  obtain ⟨s, s_cover, s_card⟩ := (coverMincard_finite_iff S F ((map φ φ) ⁻¹' V) n).1 h'
  rw [← s_card]
  have := s_cover.image h
  rw [← s.coe_image] at this
  exact this.coverMincard_le_card.trans (WithTop.coe_le_coe.2 s.card_image_le)

name: le_coverEntropyEntourage_image
statement:
lemma le_coverEntropyEntourage_image (h : Semiconj φ S T) (F : Set X) [V.IsSymm] :

name: coverEntropy_image_of_comap
proof:
:= by
  let : UniformSpace X := comap φ u
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine iSup₂_le fun V V_uni ↦
      (coverEntropyEntourage_antitone _ _ SetRel.symmetrize_subset_self).trans <|
      (coverEntropyEntourage_image_le h F _).trans ?_
    apply coverEntropyEntourage_le_coverEntropy
    rw [uniformity_comap φ, mem_comap]
    exact ⟨_, symmetrize_mem_uniformity V_uni, .rfl⟩
  · refine iSup₂_le fun U U_uni ↦ ?_
    simp only [uniformity_comap φ, mem_comap] at U_uni
    obtain ⟨V, V_uni, V_sub⟩ := U_uni
    obtain ⟨W, W_uni, W_symm, W_V⟩ := comp_symm_mem_uniformity_sets V_uni
    apply (coverEntropyEntourage_antitone S F ((preimage_mono W_V).trans V_sub)).trans
    apply (le_coverEntropyEntourage_image h F).trans
    exact coverEntropyEntourage_le_coverEntropy T (φ '' F) W_uni

name: coverEntropyInf_image_of_comap
proof:
:= by
  let : UniformSpace X := comap φ u
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine iSup₂_le fun V V_uni ↦
      (coverEntropyInfEntourage_antitone _ _ SetRel.symmetrize_subset_self).trans <|
      (coverEntropyInfEntourage_image_le h F _).trans ?_
    apply coverEntropyInfEntourage_le_coverEntropyInf
    rw [uniformity_comap φ, mem_comap]
    exact ⟨_, symmetrize_mem_uniformity V_uni, .rfl⟩
  · refine iSup₂_le fun U U_uni ↦ ?_
    simp only [uniformity_comap φ, mem_comap] at U_uni
    obtain ⟨V, V_uni, V_sub⟩ := U_uni
    obtain ⟨W, W_uni, W_symm, W_V⟩ := comp_symm_mem_uniformity_sets V_uni
    apply (coverEntropyInfEntourage_antitone S F ((preimage_mono W_V).trans V_sub)).trans
    apply (le_coverEntropyInfEntourage_image h F).trans
    exact coverEntropyInfEntourage_le_coverEntropyInf T (φ '' F) W_uni

name: coverEntropy_restrict_subset
statement:
lemma coverEntropy_restrict_subset [UniformSpace X] {T : X → X} {F G : Set X} (hF : F ⊆ G)
    (hG : MapsTo T G G) :
    coverEntropy (hG.restrict T G G) (val ⁻¹' F) = coverEntropy T F
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coverEntropy_image_of_comap _ hG.val_restrict_apply (val ⁻¹' F), image_preimage_coe G F,
    inter_eq_right.2 hF]

    (hG : MapsTo T G G) :
    coverEntropyInf (hG.restrict T G G) (val ⁻¹' F) = coverEntropyInf T F
proof:
:= by

    inter_eq_right.2 hF]

name: coverEntropy_restrict
statement:
theorem coverEntropy_restrict [UniformSpace X] {T : X → X} {F : Set X} (h : MapsTo T F F) :

proof:
:= by
  rw [← coverEntropy_restrict_subset Subset.rfl h, coe_preimage_self F]

name: coverEntropy_image_le_of_uniformContinuous
proof:
:= by
  rw [coverEntropy_image_of_comap _ h F]
  exact coverEntropy_antitone S F (uniformContinuous_iff_le_comap.1 h')

name: coverEntropy_image_le_of_uniformContinuousOn_invariant
statement:
lemma coverEntropy_image_le_of_uniformContinuousOn_invariant [UniformSpace X] [UniformSpace Y]
    {S : X → X} {T : Y → Y} {φ : X → Y} (h : Semiconj φ S T) {F G : Set X}
    (h' : UniformContinuousOn φ G) (hF : F ⊆ G) (hG : MapsTo S G G) :
    coverEntropy T (φ '' F) ≤ coverEntropy S F
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coverEntropy_restrict_subset hF hG]
  have hφ : Semiconj (G.domRestrict φ) (hG.restrict S G G) T := by
    intro x
    rw [G.domRestrict_apply, G.domRestrict_apply, hG.val_restrict_apply, h.eq x]
  apply (coverEntropy_image_le_of_uniformContinuous hφ
    (uniformContinuousOn_iff_restrict.1 h') (val ⁻¹' F)).trans_eq'
  rw [← image_image_val_eq_domRestrict_image, image_preimage_coe G F, inter_eq_right.2 hF]

name: coverEntropyInf_image_le_of_uniformContinuousOn_invariant
statement:
lemma coverEntropyInf_image_le_of_uniformContinuousOn_invariant [UniformSpace X] [UniformSpace Y]
    {S : X → X} {T : Y → Y} {φ : X → Y} (h : Semiconj φ S T) {F G : Set X}
    (h' : UniformContinuousOn φ G) (hF : F ⊆ G) (hG : MapsTo S G G) :
    coverEntropyInf T (φ '' F) ≤ coverEntropyInf S F
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coverEntropyInf_restrict_subset hF hG]
  have hφ : Semiconj (G.domRestrict φ) (hG.restrict S G G) T := by
    intro a
    rw [G.domRestrict_apply, G.domRestrict_apply, hG.val_restrict_apply, h.eq a]
  apply (coverEntropyInf_image_le_of_uniformContinuous hφ
    (uniformContinuousOn_iff_restrict.1 h') (val ⁻¹' F)).trans_eq'
  rw [← image_image_val_eq_domRestrict_image, image_preimage_coe G F, inter_eq_right.2 hF]

name: IsDynCoverOf.of_le
statement: lemma IsDynCoverOf.of_le (m_n : m ≤ n) (h : IsDynCoverOf T F U n s) : IsDynCoverOf T F U m s
proof:
:=
  h.mono_entourage <| by gcongr

name: IsDynCoverOf.of_entourage_subset
statement:
lemma IsDynCoverOf.of_entourage_subset (U_V : U ⊆ V) (h : IsDynCoverOf T F U n s) :
    IsDynCoverOf T F V n s
proof: := h.mono_entourage <| by gcongr

name: isDynCoverOf_empty
statement: @[simp] lemma isDynCoverOf_empty : IsDynCoverOf T ∅ U n s
proof: := .empty

name: isDynCoverOf_empty_right
statement: @[simp] lemma isDynCoverOf_empty_right : IsDynCoverOf T F U n ∅ ↔ F = ∅
proof: := by simp [IsDynCoverOf]

statement:
lemma isDynCoverOf_zero (T : X → X) (F : Set X) (U : SetRel X X) (h : s.Nonempty) :
    IsDynCoverOf T F U 0 s
proof: := by simp [IsDynCoverOf, h]

name: isDynCoverOf_univ
statement:
lemma isDynCoverOf_univ (T : X → X) (F : Set X) (n : ℕ) (h : s.Nonempty) :
    IsDynCoverOf T F univ n s
proof: := by simp [IsDynCoverOf, h]

name: IsDynCoverOf.nonempty_inter
statement:
lemma IsDynCoverOf.nonempty_inter [U.IsSymm] {s : Finset X} (h : IsDynCoverOf T F U n s) :
    ∃ t : Finset X, IsDynCoverOf T F U n t ∧ #t ≤ #s ∧
      ∀ x ∈ t, (ball x (dynEntourage T U n) ∩ F).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  classical
  use {x ∈ s | (ball x (dynEntourage T U n) ∩ F).Nonempty}
  simp only [Finset.coe_filter, Finset.mem_filter, and_imp, imp_self, implies_true, and_true]
  refine ⟨fun y y_F ↦ ?_, Finset.card_mono (Finset.filter_subset _ s)⟩
  obtain ⟨z, z_s, y_Bz⟩ := h y_F
  exact ⟨z, ⟨z_s, _, (dynEntourage T U n).symm y_Bz, y_F⟩, y_Bz⟩

name: IsDynCoverOf.iterate_le_pow
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  rcases F.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | F_nemp
  · exact ⟨∅, by simp⟩
  have _ : Nonempty X := F_nemp.nonempty
  have s_nemp := h.nonempty F_nemp
  obtain ⟨x, x_F⟩ := F_nemp
  rcases m.eq_zero_or_pos with rfl | m_pos
  · use {x}
    simp only [zero_mul, Finset.coe_singleton, Finset.card_singleton]
    exact ⟨isDynCoverOf_zero T F (U ○ U) (singleton_nonempty x),
      one_le_pow_of_one_le' (Nat.one_le_of_lt (Finset.Nonempty.card_pos s_nemp)) n⟩
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  have (t : Fin n → s) : ∃ y : X, (⋂ k : Fin n, T^[m * k] ⁻¹' ball (t k) (dynEntourage T U m)) ⊆
      ball y (dynEntourage T (U ○ U) (m * n)) := by
    rcases (⋂ k : Fin n, T^[m * k] ⁻¹' ball (t k) (dynEntourage T U m)).eq_empty_or_nonempty
      with inter_empt | inter_nemp
    · exact inter_empt ▸ ⟨x, empty_subset _⟩
    · obtain ⟨y, y_int⟩ := inter_nemp
      refine ⟨y, fun z z_int ↦ ?_⟩
      simp only [ball, dynEntourage, Prod.map_iterate, mem_iInter, Set.mem_preimage, Prod.map_apply,
        mem_comp] at y_int z_int ⊢
      intro k k_mn
      replace k_mn := Nat.div_lt_of_lt_mul k_mn
      specialize z_int ⟨(k / m), k_mn⟩ (k % m) (Nat.mod_lt k m_pos)
      specialize y_int ⟨(k / m), k_mn⟩ (k % m) (Nat.mod_lt k m_pos)
      rw [← Function.iterate_add_apply T (k % m) (m * (k / m)), Nat.mod_add_div k m] at y_int z_int
      exact mem_comp_of_mem_ball y_int z_int
  choose! dyncover h_dyncover using this
  
  
  
  let sn := range dyncover
  refine ⟨sn.toFinset, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    
    
    
    rw [Finset.coe_nonempty] at s_nemp
    have _ : Nonempty s := Finset.Nonempty.coe_sort s_nemp
    intro y y_F
    have key : ∀ k : Fin n, ∃ z : s, y ∈ T^[m * k] ⁻¹' ball z (dynEntourage T U m) := by
      intro k
      have := h (MapsTo.iterate F_inv (m * k) y_F)
      simp only [Finset.mem_coe] at this
      obtain ⟨z, z_s, hz⟩ := this
      exact ⟨⟨z, z_s⟩, (dynEntourage T U m).symm hz⟩
    choose! t ht using key
    simp only [toFinset_range, Finset.coe_image, Finset.coe_univ, image_univ, mem_range,
      exists_exists_eq_and, sn]
    refine ⟨t, (dynEntourage T (U ○ U) (m * n)).symm <| h_dyncover t <| by simpa using ht⟩
  · rw [toFinset_card]
    apply (Fintype.card_range_le dyncover).trans
    simp only [Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_coe, Fintype.card_fin, le_refl]

name: exists_isDynCoverOf_of_isCompact_uniformContinuous
statement:
lemma exists_isDynCoverOf_of_isCompact_uniformContinuous [UniformSpace X]
    (F_comp : IsCompact F) (h : UniformContinuous T) (U_uni : U ∈ 𝓤 X) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ s : Finset X, IsDynCoverOf T F U n s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨(V : SetRel X X), hV, hVsymm, hVU⟩ := symm_of_uniformity U_uni
  have uni_ite := dynEntourage_mem_uniformity h hV n
  let openCover x := ball x (dynEntourage T V n)
  obtain ⟨s, _, s_cover⟩ := F_comp.elim_nhds_subcover openCover fun x _ ↦ ball_mem_nhds x uni_ite
  exact ⟨s, .of_entourage_subset hVU <| .of_subset_iUnion_ball s_cover⟩

name: exists_isDynCoverOf_of_isCompact_invariant
statement:
lemma exists_isDynCoverOf_of_isCompact_invariant [UniformSpace X]
    (F_comp : IsCompact F) (F_inv : MapsTo T F F) (U_uni : U ∈ 𝓤 X) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ s : Finset X, IsDynCoverOf T F U n s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨(V : SetRel X X), V_uni, V_symm, V_U⟩ := comp_symm_mem_uniformity_sets U_uni
  obtain ⟨s, _, s_cover⟩ := F_comp.elim_nhds_subcover (ball · V)
    fun (x : X) _ ↦ ball_mem_nhds x V_uni
  have : IsDynCoverOf T F V 1 s := .of_subset_iUnion_ball <| by simpa using s_cover
  obtain ⟨t, t_dyncover, t_card⟩ := this.iterate_le_pow F_inv n
  rw [one_mul n] at t_dyncover
  exact ⟨t, t_dyncover.of_entourage_subset V_U⟩

name: IsDynCoverOf.coverMincard_le_card
statement:
lemma IsDynCoverOf.coverMincard_le_card {s : Finset X} (h : IsDynCoverOf T F U n s) :
    coverMincard T F U n ≤ s.card
proof:
:=
  iInf₂_le s h

name: coverMincard_monotone_time
statement:
lemma coverMincard_monotone_time (T : X → X) (F : Set X) (U : SetRel X X) :
    Monotone fun n : ℕ ↦ coverMincard T F U n
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ m_n ↦ biInf_mono fun _ h ↦ h.of_le m_n

name: coverMincard_antitone
statement:
lemma coverMincard_antitone (T : X → X) (F : Set X) (n : ℕ) :
    Antitone fun U : SetRel X X ↦ coverMincard T F U n
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ U_V ↦ biInf_mono fun _ h ↦ h.of_entourage_subset U_V

name: coverMincard_finite_iff
statement:
lemma coverMincard_finite_iff (T : X → X) (F : Set X) (U : SetRel X X) (n : ℕ) :
    coverMincard T F U n < ⊤ ↔
    ∃ s : Finset X, IsDynCoverOf T F U n s ∧ s.card = coverMincard T F U n
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h_fin ↦ ?_, fun ⟨s, _, s_coverMincard⟩ ↦ s_coverMincard ▸ WithTop.coe_lt_top s.card⟩
  obtain ⟨k, k_min⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp h_fin.ne
  rw [← k_min]
  simp only [Nat.cast_inj]
  have : Nonempty {s : Finset X // IsDynCoverOf T F U n s} := by
    by_contra h
    apply ENat.natCast_ne_top k
    rw [k_min, coverMincard, iInf₂_eq_top]
    simp only [ENat.natCast_ne_top, imp_false]
    rw [nonempty_subtype, not_exists] at h
    exact h
  have key := ciInf_mem fun s : {s : Finset X // IsDynCoverOf T F U n s} ↦ (s.val.card : ℕ∞)
  rw [coverMincard, iInf_subtype'] at k_min
  rw [← k_min, mem_range, Subtype.exists] at key
  simp only [Nat.cast_inj, exists_prop] at key
  exact key

name: coverMincard_empty
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coverMincard_empty : coverMincard T ∅ U n = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← nonpos_iff_eq_zero]
  exact sInf_le (by simp [IsDynCoverOf])

name: coverMincard_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma coverMincard_eq_zero_iff (T : X → X) (F : Set X) (U : SetRel X X) (n : ℕ) :
    coverMincard T F U n = 0 ↔ F = ∅
proof:
:= by
  simp [coverMincard, ENat.iInf_eq_zero]

name: one_le_coverMincard_iff
statement:
lemma one_le_coverMincard_iff (T : X → X) (F : Set X) (U : SetRel X X) (n : ℕ) :
    1 ≤ coverMincard T F U n ↔ F.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  rw [Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero, nonempty_iff_ne_empty, not_iff_not]
  exact coverMincard_eq_zero_iff T F U n

name: coverMincard_zero
statement:
lemma coverMincard_zero (T : X → X) (h : F.Nonempty) (U : SetRel X X) :
    coverMincard T F U 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm _ ((one_le_coverMincard_iff T F U 0).2 h)
  obtain ⟨x, _⟩ := h
  have := isDynCoverOf_zero T F U (singleton_nonempty x)
  rw [← Finset.coe_singleton] at this
  apply this.coverMincard_le_card.trans_eq
  rw [Finset.card_singleton, Nat.cast_one]

name: coverMincard_univ
statement: lemma coverMincard_univ (T : X → X) (h : F.Nonempty) (n : ℕ) : coverMincard T F univ n = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm _ ((one_le_coverMincard_iff T F univ n).2 h)
  obtain ⟨x, _⟩ := h
  have := isDynCoverOf_univ T F n (singleton_nonempty x)
  rw [← Finset.coe_singleton] at this
  apply this.coverMincard_le_card.trans_eq
  rw [Finset.card_singleton, Nat.cast_one]

name: coverMincard_mul_le_pow
statement:
lemma coverMincard_mul_le_pow (F_inv : MapsTo T F F) [U.IsSymm] (m n : ℕ) :
    coverMincard T F (U ○ U) (m * n) ≤ coverMincard T F U m ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rcases F.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | F_nonempty
  · simp
  obtain rfl | hn := eq_or_ne n 0
  · rw [mul_zero, coverMincard_zero T F_nonempty (U ○ U), pow_zero]
  rcases eq_top_or_lt_top (coverMincard T F U m) with h | h
  · simp [*]
  · obtain ⟨s, s_cover, s_coverMincard⟩ := (coverMincard_finite_iff T F U m).1 h
    obtain ⟨t, t_cover, t_sn⟩ := s_cover.iterate_le_pow F_inv n
    rw [← s_coverMincard]
    exact t_cover.coverMincard_le_card.trans (WithTop.coe_le_coe.2 t_sn)

name: coverMincard_le_pow
statement:
lemma coverMincard_le_pow (F_inv : MapsTo T F F) [U.IsSymm] (m_pos : 0 < m) (n : ℕ) :
    coverMincard T F (U ○ U) n ≤ coverMincard T F U m ^ (n / m + 1)
proof:
:=
  (coverMincard_monotone_time T F (U ○ U) (Nat.lt_mul_div_succ n m_pos).le).trans
    (coverMincard_mul_le_pow F_inv m (n / m + 1))

name: coverMincard_finite_of_isCompact_uniformContinuous
statement:
lemma coverMincard_finite_of_isCompact_uniformContinuous [UniformSpace X] (F_comp : IsCompact F)
    (h : UniformContinuous T) (U_uni : U ∈ 𝓤 X) (n : ℕ) :
    coverMincard T F U n < ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, s_cover⟩ := exists_isDynCoverOf_of_isCompact_uniformContinuous F_comp h U_uni n
  exact s_cover.coverMincard_le_card.trans_lt (WithTop.coe_lt_top s.card)

name: coverMincard_finite_of_isCompact_invariant
statement:
lemma coverMincard_finite_of_isCompact_invariant [UniformSpace X] (F_comp : IsCompact F)
    (F_inv : MapsTo T F F) (U_uni : U ∈ 𝓤 X) (n : ℕ) :
    coverMincard T F U n < ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, s_cover⟩ := exists_isDynCoverOf_of_isCompact_invariant F_comp F_inv U_uni n
  exact s_cover.coverMincard_le_card.trans_lt (WithTop.coe_lt_top s.card)

name: nonempty_inter_of_coverMincard
statement:
lemma nonempty_inter_of_coverMincard [U.IsSymm] {s : Finset X} (h : IsDynCoverOf T F U n s)
    (h' : #s = coverMincard T F U n) :
    ∀ x ∈ s, (F ∩ ball x (dynEntourage T U n)).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  
  classical
  by_contra! ⟨x, x_s, ball_empt⟩
  have smaller_cover : IsDynCoverOf T F U n (s.erase x) := by
    intro y y_F
    specialize h y_F
    simp only [s.mem_coe] at h
    simp only [s.coe_erase, mem_sdiff, s.mem_coe, mem_singleton_iff]
    obtain ⟨z, z_s, hz⟩ := h
    refine ⟨z, ⟨z_s, fun z_x ↦ notMem_empty y ?_⟩, hz⟩
    rw [← ball_empt]
    rw [z_x] at hz
    exact mem_inter y_F <| (dynEntourage T U n).symm hz
  apply smaller_cover.coverMincard_le_card.not_gt
  rw [← h']
  exact_mod_cast s.card_erase_lt_of_mem x_s

name: coverEntropyEntourage_le_log_coverMincard_div
statement:
lemma coverEntropyEntourage_le_log_coverMincard_div (F_inv : MapsTo T F F) [U.IsSymm]
    (n_pos : n ≠ 0) :
    coverEntropyEntourage T F (U ○ U) ≤ log (coverMincard T F U n) / n
proof:
:= by
  have cv_mono : Monotone fun m ↦ (coverMincard T F (U ○ U) m).toENNReal :=
    fun _ _ k_m ↦ ENat.toENNReal_mono (coverMincard_monotone_time T F (U ○ U) k_m)
  have h := cv_mono.expGrowthSup_comp_mul n_pos
  rw [mul_comm, ← div_eq_iff (natCast_ne_bot n) (natCast_ne_top n) (Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 n_pos)] at h
  rw [coverEntropyEntourage, ← h]
  apply monotone_div_right_of_nonneg n.cast_nonneg'
  rw [← expGrowthSup_pow]
  refine expGrowthSup_monotone fun m ↦ ?_
  rw [← ENat.toENNReal_pow]
  exact ENat.toENNReal_mono (coverMincard_mul_le_pow F_inv n m)

name: IsDynCoverOf.coverEntropyEntourage_le_log_card_div
statement:
lemma IsDynCoverOf.coverEntropyEntourage_le_log_card_div (F_inv : MapsTo T F F) [U.IsSymm]
    (n_pos : n ≠ 0) {s : Finset X} (h : IsDynCoverOf T F U n s) :
    coverEntropyEntourage T F (U ○ U) ≤ log s.card / n
proof:
:= by
  apply (coverEntropyEntourage_le_log_coverMincard_div F_inv n_pos).trans
  apply monotone_div_right_of_nonneg n.cast_nonneg' (log_monotone _)
  exact_mod_cast coverMincard_le_card h

name: coverEntropyEntourage_le_coverEntropyInfEntourage
statement:
lemma coverEntropyEntourage_le_coverEntropyInfEntourage (F_inv : MapsTo T F F) [U.IsSymm] :
    coverEntropyEntourage T F (U ○ U) ≤ coverEntropyInfEntourage T F U
proof:
:= by
  refine (le_liminf_of_le) (eventually_atTop.2 ⟨1, fun m m_pos ↦ ?_⟩)
  exact coverEntropyEntourage_le_log_coverMincard_div F_inv (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.1 m_pos)

name: coverEntropyEntourage_finite_of_isCompact_invariant
statement:
lemma coverEntropyEntourage_finite_of_isCompact_invariant [UniformSpace X]
    (F_comp : IsCompact F) (F_inv : MapsTo T F F) (U_uni : U ∈ 𝓤 X) :
    coverEntropyEntourage T F U < ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, V_uni, V_symm, V_U⟩ := comp_symm_mem_uniformity_sets U_uni
  obtain ⟨s, s_cover⟩ := exists_isDynCoverOf_of_isCompact_invariant F_comp F_inv V_uni 1
  apply (coverEntropyEntourage_antitone T F V_U).trans_lt
  apply (s_cover.coverEntropyEntourage_le_log_card_div F_inv one_ne_zero).trans_lt
  rw [Nat.cast_one, div_one, log_lt_top_iff, ← ENat.toENNReal_top]
  exact_mod_cast (ENat.natCast_ne_top (Finset.card s)).lt_top

lemma coverEntropyInfEntourage_le_coverEntropyInf (T : X → X) (F : Set X)

name: coverEntropy_eq_iSup_basis
proof:
:= by
  refine (iSup₂_le fun U U_uni ↦ ?_).antisymm
    (iSup₂_mono' fun i h_i ↦ ⟨s i, HasBasis.mem_of_mem h h_i, le_refl _⟩)
  obtain ⟨i, h_i, si_U⟩ := (HasBasis.mem_iff h).1 U_uni
  exact (coverEntropyEntourage_antitone T F si_U).trans
    (le_iSup₂ (f := fun (i : ι) (_ : p i) ↦ coverEntropyEntourage T F (s i)) i h_i)

name: coverEntropyInf_eq_iSup_basis
proof:
:= by
  refine (iSup₂_le fun U U_uni ↦ ?_).antisymm
    (iSup₂_mono' fun i h_i ↦ ⟨s i, HasBasis.mem_of_mem h h_i, le_refl _⟩)
  obtain ⟨i, h_i, si_U⟩ := (HasBasis.mem_iff h).1 U_uni
  exact (coverEntropyInfEntourage_antitone T F si_U).trans
    (le_iSup₂ (f := fun (i : ι) (_ : p i) ↦ coverEntropyInfEntourage T F (s i)) i h_i)

lemma coverEntropyInf_eq_coverEntropy (T : X → X) (h : MapsTo T F F) :

  obtain ⟨V, V_uni, V_symm, V_U⟩ := comp_symm_mem_uniformity_sets U_uni
  exact (coverEntropyEntourage_antitone T F V_U).trans <| le_iSup₂_of_le V V_uni <|
     coverEntropyEntourage_le_coverEntropyInfEntourage h

name: IsDynNetIn.of_le
statement: lemma IsDynNetIn.of_le (m_n : m ≤ n) (h : IsDynNetIn T F U m s) : IsDynNetIn T F U n s
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.1, PairwiseDisjoint.mono h.2 fun x ↦ ball_mono (dynEntourage_antitone T U m_n) x⟩

name: IsDynNetIn.of_entourage_subset
statement:
lemma IsDynNetIn.of_entourage_subset (U_V : U ⊆ V) (h : IsDynNetIn T F V n s) :
    IsDynNetIn T F U n s
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.1, PairwiseDisjoint.mono h.2 fun x ↦ ball_mono (dynEntourage_monotone T n U_V) x⟩

name: isDynNetIn_empty
statement: lemma isDynNetIn_empty : IsDynNetIn T F U n ∅
proof: := ⟨empty_subset F, pairwise_empty _⟩

name: isDynNetIn_singleton
statement:
lemma isDynNetIn_singleton (T : X → X) (U : SetRel X X) (n : ℕ) (h : x ∈ F) :
    IsDynNetIn T F U n {x}
proof:
:=
  ⟨singleton_subset_iff.2 h, pairwise_singleton x _⟩

name: IsDynNetIn.card_le_card_of_isDynCoverOf
proof:
:= by
  have (x : X) (x_s : x ∈ s) : ∃ z ∈ t, z ∈ ball x (dynEntourage T U n) := by
    simpa using! ht (hs.1 x_s)
  choose! F s_t using this
  apply Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn F fun x x_s ↦ (s_t x x_s).1
  exact fun x x_s y y_s Fx_Fy ↦
    PairwiseDisjoint.elim_set hs.2 x_s y_s (F x) (s_t x x_s).2 (Fx_Fy ▸ (s_t y y_s).2)

name: IsDynNetIn.card_le_netMaxcard
statement:
lemma IsDynNetIn.card_le_netMaxcard {s : Finset X} (h : IsDynNetIn T F U n s) :
    s.card ≤ netMaxcard T F U n
proof:
:= by
  grw [netMaxcard, ← le_iSup₂ s h]

name: netMaxcard_monotone_time
statement:
lemma netMaxcard_monotone_time (T : X → X) (F : Set X) (U : SetRel X X) :
    Monotone fun n : ℕ ↦ netMaxcard T F U n
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ m_n ↦ biSup_mono fun _ h ↦ h.of_le m_n

name: netMaxcard_antitone
statement:
lemma netMaxcard_antitone (T : X → X) (F : Set X) (n : ℕ) :
    Antitone fun U : SetRel X X ↦ netMaxcard T F U n
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ U_V ↦ biSup_mono fun _ h ↦ h.of_entourage_subset U_V

name: netMaxcard_finite_iff
statement:
lemma netMaxcard_finite_iff (T : X → X) (F : Set X) (U : SetRel X X) (n : ℕ) :
    netMaxcard T F U n < ⊤ ↔
    ∃ s : Finset X, IsDynNetIn T F U n s ∧ (s.card : ℕ∞) = netMaxcard T F U n
proof:
:= by
  apply Iff.intro <;> intro h
  · obtain ⟨k, k_max⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp h.ne
    rw [← k_max]
    simp only [Nat.cast_inj]
    
    
    have : netMaxcard T F U n
      = sSup (WithTop.some '' Finset.card '' {s : Finset X | IsDynNetIn T F U n s}) := by
      rw [netMaxcard, ← image_comp, sSup_image]
      simp only [mem_ofPred_eq, ENat.some_eq_natCast, Function.comp_apply]
      exact biSup_congr (fun _ _ ↦ rfl)
    rw [this] at k_max
    have h_bdda : BddAbove (Finset.card '' {s : Finset X | IsDynNetIn T F U n s}) := by
      refine ⟨k, mem_upperBounds.2 ?_⟩
      simp only [mem_image, mem_ofPred_eq, forall_exists_index, and_imp, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂]
      intro s h
      rw [← ENat.natCast_le_natCast, k_max]
      apply le_sSup
      exact Filter.frequently_principal.mp fun a ↦ a (by simpa using ⟨_, h, rfl⟩) rfl
    have h_nemp : (Finset.card '' {s : Finset X | IsDynNetIn T F U n s}).Nonempty := by
      refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
      simp only [mem_image, mem_ofPred_eq, Finset.card_eq_zero, exists_eq_right, Finset.coe_empty]
      exact isDynNetIn_empty
    rw [← WithTop.coe_sSup' h_bdda] at k_max
    have key := Nat.sSup_mem h_nemp h_bdda
    rw [← Nat.cast_inj.mp k_max, mem_image] at key
    simp only [mem_ofPred_eq] at key
    exact key
  · obtain ⟨s, _, s_card⟩ := h
    rw [← s_card]
    exact WithTop.coe_lt_top s.card

name: netMaxcard_empty
statement:
@[simp]
lemma netMaxcard_empty : netMaxcard T ∅ U n = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [netMaxcard, ← bot_eq_zero, iSup₂_eq_bot]
  intro s s_net
  replace s_net := subset_empty_iff.1 s_net.1
  norm_cast at s_net
  rw [s_net, Finset.card_empty, CharP.cast_eq_zero, bot_eq_zero']

name: netMaxcard_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma netMaxcard_eq_zero_iff (T : X → X) (F : Set X) (U : SetRel X X) (n : ℕ) :
    netMaxcard T F U n = 0 ↔ F = ∅
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ by rw [h, netMaxcard_empty]⟩
  rw [eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
  intro x x_F
  have key := isDynNetIn_singleton T U n x_F
  rw [← Finset.coe_singleton] at key
  replace key := key.card_le_netMaxcard
  rw [Finset.card_singleton, Nat.cast_one, h] at key
  exact key.not_gt zero_lt_one

name: one_le_netMaxcard_iff
statement:
lemma one_le_netMaxcard_iff (T : X → X) (F : Set X) (U : SetRel X X) (n : ℕ) :
    1 ≤ netMaxcard T F U n ↔ F.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  rw [Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero, nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
  exact not_iff_not.2 (netMaxcard_eq_zero_iff T F U n)

name: netMaxcard_zero
statement: lemma netMaxcard_zero (T : X → X) (h : F.Nonempty) (U : SetRel X X) : netMaxcard T F U 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply (iSup₂_le _).antisymm ((one_le_netMaxcard_iff T F U 0).2 h)
  intro s ⟨_, s_net⟩
  simp only [ball, dynEntourage_zero, preimage_univ] at s_net
  norm_cast
  refine Finset.card_le_one.2 fun x x_s y y_s ↦ ?_
  exact PairwiseDisjoint.elim_set s_net x_s y_s x (mem_univ x) (mem_univ x)

name: netMaxcard_univ
statement: lemma netMaxcard_univ (T : X → X) (h : F.Nonempty) (n : ℕ) : netMaxcard T F univ n = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply (iSup₂_le _).antisymm ((one_le_netMaxcard_iff T F univ n).2 h)
  intro s ⟨_, s_net⟩
  simp only [ball, dynEntourage_univ, preimage_univ] at s_net
  norm_cast
  refine Finset.card_le_one.2 fun x x_s y y_s ↦ ?_
  exact PairwiseDisjoint.elim_set s_net x_s y_s x (mem_univ x) (mem_univ x)

name: netMaxcard_infinite_iff
statement:
lemma netMaxcard_infinite_iff (T : X → X) (F : Set X) (U : SetRel X X) (n : ℕ) :
    netMaxcard T F U n = ⊤ ↔ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ s : Finset X, IsDynNetIn T F U n s ∧ k ≤ s.card
proof:
:= by
  apply Iff.intro <;> intro h
  · intro k
    rw [netMaxcard, iSup_subtype', iSup_eq_top] at h
    specialize h k (ENat.natCast_lt_top k)
    simp only [Nat.cast_lt, Subtype.exists, exists_prop] at h
    obtain ⟨s, s_net, s_k⟩ := h
    exact ⟨s, s_net, s_k.le⟩
  · refine ENat.eq_top_iff_forall_gt.mpr fun k ↦ ?_
    specialize h (k + 1)
    obtain ⟨s, s_net, s_card⟩ := h
    apply s_net.card_le_netMaxcard.trans_lt'
    rw [Nat.cast_lt]
    exact (lt_add_one k).trans_le s_card

name: netMaxcard_le_coverMincard
statement:
lemma netMaxcard_le_coverMincard (T : X → X) (F : Set X) (n : ℕ) :
    netMaxcard T F U n ≤ coverMincard T F U n
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_top_or_lt_top (coverMincard T F U n) with h | h
  · exact h ▸ le_top
  · obtain ⟨t, t_cover, t_mincard⟩ := (coverMincard_finite_iff T F U n).1 h
    rw [← t_mincard]
    exact iSup₂_le fun s s_net ↦ Nat.cast_le.2 (s_net.card_le_card_of_isDynCoverOf t_cover)

name: coverMincard_le_netMaxcard
statement:
lemma coverMincard_le_netMaxcard (T : X → X) (F : Set X) [U.IsRefl] [U.IsSymm] (n : ℕ) :
    coverMincard T F (U ○ U) n ≤ netMaxcard T F U n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  rcases eq_top_or_lt_top (netMaxcard T F U n) with h | h
  · exact h ▸ le_top
  obtain ⟨s, s_net, s_card⟩ := (netMaxcard_finite_iff T F U n).1 h
  rw [← s_card]
  apply IsDynCoverOf.coverMincard_le_card
  
  
  
  rw [IsDynCoverOf, isCover_iff_subset_iUnion_ball]
  by_contra h
  obtain ⟨x, x_F, x_uncov⟩ := not_subset.1 h
  simp only [Finset.mem_coe, mem_iUnion, exists_prop, not_exists, not_and] at x_uncov
  have larger_net : IsDynNetIn T F U n (insert x s) := by
    refine ⟨insert_subset x_F s_net.1, pairwiseDisjoint_insert.2 ⟨s_net.2, ?_⟩⟩
    refine fun y y_s _ ↦ disjoint_left.2 fun z z_x z_y ↦ x_uncov y y_s ?_
    exact mem_ball_dynEntourage_comp T n x y (nonempty_of_mem ⟨z_x, z_y⟩)
  rw [← s.coe_insert x] at larger_net
  apply larger_net.card_le_netMaxcard.not_gt
  rw [← s_card, Nat.cast_lt]
  refine (lt_add_one s.card).trans_eq (s.card_insert_of_notMem fun x_s ↦ ?_).symm
  exact x_uncov x x_s (ball_mono (dynEntourage_monotone T n SetRel.left_subset_comp) x <|
    SetRel.rfl (dynEntourage T U n))

name: coverEntropyInf_eq_iSup_netEntropyInfEntourage
statement:
theorem coverEntropyInf_eq_iSup_netEntropyInfEntourage :
    coverEntropyInf T F = ⨆ U ∈ 𝓤 X, netEntropyInfEntourage T F U
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm <;> refine iSup₂_le fun U U_uni ↦ ?_
  · obtain ⟨V, V_uni, V_symm, V_U⟩ := comp_symm_mem_uniformity_sets U_uni
    have := isRefl_of_mem_uniformity V_uni
    apply (coverEntropyInfEntourage_antitone T F V_U).trans (le_iSup₂_of_le V V_uni _)
    exact coverEntropyInfEntourage_le_netEntropyInfEntourage T F
  · apply (netEntropyInfEntourage_antitone T F SetRel.symmetrize_subset_self).trans
    apply (le_iSup₂ (SetRel.symmetrize U) (symmetrize_mem_uniformity U_uni)).trans'
    exact netEntropyInfEntourage_le_coverEntropyInfEntourage T F

  · obtain ⟨V, V_uni, V_symm, V_comp_U⟩ := comp_symm_mem_uniformity_sets U_uni
    apply (coverEntropyEntourage_antitone T F V_comp_U).trans (le_iSup₂_of_le V V_uni _)
    have := isRefl_of_mem_uniformity V_uni
    exact coverEntropyEntourage_le_netEntropyEntourage T F
  · apply (netEntropyEntourage_antitone T F SetRel.symmetrize_subset_self).trans
    apply (le_iSup₂ (SetRel.symmetrize U) (symmetrize_mem_uniformity U_uni)).trans'
    exact netEntropyEntourage_le_coverEntropyEntourage T F

name: coverEntropyInf_eq_iSup_basis_netEntropyInfEntourage
proof:
:= by

  apply (iSup₂_mono' fun i h_i ↦ ⟨s i, HasBasis.mem_of_mem h h_i, le_refl _⟩).antisymm'
  refine iSup₂_le fun U U_uni ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨i, h_i, si_U⟩ := (HasBasis.mem_iff h).1 U_uni
  apply (netEntropyInfEntourage_antitone T F si_U).trans
  exact le_iSup₂ (f := fun (i : ι) (_ : p i) ↦ netEntropyInfEntourage T F (s i)) i h_i

name: coverEntropy_eq_iSup_basis_netEntropyEntourage

name: dynEntourage_mem_uniformity
statement:
lemma dynEntourage_mem_uniformity [UniformSpace X] (h : UniformContinuous T)
    (U_uni : U ∈ 𝓤 X) (n : ℕ) :
    dynEntourage T U n ∈ 𝓤 X
proof:
:= by
  rw [dynEntourage_eq_inter_Ico T U n]
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [iInter_coe_set, mem_Ico, Nat.zero_le, true_and] at ih ⊢
    rw [Set.biInter_lt_succ]
    apply Filter.inter_mem ih
    rw [map_iterate T T n]
    exact uniformContinuous_def.1 (UniformContinuous.iterate T n h) U U_uni

name: ball_dynEntourage_mem_nhds
statement:
lemma ball_dynEntourage_mem_nhds [UniformSpace X] (h : Continuous T)

proof:
:= by
  rw [dynEntourage_eq_inter_Ico T U n, ball_iInter, Filter.iInter_mem, Subtype.forall]
  intro k _
  simp only [map_iterate, _root_.ball_preimage]
  exact (h.iterate k).continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (ball_mem_nhds (T^[k] x) U_uni)

proof:

  intro k k_n xy xy_comp
  simp only [SetRel.comp, mem_iInter, mem_preimage, map_apply, mem_ofPred_eq] at xy_comp ⊢
  rcases xy_comp with ⟨z, hz1, hz2⟩
  exact mem_ball_comp (hz1 k k_n) (hz2 k k_n)

statement:
theorem birkhoffAverage_apply_sub_birkhoffAverage (f : α → α) (g : α → M) (n : ℕ) (x : α) :
    birkhoffAverage R f g n (f x) - birkhoffAverage R f g n x =
      (n : R)⁻¹ • (g (f^[n] x) - g x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [birkhoffAverage, birkhoffSum_apply_sub_birkhoffSum, ← smul_sub]

name: birkhoffAverage_comp_sub_birkhoffAverage
statement:
theorem birkhoffAverage_comp_sub_birkhoffAverage (f : α → α) (g : α → M) (n : ℕ) :
    birkhoffAverage R f g n ∘ f - birkhoffAverage R f g n = (n : R)⁻¹ • (g ∘ f^[n] - g)
proof:
:=
  funext <| birkhoffAverage_apply_sub_birkhoffAverage f g n

name: birkhoffSum_zero_apply
statement: theorem birkhoffSum_zero_apply (f : α → α) (g : α → M) (x : α) : birkhoffSum f g 0 x = 0
proof:
:=
  sum_range_zero _

name: birkhoffSum_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem birkhoffSum_zero (f : α → α) (g : α → M) : birkhoffSum f g 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  funext <| birkhoffSum_zero_apply _ _

name: birkhoffSum_one_apply
statement: theorem birkhoffSum_one_apply (f : α → α) (g : α → M) (x : α) : birkhoffSum f g 1 x = g x
proof:
:=
  sum_range_one _

name: birkhoffSum_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem birkhoffSum_one (f : α → α) (g : α → M) : birkhoffSum f g 1 = g
proof:
:=
  funext <| birkhoffSum_one_apply f g

name: birkhoffSum_succ_apply
statement:
theorem birkhoffSum_succ_apply (f : α → α) (g : α → M) (n : ℕ) (x : α) :
    birkhoffSum f g (n + 1) x = birkhoffSum f g n x + g (f^[n] x)
proof:
:=
  sum_range_succ _ _

name: birkhoffSum_succ
statement:
theorem birkhoffSum_succ (f : α → α) (g : α → M) (n : ℕ) :
    birkhoffSum f g (n + 1) = birkhoffSum f g n + g ∘ f^[n]
proof:
:=
  funext <| birkhoffSum_succ_apply f g n

name: birkhoffSum_succ_apply'
statement:
theorem birkhoffSum_succ_apply' (f : α → α) (g : α → M) (n : ℕ) (x : α) :
    birkhoffSum f g (n + 1) x = g x + birkhoffSum f g n (f x)
proof:
:=
  (sum_range_succ' _ _).trans (add_comm _ _)

name: birkhoffSum_succ'
statement:
theorem birkhoffSum_succ' (f : α → α) (g : α → M) (n : ℕ) :
    birkhoffSum f g (n + 1) = g + birkhoffSum f g n ∘ f
proof:
:=
  funext <| birkhoffSum_succ_apply' f g n

name: birkhoffSum_add_apply
statement:
theorem birkhoffSum_add_apply (f : α → α) (g g' : α → M) (n : ℕ) (x : α) :
    birkhoffSum f (g + g') n x = birkhoffSum f g n x + birkhoffSum f g' n x
proof:
:= by
  simpa [birkhoffSum] using sum_add_distrib

name: birkhoffSum_add
statement:
theorem birkhoffSum_add (f : α → α) (g g' : α → M) :
    birkhoffSum f (g + g') = birkhoffSum f g + birkhoffSum f g'
proof:
:=
  funext₂ <| birkhoffSum_add_apply f g g'

name: birkhoffSum_add_right_apply
statement:
theorem birkhoffSum_add_right_apply (f : α → α) (g : α → M) (m n : ℕ) (x : α) :
    birkhoffSum f g (m + n) x = birkhoffSum f g m x + birkhoffSum f g n (f^[m] x)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [birkhoffSum, sum_range_add, add_comm m, iterate_add_apply]

name: birkhoffSum_add_right
statement:
theorem birkhoffSum_add_right (f : α → α) (g : α → M) (m n : ℕ) :
    birkhoffSum f g (m + n) = birkhoffSum f g m + birkhoffSum f g n ∘ f^[m]
proof:
:=
  funext <| birkhoffSum_add_right_apply f g m n

name: Function.IsFixedPt.birkhoffSum_eq
statement:
theorem Function.IsFixedPt.birkhoffSum_eq {f : α → α} {x : α} (h : IsFixedPt f x) (g : α → M)
    (n : ℕ) : birkhoffSum f g n x = n • g x
proof:
:= by
  simp [birkhoffSum, (h.iterate _).eq]

name: map_birkhoffSum
statement:
theorem map_birkhoffSum {F N : Type*} [AddCommMonoid N] [FunLike F M N] [AddMonoidHomClass F M N]
    (g' : F) (f : α → α) (g : α → M) (n : ℕ) (x : α) :
    g' (birkhoffSum f g n x) = birkhoffSum f (g' ∘ g) n x
proof:
:=
  map_sum g' _ _

name: map_comp_birkhoffSum
statement:
theorem map_comp_birkhoffSum {F N : Type*} [AddCommMonoid N] [FunLike F M N]
    [AddMonoidHomClass F M N] (g' : F) (f : α → α) (g : α → M) (n : ℕ) :
    ⇑g' ∘ birkhoffSum f g n = birkhoffSum f (g' ∘ g) n
proof:
:=
  funext <| map_birkhoffSum g' f g n

name: birkhoffSum_apply_of_comp_eq
statement:
theorem birkhoffSum_apply_of_comp_eq {f : α → α} {φ : α → M} (h : φ ∘ f = φ) (n : ℕ) (x : α) :
    birkhoffSum f φ n x = n • φ x
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ k, φ (f^[k] x) = φ x by simp [birkhoffSum, this]
  intro k
  exact congrFun (iterate_invariant h k) x

name: birkhoffSum_of_comp_eq
statement:
theorem birkhoffSum_of_comp_eq {f : α → α} {φ : α → M} (h : φ ∘ f = φ) (n : ℕ) :
    birkhoffSum f φ n = n • φ
proof:
:=
  funext <| birkhoffSum_apply_of_comp_eq h n

name: birkhoffSum_neg_apply
statement:
theorem birkhoffSum_neg_apply (f : α → α) (g : α → G) (n : ℕ) (x : α) :
    birkhoffSum f (-g) n x = -birkhoffSum f g n x
proof:
:= by
  simp [birkhoffSum]

name: birkhoffSum_neg
statement:
theorem birkhoffSum_neg (f : α → α) (g : α → G) :
    birkhoffSum f (-g) = -birkhoffSum f g
proof:
:=
  funext₂ <| birkhoffSum_neg_apply f g

name: birkhoffSum_sub_apply
statement:
theorem birkhoffSum_sub_apply (f : α → α) (g g' : α → G) (n : ℕ) (x : α) :
    birkhoffSum f (g - g') n x = birkhoffSum f g n x - birkhoffSum f g' n x
proof:
:= by
  simp [birkhoffSum]

name: birkhoffSum_sub
statement:
theorem birkhoffSum_sub (f : α → α) (g g' : α → G) :
    birkhoffSum f (g - g') = birkhoffSum f g - birkhoffSum f g'
proof:
:=
  funext₂ <| birkhoffSum_sub_apply f g g'

name: birkhoffSum_apply_sub_birkhoffSum
statement:
theorem birkhoffSum_apply_sub_birkhoffSum (f : α → α) (g : α → G) (n : ℕ) (x : α) :
    birkhoffSum f g n (f x) - birkhoffSum f g n x = g (f^[n] x) - g x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_iff_eq_add.2 (birkhoffSum_succ_apply f g n x),
    ← sub_eq_iff_eq_add.2 (birkhoffSum_succ_apply' f g n x),
    ← sub_add, ← sub_add, sub_add_comm]

name: birkhoffSum_comp_sub_birkhoffSum
statement:
theorem birkhoffSum_comp_sub_birkhoffSum (f : α → α) (g : α → G) (n : ℕ) :
    birkhoffSum f g n ∘ f - birkhoffSum f g n = g ∘ f^[n] - g
proof:
:=
  funext <| birkhoffSum_apply_sub_birkhoffSum f g n

name: birkhoffSum_ae_eq_of_ae_eq
statement:
theorem birkhoffSum_ae_eq_of_ae_eq (hf : QuasiMeasurePreserving f μ μ) (hφ : φ =ᵐ[μ] ψ) n :
    birkhoffSum f φ n =ᵐ[μ] birkhoffSum f ψ n
proof:
:= by
  apply Eventually.mono _ (fun _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl)
  apply ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => ?_)
  exact (hf.iterate i).ae (hφ.mono (fun _ h _ => h))

name: birkhoffAverage_ae_eq_of_ae_eq
statement:
theorem birkhoffAverage_ae_eq_of_ae_eq (R : Type*) [DivisionSemiring R] [Module R M]
    (hf : QuasiMeasurePreserving f μ μ) (hφ : φ =ᵐ[μ] ψ) n :
    birkhoffAverage R f φ n =ᵐ[μ] birkhoffAverage R f ψ n
proof:
:=
  EventuallyEq.const_smul (birkhoffSum_ae_eq_of_ae_eq hf hφ n) (n : R)⁻¹

name: Function.IsFixedPt.tendsto_birkhoffAverage
statement:
theorem Function.IsFixedPt.tendsto_birkhoffAverage
    (R : Type*) [DivisionSemiring R] [CharZero R]
    [AddCommMonoid E] [TopologicalSpace E] [Module R E]
    {f : α → α} {x : α} (h : f.IsFixedPt x) (g : α → E) :
    Tendsto (birkhoffAverage R f g · x) atTop (𝓝 (g x))
proof:
:=
  tendsto_const_nhds.congr' <| (eventually_ne_atTop 0).mono fun _n hn ↦
    (h.birkhoffAverage_eq R g (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hn)).symm

name: dist_birkhoffSum_apply_birkhoffSum
statement:
theorem dist_birkhoffSum_apply_birkhoffSum (f : α → α) (g : α → E) (n : ℕ) (x : α) :
    dist (birkhoffSum f g n (f x)) (birkhoffSum f g n x) = dist (g (f^[n] x)) (g x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dist_eq_norm, birkhoffSum_apply_sub_birkhoffSum]

name: dist_birkhoffSum_birkhoffSum_le
statement:
theorem dist_birkhoffSum_birkhoffSum_le (f : α → α) (g : α → E) (n : ℕ) (x y : α) :
    dist (birkhoffSum f g n x) (birkhoffSum f g n y) ≤
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, dist (g (f^[k] x)) (g (f^[k] y))
proof:
:=
  dist_sum_sum_le _ _ _

name: dist_birkhoffAverage_birkhoffAverage
statement:
theorem dist_birkhoffAverage_birkhoffAverage (f : α → α) (g : α → E) (n : ℕ) (x y : α) :
    dist (birkhoffAverage 𝕜 f g n x) (birkhoffAverage 𝕜 f g n y) =
      dist (birkhoffSum f g n x) (birkhoffSum f g n y) / n
proof:
:= by
  simp [birkhoffAverage, dist_smul₀, div_eq_inv_mul]

name: dist_birkhoffAverage_birkhoffAverage_le
statement:
theorem dist_birkhoffAverage_birkhoffAverage_le (f : α → α) (g : α → E) (n : ℕ) (x y : α) :
    dist (birkhoffAverage 𝕜 f g n x) (birkhoffAverage 𝕜 f g n y) ≤
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, dist (g (f^[k] x)) (g (f^[k] y))) / n
proof:
:=
  (dist_birkhoffAverage_birkhoffAverage _ _ _ _ _ _).trans_le <| by
    gcongr; apply dist_birkhoffSum_birkhoffSum_le

name: dist_birkhoffAverage_apply_birkhoffAverage
statement:
theorem dist_birkhoffAverage_apply_birkhoffAverage (f : α → α) (g : α → E) (n : ℕ) (x : α) :
    dist (birkhoffAverage 𝕜 f g n (f x)) (birkhoffAverage 𝕜 f g n x) =
      dist (g (f^[n] x)) (g x) / n
proof:
:= by
  simp [dist_birkhoffAverage_birkhoffAverage, dist_birkhoffSum_apply_birkhoffSum]

name: tendsto_birkhoffAverage_apply_sub_birkhoffAverage
proof:
:= by
  rcases Metric.isBounded_range_iff.1 h with ⟨C, hC⟩
  have : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ C / n) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  refine squeeze_zero_norm (fun n ↦ ?_) this
  rw [← dist_eq_norm, dist_birkhoffAverage_apply_birkhoffAverage]
  gcongr
  exact hC n 0

name: tendsto_birkhoffAverage_apply_sub_birkhoffAverage'
proof:
:=
  tendsto_birkhoffAverage_apply_sub_birkhoffAverage _ <| h.subset <| range_comp_subset_range _ _

name: uniformEquicontinuous_birkhoffAverage
statement:
theorem uniformEquicontinuous_birkhoffAverage (hf : LipschitzWith 1 f) (hg : UniformContinuous g) :
    UniformEquicontinuous (birkhoffAverage 𝕜 f g)
proof:
:= by
  refine Metric.uniformity_basis_dist_le.uniformEquicontinuous_iff_right.2 fun ε hε ↦ ?_
  rcases (uniformity_basis_edist_le.uniformContinuous_iff Metric.uniformity_basis_dist_le).1 hg ε hε
    with ⟨δ, hδ₀, hδε⟩
  refine mem_uniformity_edist.2 ⟨δ, hδ₀, fun {x y} h n ↦ ?_⟩
  calc
    dist (birkhoffAverage 𝕜 f g n x) (birkhoffAverage 𝕜 f g n y)
      ≤ (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, dist (g (f^[k] x)) (g (f^[k] y))) / n :=
      dist_birkhoffAverage_birkhoffAverage_le ..
    _ ≤ (∑ _k ∈ Finset.range n, ε) / n := by
      gcongr
      refine hδε _ _ ?_
      simpa using (hf.iterate _).edist_le_mul_of_le h.le
    _ = n * ε / n := by simp
    _ ≤ ε := by
      rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with hn | hn <;> simp [hn, hε.le, mul_div_cancel_left₀]

name: isClosed_setOfPred_tendsto_birkhoffAverage
proof:
:=
  (uniformEquicontinuous_birkhoffAverage 𝕜 hf hg).equicontinuous.isClosed_setOfPred_tendsto hl

name: smul_eq_self_of_preimage_zpow_eq_self
statement:
@[to_additive
      /
      under preimage for the map `x ↦ n • x`. Then `s` is invariant under the pointwise action of
      the additive subgroup of elements `g : G` such that `(n^j) • g = 0` for some `j : ℕ`.
      (This additive subgroup is called the Prüfer subgroup when `G` is the `AddCircle` and `n` is
      prime.) -/]
theorem smul_eq_self_of_preimage_zpow_eq_self {G : Type*} [CommGroup G] {n : ℤ} {s : Set G}
    (hs : (fun x => x ^ n) ⁻¹' s = s) {g : G} {j : ℕ} (hg : g ^ n ^ j = 1) : g • s = s
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ {g' : G} (_ : g' ^ n ^ j = 1), g' • s ⊆ s by
    refine le_antisymm (this hg) ?_
    conv_lhs => rw [← smul_inv_smul g s]
    replace hg : g⁻¹ ^ n ^ j = 1 := by rw [inv_zpow, hg, inv_one]
    simp only [smul_set_subset_smul_set_iff, this hg]
  rw [(IsFixedPt.preimage_iterate hs j : (zpowGroupHom n)^[j] ⁻¹' s = s).symm]
  rintro g' hg' - ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  change (zpowGroupHom n)^[j] (g' * y) ∈ s
  replace hg' : (zpowGroupHom n)^[j] g' = 1 := by simpa [zpowGroupHom]
  rwa [iterate_map_mul, hg', one_mul]

name: isFixedPt_of_tendsto_iterate
statement:
theorem isFixedPt_of_tendsto_iterate {x y : α} (hy : Tendsto (fun n => f^[n] x) atTop (𝓝 y))
    (hf : ContinuousAt f y) : IsFixedPt f y
proof:
:= by
  refine tendsto_nhds_unique ((tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat 1).1 ?_) hy
  simp only [iterate_succ' f]
  exact hf.tendsto.comp hy

name: isClosed_fixedPoints

name: comp
statement: protected theorem comp (hf : IsFixedPt f x) (hg : IsFixedPt g x) : IsFixedPt (f ∘ g) x
proof:
:=
  calc
    f (g x) = f x := congr_arg f hg
    _ = x := hf

name: iterate
statement: protected theorem iterate (hf : IsFixedPt f x) (n : ℕ) : IsFixedPt f^[n] x
proof:
:=
  iterate_fixed hf n

name: left_of_comp
statement: theorem left_of_comp (hfg : IsFixedPt (f ∘ g) x) (hg : IsFixedPt g x) : IsFixedPt f x
proof:
:=
  calc
    f x = f (g x) := congr_arg f hg.symm
    _ = x := hfg

:=

    _ = x := h x

name: map
statement:
protected theorem map {x : α} (hx : IsFixedPt fa x) {g : α → β} (h : Semiconj g fa fb) :
    IsFixedPt fb (g x)
proof:
:=
  calc
    fb (g x) = g (fa x) := (h.eq x).symm
    _ = g x := congr_arg g hx

name: preimage_iterate

theorem preimage_iterate {s : Set α} (h : IsFixedPt (Set.preimage f) s) (n : ℕ) :

lemma image_iterate {s : Set α} (h : IsFixedPt (Set.image f) s) (n : ℕ) :

:=
  Set.image_iterate_eq ▸ h.iterate n

name: equiv_symm
statement: protected theorem equiv_symm (h : IsFixedPt e x) : IsFixedPt e.symm x

:=
  h.to_leftInverse e.leftInverse_symm

name: equiv_symm_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equiv_symm_iff : IsFixedPt e.symm x ↔ IsFixedPt e x
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ e.symm_symm ▸ h.equiv_symm, .equiv_symm⟩

name: perm_inv
statement: protected theorem perm_inv (h : IsFixedPt e x) : IsFixedPt (⇑e⁻¹) x
proof:

  h.equiv_symm

name: perm_pow
statement: protected theorem perm_pow (h : IsFixedPt e x) (n : ℕ) : IsFixedPt (⇑(e ^ n)) x

name: perm_zpow
statement:
protected theorem perm_zpow (h : IsFixedPt e x) : ∀ n : ℤ, IsFixedPt (⇑(e ^ n)) x
  | Int.ofNat _ => h.perm_pow _
  | Int.negSucc n => (h.perm_pow <| n + 1).perm_inv

name: _root_.Measurable.measurePreserving

protected theorem _root_.Measurable.measurePreserving
