name: of_isEmpty
statement:
@[nontriviality]
theorem of_isEmpty [IsEmpty β] (f : α → β) (μa : Measure α) (μb : Measure β) :
    MeasurePreserving f μa μb
proof:
:=
  ⟨measurable_of_subsingleton_codomain _, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩

name: symm
statement:
theorem symm (e : α ≃ᵐ β) {μa : Measure α} {μb : Measure β} (h : MeasurePreserving e μa μb) :
    MeasurePreserving e.symm μb μa
proof:
:=
  ⟨e.symm.measurable, by
    rw [← h.map_eq, map_map e.symm.measurable e.measurable, e.symm_comp_self, map_id]⟩

name: restrict_preimage
statement:
theorem restrict_preimage {f : α → β} (hf : MeasurePreserving f μa μb) {s : Set β}
    (hs : MeasurableSet s) : MeasurePreserving f (μa.restrict (f ⁻¹' s)) (μb.restrict s)
proof:
:=
  ⟨hf.measurable, by rw [← hf.map_eq, restrict_map hf.measurable hs]⟩

name: restrict_preimage_emb
statement:
theorem restrict_preimage_emb {f : α → β} (hf : MeasurePreserving f μa μb)
    (h₂ : MeasurableEmbedding f) (s : Set β) :
    MeasurePreserving f (μa.restrict (f ⁻¹' s)) (μb.restrict s)
proof:
:=
  ⟨hf.measurable, by rw [← hf.map_eq, h₂.restrict_map]⟩

name: restrict_image_emb
statement:
theorem restrict_image_emb {f : α → β} (hf : MeasurePreserving f μa μb) (h₂ : MeasurableEmbedding f)
    (s : Set α) : MeasurePreserving f (μa.restrict s) (μb.restrict (f '' s))
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Set.preimage_image_eq _ h₂.injective] using hf.restrict_preimage_emb h₂ (f '' s)

name: aemeasurable_comp_iff
statement:
theorem aemeasurable_comp_iff {f : α → β} (hf : MeasurePreserving f μa μb)
    (h₂ : MeasurableEmbedding f) {g : β → γ} : AEMeasurable (g ∘ f) μa ↔ AEMeasurable g μb
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hf.map_eq, h₂.aemeasurable_map_iff]

name: quasiMeasurePreserving
statement:
protected theorem quasiMeasurePreserving {f : α → β} (hf : MeasurePreserving f μa μb) :
    QuasiMeasurePreserving f μa μb
proof:
:=
  ⟨hf.1, hf.2.absolutelyContinuous⟩

name: comp
statement:
protected theorem comp {g : β → γ} {f : α → β} (hg : MeasurePreserving g μb μc)
    (hf : MeasurePreserving f μa μb) : MeasurePreserving (g ∘ f) μa μc
proof:
:=
  ⟨hg.1.comp hf.1, by rw [← map_map hg.1 hf.1, hf.2, hg.2]⟩

name: map_of_comp
statement:
protected theorem map_of_comp {f : α → β} {g : β → γ} (hgf : MeasurePreserving (g ∘ f) μa μc)
    (hg : Measurable g) (hf : Measurable f) :
    MeasurePreserving g (μa.map f) μc
proof:
:=
  ⟨hg, (map_map hg hf).trans hgf.map_eq⟩

name: of_semiconj
proof:
:= by
  have := hf.comp_eq ▸ hfm.comp hga |>.map_of_comp hgb hfm.measurable
  rwa [hfm.map_eq] at this

name: trans
proof:
:=
  h'.comp h

name: comp_left_iff
statement:
protected theorem comp_left_iff {g : α → β} {e : β ≃ᵐ γ} (h : MeasurePreserving e μb μc) :
    MeasurePreserving (e ∘ g) μa μc ↔ MeasurePreserving g μa μb
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hg => ?_, fun hg => h.comp hg⟩
  convert! (MeasurePreserving.symm e h).comp hg
  simp [← Function.comp_assoc e.symm e g]

name: comp_right_iff
statement:
protected theorem comp_right_iff {g : α → β} {e : γ ≃ᵐ α} (h : MeasurePreserving e μc μa) :
    MeasurePreserving (g ∘ e) μc μb ↔ MeasurePreserving g μa μb
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hg => ?_, fun hg => hg.comp h⟩
  convert! hg.comp (MeasurePreserving.symm e h)
  simp [Function.comp_assoc g e e.symm]

name: sigmaFinite
statement:
protected theorem sigmaFinite {f : α → β} (hf : MeasurePreserving f μa μb) [SigmaFinite μb] :
    SigmaFinite μa
proof:
:=
  SigmaFinite.of_map μa hf.aemeasurable (by rwa [hf.map_eq])

name: sfinite
statement:
protected theorem sfinite {f : α → β} (hf : MeasurePreserving f μa μb) [SFinite μa] :
    SFinite μb
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hf.map_eq]
  infer_instance

name: measure_preimage
statement:
theorem measure_preimage {f : α → β} (hf : MeasurePreserving f μa μb) {s : Set β}
    (hs : NullMeasurableSet s μb) : μa (f ⁻¹' s) = μb s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hf.map_eq] at hs ⊢
  rw [map_apply₀ hf.1.aemeasurable hs]

name: measureReal_preimage
statement:
theorem measureReal_preimage {f : α → β} (hf : MeasurePreserving f μa μb) {s : Set β}
    (hs : NullMeasurableSet s μb) : μa.real (f ⁻¹' s) = μb.real s
proof:
:= by
  simp [measureReal_def, measure_preimage hf hs]

name: measure_preimage_emb
statement:
theorem measure_preimage_emb {f : α → β} (hf : MeasurePreserving f μa μb)
    (hfe : MeasurableEmbedding f) (s : Set β) : μa (f ⁻¹' s) = μb s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hf.map_eq, hfe.map_apply]

name: measure_preimage_equiv
statement:
theorem measure_preimage_equiv {f : α ≃ᵐ β} (hf : MeasurePreserving f μa μb) (s : Set β) :
    μa (f ⁻¹' s) = μb s
proof:
:=
  measure_preimage_emb hf f.measurableEmbedding s

name: measure_preimage_le
statement:
theorem measure_preimage_le {f : α → β} (hf : MeasurePreserving f μa μb) (s : Set β) :
    μa (f ⁻¹' s) ≤ μb s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hf.map_eq]
  exact le_map_apply hf.aemeasurable _

name: preimage_null
statement:
theorem preimage_null {f : α → β} (hf : MeasurePreserving f μa μb) {s : Set β}
    (hs : μb s = 0) : μa (f ⁻¹' s) = 0
proof:
:=
  hf.quasiMeasurePreserving.preimage_null hs

name: aeconst_comp
statement:
theorem aeconst_comp [MeasurableSingletonClass γ] {f : α → β} (hf : MeasurePreserving f μa μb)
    {g : β → γ} (hg : NullMeasurable g μb) :
    Filter.EventuallyConst (g ∘ f) (ae μa) ↔ Filter.EventuallyConst g (ae μb)
proof:
:=
  exists_congr fun s ↦ and_congr_left fun hs ↦ by
    simp only [Filter.mem_map, mem_ae_iff, ← hf.measure_preimage (hg hs.measurableSet).compl,
      preimage_comp, preimage_compl]

name: aeconst_preimage
proof:
:=
  aeconst_comp hf hs.mem

name: add_measure
statement:
theorem add_measure {f μa' μb'} (hf : MeasurePreserving f μa μb)
    (hf' : MeasurePreserving f μa' μb') : MeasurePreserving f (μa + μa') (μb + μb') where
  measurable
proof:
:= hf.measurable
  map_eq := by rw [Measure.map_add _ _ hf.measurable, hf.map_eq, hf'.map_eq]

name: smul_measure
proof:
:= hf.measurable
  map_eq := by rw [Measure.map_smul _ hf.aemeasurable, hf.map_eq]

name: iterate
statement:
protected theorem iterate (hf : MeasurePreserving f μ μ) :
    ∀ n, MeasurePreserving f^[n] μ μ
  | 0 => .id μ
  | n + 1 => (MeasurePreserving.iterate hf n).comp hf

open scoped symmDiff in

name: measure_symmDiff_preimage_iterate_le
statement:
lemma measure_symmDiff_preimage_iterate_le
    (hf : MeasurePreserving f μ μ) (hs : NullMeasurableSet s μ) (n : ℕ) :
    μ (s ∆ (f^[n] ⁻¹' s)) ≤ n • μ (s ∆ (f ⁻¹' s))
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [add_smul, one_smul]
    grw [← ih, measure_symmDiff_le s (f^[n] ⁻¹' s) (f^[n + 1] ⁻¹' s)]
    replace hs : NullMeasurableSet (s ∆ (f ⁻¹' s)) μ :=
      hs.symmDiff <| hs.preimage hf.quasiMeasurePreserving
    rw [iterate_succ', preimage_comp, ← preimage_symmDiff, (hf.iterate n).measure_preimage hs]

name: exists_mem_iterate_mem_of_measure_univ_lt_mul_measure
statement:
theorem exists_mem_iterate_mem_of_measure_univ_lt_mul_measure (hf : MeasurePreserving f μ μ)
    (hs : NullMeasurableSet s μ) {n : ℕ} (hvol : μ (Set.univ : Set α) < n * μ s) :
    ∃ x ∈ s, ∃ m ∈ Set.Ioo 0 n, f^[m] x ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  have A : ∀ m, NullMeasurableSet (f^[m] ⁻¹' s) μ := fun m ↦
    hs.preimage (hf.iterate m).quasiMeasurePreserving
  have B : ∀ m, μ (f^[m] ⁻¹' s) = μ s := fun m ↦ (hf.iterate m).measure_preimage hs
  have : μ (univ : Set α) < ∑ m ∈ Finset.range n, μ (f^[m] ⁻¹' s) := by simpa [B]
  obtain ⟨i, hi, j, hj, hij, x, hxi : f^[i] x ∈ s, hxj : f^[j] x ∈ s⟩ :
      ∃ i < n, ∃ j < n, i ≠ j ∧ (f^[i] ⁻¹' s ∩ f^[j] ⁻¹' s).Nonempty := by
    simpa using exists_nonempty_inter_of_measure_univ_lt_sum_measure μ (fun m _ ↦ A m) this
  wlog hlt : i < j generalizing i j
  · exact this j hj i hi hij.symm hxj hxi (hij.lt_or_gt.resolve_left hlt)
  refine ⟨f^[i] x, hxi, j - i, ⟨tsub_pos_of_lt hlt, lt_of_le_of_lt (j.sub_le i) hj⟩, ?_⟩
  rwa [← iterate_add_apply, tsub_add_cancel_of_le hlt.le]

name: exists_mem_iterate_mem
statement:
theorem exists_mem_iterate_mem [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hf : MeasurePreserving f μ μ)
    (hs : NullMeasurableSet s μ) (hs' : μ s ≠ 0) : ∃ x ∈ s, ∃ m ≠ 0, f^[m] x ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  rcases ENNReal.exists_nat_mul_gt hs' (measure_ne_top μ (Set.univ : Set α)) with ⟨N, hN⟩
  rcases hf.exists_mem_iterate_mem_of_measure_univ_lt_mul_measure hs hN with ⟨x, hx, m, hm, hmx⟩
  exact ⟨x, hx, m, hm.1.ne', hmx⟩

name: measurePreserving_subtype_coe
statement:
lemma measurePreserving_subtype_coe {s : Set α} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    MeasurePreserving (Subtype.val : s → α) (μa.comap Subtype.val) (μa.restrict s) where
  measurable
proof:
:= measurable_subtype_coe
  map_eq := map_comap_subtype_coe hs _

name: measurePreserving_symm
statement:
theorem measurePreserving_symm (μ : Measure α) (e : α ≃ᵐ β) :
    MeasurePreserving e.symm (map e μ) μ
proof:
:=
  (e.measurable.measurePreserving μ).symm _

name: ae_empty_or_univ_of_forall_vadd_ae_eq_self
proof:
:= by
  /- Sketch of proof:
    Assume `T = 1` for simplicity and let `μ` be the Haar measure. We may assume `s` has positive
    measure since otherwise there is nothing to prove. In this case, by Lebesgue's density theorem,
    there exists a point `d` of positive density. Let `Iⱼ` be the sequence of closed balls about `d`
    of diameter `1 / nⱼ` where `nⱼ` is the additive order of `uⱼ`. Since `d` has positive density we
    must have `μ (s ∩ Iⱼ) / μ Iⱼ → 1` along `l`. However since `s` is invariant under the action of
    `uⱼ` and since `Iⱼ` is a fundamental domain for this action, we must have
    `μ (s ∩ Iⱼ) = nⱼ * μ s = (μ Iⱼ) * μ s`. We thus have `μ s → 1` and thus `μ s = 1`. -/
  set μ := (volume : Measure <| AddCircle T)
  set n : ι → ℕ := addOrderOf ∘ u
  have hT₀ : 0 < T := hT.out
  have hT₁ : ENNReal.ofReal T ≠ 0 := by simpa
  rw [ae_eq_empty, ae_eq_univ_iff_measure_eq hs, AddCircle.measure_univ]
  rcases eq_or_ne (μ s) 0 with h | h; · exact Or.inl h
  right
  obtain ⟨d, -, hd⟩ : ∃ d, d ∈ s ∧ ∀ {ι'} {l : Filter ι'} (w : ι' → AddCircle T) (δ : ι' → ℝ),
    Tendsto δ l (𝓝[>] 0) → (∀ᶠ j in l, d ∈ closedBall (w j) (1 * δ j)) →
      Tendsto (fun j => μ (s ∩ closedBall (w j) (δ j)) / μ (closedBall (w j) (δ j))) l (𝓝 1) :=
    exists_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_ae h
      (IsUnifLocDoublingMeasure.ae_tendsto_measure_inter_div μ s 1)
  let I : ι → Set (AddCircle T) := fun j => closedBall d (T / (2 * ↑(n j)))
  replace hd : Tendsto (fun j => μ (s ∩ I j) / μ (I j)) l (𝓝 1) := by
    let δ : ι → ℝ := fun j => T / (2 * ↑(n j))
    have hδ₀ : ∀ᶠ j in l, 0 < δ j :=
      (hu₂.eventually_gt_atTop 0).mono fun j hj => div_pos hT₀ <| by positivity
    have hδ₁ : Tendsto δ l (𝓝[>] 0) := by
      refine tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨?_, hδ₀⟩
      replace hu₂ : Tendsto (fun j => T⁻¹ * 2 * n j) l atTop :=
        (tendsto_natCast_atTop_iff.mpr hu₂).const_mul_atTop (by positivity : 0 < T⁻¹ * 2)
      convert! hu₂.inv_tendsto_atTop
      ext j
      simp only [δ, Pi.inv_apply, mul_inv_rev, inv_inv, div_eq_inv_mul, ← mul_assoc]
    have hw : ∀ᶠ j in l, d ∈ closedBall d (1 * δ j) := hδ₀.mono fun j hj => by
      simp only [one_mul, mem_closedBall, dist_self]
      apply hj.le
    exact hd _ δ hδ₁ hw
  suffices ∀ᶠ j in l, μ (s ∩ I j) / μ (I j) = μ s / ENNReal.ofReal T by
    replace hd := hd.congr' this
    rwa [tendsto_const_nhds_iff, ENNReal.div_eq_one_iff hT₁ ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top] at hd
  refine (hu₂.eventually_gt_atTop 0).mono fun j hj => ?_
  have : addOrderOf (u j) = n j := rfl
  have huj : IsOfFinAddOrder (u j) := addOrderOf_pos_iff.mp hj
  have huj' : 1 ≤ (↑(n j) : ℝ) := by norm_cast
  have hI₀ : μ (I j) ≠ 0 := (measure_closedBall_pos _ d <| by positivity).ne.symm
  have hI₁ : μ (I j) ≠ ⊤ := measure_ne_top _ _
  have hI₂ : μ (I j) * ↑(n j) = ENNReal.ofReal T := by
    rw [volume_closedBall, mul_div, mul_div_mul_left T _ two_ne_zero,
      min_eq_right (div_le_self hT₀.le huj'), mul_comm, ← nsmul_eq_mul, ← ENNReal.ofReal_nsmul,
      nsmul_eq_mul, mul_div_cancel₀]
    exact Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hj.ne'
  rw [ENNReal.div_eq_div_iff hT₁ ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hI₀ hI₁,
    volume_of_add_preimage_eq s _ (u j) d huj (hu₁ j) closedBall_ae_eq_ball, nsmul_eq_mul, ←
    mul_assoc, this, hI₂]

name: ergodic_zsmul
statement: theorem ergodic_zsmul {n : ℤ} (hn : 1 < |n|) : Ergodic fun y : AddCircle T => n • y
proof:
:=
  { measurePreserving_zsmul volume (abs_pos.mp <| lt_trans zero_lt_one hn) with
    aeconst_set := fun s hs hs' => by
      let u : ℕ → AddCircle T := fun j => ↑((↑1 : ℝ) / ↑(n.natAbs ^ j) * T)
      replace hn : 1 < n.natAbs := by rwa [Int.abs_eq_natAbs, Nat.one_lt_cast] at hn
      have hu₀ : ∀ j, addOrderOf (u j) = n.natAbs ^ j := fun j => by
        convert!
          addOrderOf_div_of_gcd_eq_one (p := T) (m := 1) (pow_pos (pos_of_gt hn) j) (gcd_one_left _)
        norm_cast
      have hnu : ∀ j, n ^ j • u j = 0 := fun j => by
        rw [← addOrderOf_dvd_iff_zsmul_eq_zero, hu₀, Int.natCast_pow, Int.natCast_natAbs, ← abs_pow,
          abs_dvd]
      have hu₁ : ∀ j, (u j +ᵥ s : Set _) =ᵐ[volume] s := fun j =>
        (vadd_eq_self_of_preimage_zsmul_eq_self hs' (hnu j)).eventuallyEq
      have hu₂ : Tendsto (fun j => addOrderOf <| u j) atTop atTop := by
        simp_rw [hu₀]; exact tendsto_pow_atTop_atTop_of_one_lt hn
      rw [eventuallyEmptyOrUniv_iff']
      exact ae_empty_or_univ_of_forall_vadd_ae_eq_self hs.nullMeasurableSet hu₁ hu₂ }

name: ergodic_nsmul
statement: theorem ergodic_nsmul {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 < n) : Ergodic fun y : AddCircle T => n • y
proof:
:=
  ergodic_zsmul (by simp [hn] : 1 < |(n : ℤ)|)

name: ergodic_zsmul_add
statement: theorem ergodic_zsmul_add (x : AddCircle T) {n : ℤ} (h : 1 < |n|) : Ergodic fun y => n • y + x
proof:
:= by
  set f : AddCircle T → AddCircle T := fun y => n • y + x
  let e : AddCircle T ≃ᵐ AddCircle T := MeasurableEquiv.addLeft (DivisibleBy.div x <| n - 1)
  have he : MeasurePreserving e volume volume :=
    measurePreserving_add_left volume (DivisibleBy.div x <| n - 1)
  suffices e ∘ f ∘ e.symm = fun y => n • y by
    rw [← he.ergodic_conjugate_iff, this]; exact ergodic_zsmul h
  replace h : n - 1 ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← abs_one] at h; rw [sub_ne_zero]; exact ne_of_apply_ne _ (ne_of_gt h)
  have hnx : n • DivisibleBy.div x (n - 1) = x + DivisibleBy.div x (n - 1) := by
    conv_rhs => congr; rw [← DivisibleBy.div_cancel x h]
    rw [sub_smul, one_smul, sub_add_cancel]
  ext y
  simp only [f, e, hnx, MeasurableEquiv.coe_addLeft, MeasurableEquiv.symm_addLeft, comp_apply,
    smul_add, zsmul_neg', neg_smul, neg_add_rev]
  abel

name: ergodic_nsmul_add
statement: theorem ergodic_nsmul_add (x : AddCircle T) {n : ℕ} (h : 1 < n) : Ergodic fun y => n • y + x
proof:
:=
  ergodic_zsmul_add x (by simp [h] : 1 < |(n : ℤ)|)

name: of_mem_extremePoints_measure_univ_eq
statement:
theorem of_mem_extremePoints_measure_univ_eq {c : ℝ≥0∞} (hc : c ≠ ∞)
    (h : μ ∈ extremePoints ℝ≥0∞ {ν | MeasurePreserving f ν ν ∧ ν univ = c}) : Ergodic f μ
proof:
:= by
  have hf : MeasurePreserving f μ μ := h.1.1
  rcases eq_or_ne c 0 with rfl | hc₀
  · convert! zero_measure hf.measurable
    rw [← measure_univ_eq_zero, h.1.2]
  · refine ⟨hf, ⟨?_⟩⟩
    have : IsFiniteMeasure μ := by
      constructor
      rwa [h.1.2, lt_top_iff_ne_top]
    set S := {ν | MeasurePreserving f ν ν ∧ ν univ = c}
    have {s : Set X} (hsm : MeasurableSet s) (hfs : f ⁻¹' s = s) (hμs : μ s ≠ 0) :
        c • μ[|s] ∈ S := by
      refine ⟨.smul_measure (.smul_measure ?_ _) c, ?_⟩
      · convert! hf.restrict_preimage hsm
        exact hfs.symm
      · rw [Measure.smul_apply, (cond_isProbabilityMeasure hμs).1, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    intro s hsm hfs
    by_contra H
    obtain ⟨hs, hs'⟩ : μ s ≠ 0 ∧ μ sᶜ ≠ 0 := by
      simpa [eventuallyEmptyOrUniv_iff, ae_iff, and_comm] using! H
    have hcond : c • μ[|s] = μ := by
      apply h.2 (this hsm hfs hs) (this hsm.compl (by rw [preimage_compl, hfs]) hs')
      refine ⟨μ s / c, μ sᶜ / c, ENNReal.div_pos hs hc, ENNReal.div_pos hs' hc, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [← ENNReal.add_div, measure_add_measure_compl hsm, h.1.2, ENNReal.div_self hc₀ hc]
      · simp [ProbabilityTheory.cond, smul_smul, ← mul_assoc, ENNReal.div_mul_cancel,
          ENNReal.mul_inv_cancel, *]
    rw [← hcond] at hs'
    simp [ProbabilityTheory.cond_apply, hsm] at hs'

name: of_mem_extremePoints
statement:
theorem of_mem_extremePoints
    (h : μ ∈ extremePoints ℝ≥0∞ {ν | MeasurePreserving f ν ν ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure ν}) :
    Ergodic f μ
proof:
:=
  .of_mem_extremePoints_measure_univ_eq ENNReal.one_ne_top <| by
    simpa only [isProbabilityMeasure_iff] using h

name: eq_smul_of_absolutelyContinuous
statement:
theorem eq_smul_of_absolutelyContinuous [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hμ : Ergodic f μ)
    (hfν : MeasurePreserving f ν ν) (hνμ : ν ≪ μ) : ∃ c : ℝ≥0∞, ν = c • μ
proof:
:= by
  have := hfν.rnDeriv_comp_aeEq hμ.toMeasurePreserving
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hμ.ae_eq_const_of_ae_eq_comp₀ (measurable_rnDeriv _ _).nullMeasurable this
  use c
  ext s hs
  calc
    ν s = ∫⁻ a in s, ν.rnDeriv μ a ∂μ := .symm <| setLIntegral_rnDeriv hνμ _
    _ = ∫⁻ _ in s, c ∂μ := lintegral_congr_ae <| hc.filter_mono <| ae_mono restrict_le_self
    _ = (c • μ) s := by simp

name: eq_of_absolutelyContinuous_measure_univ_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_absolutelyContinuous_measure_univ_eq [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hμ : Ergodic f μ) (hfν : MeasurePreserving f ν ν) (hνμ : ν ≪ μ) (huniv : ν univ = μ univ) :
    ν = μ
proof:
:= by
  rcases hμ.eq_smul_of_absolutelyContinuous hfν hνμ with ⟨c, rfl⟩
  rcases eq_or_ne μ 0 with rfl | hμ₀
  · simp
  · simp_all [ENNReal.mul_eq_right]

name: eq_of_absolutelyContinuous
statement:
theorem eq_of_absolutelyContinuous [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hμ : Ergodic f μ) (hfν : MeasurePreserving f ν ν) (hνμ : ν ≪ μ) : ν = μ
proof:
:=
  eq_of_absolutelyContinuous_measure_univ_eq hμ hfν hνμ <| by simp

name: mem_extremePoints_measure_univ_eq
statement:
theorem mem_extremePoints_measure_univ_eq [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hμ : Ergodic f μ) :
    μ ∈ extremePoints ℝ≥0∞ {ν | MeasurePreserving f ν ν ∧ ν univ = μ univ}
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_extremePoints_iff_left]
  refine ⟨⟨hμ.toMeasurePreserving, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro ν₁ ⟨hfν₁, hν₁μ⟩ ν₂ ⟨hfν₂, hν₂μ⟩ ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩
  have : IsFiniteMeasure ν₁ := ⟨by rw [hν₁μ]; apply measure_lt_top⟩
  apply hμ.eq_of_absolutelyContinuous_measure_univ_eq hfν₁ (.add_right _ _) hν₁μ
  apply absolutelyContinuous_smul ha.ne'

name: mem_extremePoints
statement:
theorem mem_extremePoints [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (hμ : Ergodic f μ) :
    μ ∈ extremePoints ℝ≥0∞ {ν | MeasurePreserving f ν ν ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure ν}
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [isProbabilityMeasure_iff, measure_univ] using hμ.mem_extremePoints_measure_univ_eq

name: iff_mem_extremePoints_measure_univ_eq
statement:
theorem iff_mem_extremePoints_measure_univ_eq [IsFiniteMeasure μ] :
    Ergodic f μ ↔ μ ∈ extremePoints ℝ≥0∞ {ν | MeasurePreserving f ν ν ∧ ν univ = μ univ}
proof:
:=
  ⟨mem_extremePoints_measure_univ_eq, of_mem_extremePoints_measure_univ_eq (measure_ne_top _ _)⟩

name: iff_mem_extremePoints
statement:
theorem iff_mem_extremePoints [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] :
    Ergodic f μ ↔ μ ∈ extremePoints ℝ≥0∞ {ν | MeasurePreserving f ν ν ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure ν}
proof:

  ⟨mem_extremePoints, of_mem_extremePoints⟩

name: singularPart
proof:
:= by
  rcases (μ.mutuallySingular_singularPart ν).symm with ⟨s, hsm, hνs, hμs⟩
  convert! hfμ.restrict_preimage hsm using 1
  · refine singularPart_eq_restrict ?_ (hfν.preimage_null hνs)
    rw [← mem_ae_iff, ← Filter.eventuallyEqSet_univ,
      ae_eq_univ_iff_measure_eq (hfμ.measurable hsm).nullMeasurableSet]
    calc
      μ.singularPart ν (f ⁻¹' s) = (ν.withDensity (μ.rnDeriv ν) + μ.singularPart ν) (f ⁻¹' s) := by
        rw [← hfν.measure_preimage hsm.nullMeasurableSet] at hνs
        rw [add_apply, withDensity_absolutelyContinuous _ _ hνs, zero_add]
      _ = (ν.withDensity (μ.rnDeriv ν) + μ.singularPart ν) s := by
        rw [rnDeriv_add_singularPart, hfμ.measure_preimage hsm.nullMeasurableSet]
      _ = μ.singularPart ν s := by
        rw [add_apply, withDensity_absolutelyContinuous _ _ hνs, zero_add]
      _ = μ.singularPart ν univ := by
        rw [← measure_add_measure_compl hsm, hμs, add_zero]
  · exact singularPart_eq_restrict hμs hνs

name: withDensity_rnDeriv
proof:
:= by
  use hfμ.measurable
  ext s hs
  rw [← ENNReal.add_left_inj (measure_ne_top (μ.singularPart ν) s), map_apply hfμ.measurable hs,
    ← add_apply, rnDeriv_add_singularPart,
    ← (hfμ.singularPart hfν).measure_preimage hs.nullMeasurableSet, ← add_apply,
    rnDeriv_add_singularPart, hfμ.measure_preimage hs.nullMeasurableSet]

name: rnDeriv_comp_aeEq
proof:
:= by
  wlog hμν : μ ≪ ν generalizing μ
  · specialize this (hfμ.withDensity_rnDeriv hfν) (withDensity_absolutelyContinuous _ _)
    refine .trans (.trans ?_ this) (rnDeriv_withDensity ν (measurable_rnDeriv μ ν))
    apply hfν.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae_eq_comp
    exact (rnDeriv_withDensity ν (measurable_rnDeriv μ ν)).symm
  refine .of_forall_eventually_lt_iff fun c ↦ ?_
  set s := {a | μ.rnDeriv ν a < c}
  have hsm : MeasurableSet s := measurable_rnDeriv _ _ measurableSet_Iio
  have hμ_sdiff : μ (f ⁻¹' s \ s) = μ (s \ f ⁻¹' s) :=
    measure_sdiff_symm (hfμ.measurable hsm).nullMeasurableSet hsm.nullMeasurableSet
      (hfμ.measure_preimage hsm.nullMeasurableSet) (by finiteness)
  have hν_sdiff : ν (f ⁻¹' s \ s) = ν (s \ f ⁻¹' s) :=
    measure_sdiff_symm (hfν.measurable hsm).nullMeasurableSet hsm.nullMeasurableSet
      (hfν.measure_preimage hsm.nullMeasurableSet) (by finiteness)
  suffices f ⁻¹' s =ᵐ[ν] s from this.mem_iff
  suffices ν (f ⁻¹' s \ s) = 0 from (ae_le_set.mpr this).antisymm (ae_le_set.mpr <| hν_sdiff ▸ this)
  contrapose! hμ_sdiff with h₀
  apply ne_of_gt
  calc
    μ (s \ f ⁻¹' s) = ∫⁻ a in s \ f ⁻¹' s, μ.rnDeriv ν a ∂ν := (setLIntegral_rnDeriv hμν _).symm
    _ < ∫⁻ _ in s \ f ⁻¹' s, c ∂ν := by
      apply setLIntegral_strict_mono (hsm.diff (hfμ.measurable hsm)) (hν_sdiff ▸ h₀)
        measurable_const
      · rw [setLIntegral_rnDeriv hμν]
        finiteness
      · exact .of_forall fun x hx ↦ hx.1
    _ = ∫⁻ _ in f ⁻¹' s \ s, c ∂ν := by simp [hν_sdiff]
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ a in f ⁻¹' s \ s, μ.rnDeriv ν a ∂ν :=
      setLIntegral_mono (by fun_prop) (fun x hx ↦ not_lt.mp hx.2)
    _ = μ (f ⁻¹' s \ s) := setLIntegral_rnDeriv hμν _

name: QuasiErgodic.ae_eq_const_of_ae_eq_comp_of_ae_range
statement:
theorem QuasiErgodic.ae_eq_const_of_ae_eq_comp_of_ae_range₀ [Nonempty X] [MeasurableSpace X]
    {s : Set X} [MeasurableSpace.CountablySeparated s] {f : α → α} {g : α → X}
    (h : QuasiErgodic f μ) (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, g x ∈ s) (hgm : NullMeasurable g μ)
    (hg_eq : g ∘ f =ᵐ[μ] g) :
    ∃ c, g =ᵐ[μ] const α c
proof:
:= by
  refine exists_eventuallyEq_const_of_eventually_mem_of_forall_separating MeasurableSet hs ?_
  refine fun U hU ↦ h.ae_mem_or_ae_notMem₀ (s := g ⁻¹' U) (hgm hU) ?_b
  refine (hg_eq.mono fun x hx ↦ ?_).set_eq
  rw [← preimage_comp, mem_preimage, mem_preimage, hx]

name: PreErgodic.ae_eq_const_of_ae_eq_comp
statement:
theorem PreErgodic.ae_eq_const_of_ae_eq_comp (h : PreErgodic f μ) (hgm : Measurable g)
    (hg_eq : g ∘ f = g) : ∃ c, g =ᵐ[μ] const α c
proof:
:=
  exists_eventuallyEq_const_of_forall_separating MeasurableSet fun U hU ↦
    h.ae_mem_or_ae_notMem (s := g ⁻¹' U) (hgm hU) <| by rw [← preimage_comp, hg_eq]

name: QuasiErgodic.ae_eq_const_of_ae_eq_comp
statement:
theorem QuasiErgodic.ae_eq_const_of_ae_eq_comp₀ (h : QuasiErgodic f μ) (hgm : NullMeasurable g μ)
    (hg_eq : g ∘ f =ᵐ[μ] g) : ∃ c, g =ᵐ[μ] const α c
proof:
:=
  h.ae_eq_const_of_ae_eq_comp_of_ae_range₀ (s := univ) univ_mem hgm hg_eq

name: Ergodic.ae_eq_const_of_ae_eq_comp
statement:
theorem Ergodic.ae_eq_const_of_ae_eq_comp₀ (h : Ergodic f μ) (hgm : NullMeasurable g μ)
    (hg_eq : g ∘ f =ᵐ[μ] g) : ∃ c, g =ᵐ[μ] const α c

name: ae_eq_const_of_ae_eq_comp_ae
statement:
theorem ae_eq_const_of_ae_eq_comp_ae {g : α → X} (h : QuasiErgodic f μ)
    (hgm : AEStronglyMeasurable g μ) (hg_eq : g ∘ f =ᵐ[μ] g) : ∃ c, g =ᵐ[μ] const α c
proof:
:= by
  borelize X
  rcases hgm.isSeparable_ae_range with ⟨t, ht, hgt⟩
  have := ht.secondCountableTopology
  exact h.ae_eq_const_of_ae_eq_comp_of_ae_range₀ hgt hgm.aemeasurable.nullMeasurable hg_eq

name: eq_const_of_compQuasiMeasurePreserving_eq
statement:
theorem eq_const_of_compQuasiMeasurePreserving_eq (h : QuasiErgodic f μ) {g : α →ₘ[μ] X}
    (hg_eq : g.compQuasiMeasurePreserving f h.1 = g) : ∃ c, g = .const α c
proof:
:=
  have : g ∘ f =ᵐ[μ] g := (g.coeFn_compQuasiMeasurePreserving h.1).symm.trans
    (hg_eq.symm ▸ .refl _ _)
  let ⟨c, hc⟩ := h.ae_eq_const_of_ae_eq_comp_ae g.aestronglyMeasurable this
  ⟨c, AEEqFun.ext <| hc.trans (AEEqFun.coeFn_const _ _).symm⟩

name: ae_eq_const_of_ae_eq_comp_ae
statement:
theorem ae_eq_const_of_ae_eq_comp_ae {g : α → X} (h : Ergodic f μ) (hgm : AEStronglyMeasurable g μ)

name: preErgodic_of_preErgodic_semiconj
statement:
theorem preErgodic_of_preErgodic_semiconj (hg : MeasurePreserving g μ μ') (hf : PreErgodic f μ)
    {f' : β → β} (h_comm : Semiconj g f f') : PreErgodic f' μ' where
  aeconst_set s hs₀ hs₁
proof:
:= by
    rw [← hg.aeconst_preimage hs₀.nullMeasurableSet]
    apply hf.aeconst_set (hg.measurable hs₀)
    rw [← preimage_comp, h_comm.comp_eq, preimage_comp, hs₁]

proof:
:=
  ⟨hg.of_semiconj hf.toMeasurePreserving h_comm hf',
   hg.preErgodic_of_preErgodic_semiconj hf.toPreErgodic h_comm⟩

name: preErgodic_conjugate_iff
statement:
theorem preErgodic_conjugate_iff {e : α ≃ᵐ β} (h : MeasurePreserving e μ μ') :
    PreErgodic (e ∘ f ∘ e.symm) μ' ↔ PreErgodic f μ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hf => preErgodic_of_preErgodic_semiconj (h.symm e) hf ?_,
      fun hf => preErgodic_of_preErgodic_semiconj h hf ?_⟩
  · simp [Semiconj]
  · simp [Semiconj]

name: ergodic_conjugate_iff
statement:
theorem ergodic_conjugate_iff {e : α ≃ᵐ β} (h : MeasurePreserving e μ μ') :
    Ergodic (e ∘ f ∘ e.symm) μ' ↔ Ergodic f μ
proof:
:= by
  have : MeasurePreserving (e ∘ f ∘ e.symm) μ' μ' ↔ MeasurePreserving f μ μ := by
    rw [h.comp_left_iff, (MeasurePreserving.symm e h).comp_right_iff]
  replace h : PreErgodic (e ∘ f ∘ e.symm) μ' ↔ PreErgodic f μ := h.preErgodic_conjugate_iff
  exact ⟨fun hf => { this.mp hf.toMeasurePreserving, h.mp hf.toPreErgodic with },
    fun hf => { this.mpr hf.toMeasurePreserving, h.mpr hf.toPreErgodic with }⟩

  let ⟨_t, h₀, h₁, h₂⟩ := hf.toQuasiMeasurePreserving.exists_preimage_eq_of_preimage_ae hsm hs

name: ae_empty_or_univ_of_preimage_ae_le'
statement:
theorem ae_empty_or_univ_of_preimage_ae_le' (hf : Ergodic f μ) (hs : NullMeasurableSet s μ)
    (hs' : f ⁻¹' s ≤ᵐ[μ] s) (h_fin : μ s ≠ ∞) : s =ᵐ[μ] ∅ ∨ s =ᵐ[μ] univ
proof:
:= by
  refine hf.quasiErgodic.ae_empty_or_univ₀ hs ?_
  refine ae_eq_of_ae_subset_of_measure_ge hs' (hf.measure_preimage hs).ge ?_ h_fin
  exact hs.preimage hf.quasiMeasurePreserving

name: ae_empty_or_univ_of_ae_le_preimage'

    (hs' : s ≤ᵐ[μ] f ⁻¹' s) (h_fin : μ s ≠ ∞) : s =ᵐ[μ] ∅ ∨ s =ᵐ[μ] univ
proof:
:= by
  replace h_fin : μ (f ⁻¹' s) ≠ ∞ := by rwa [hf.measure_preimage hs]
  refine hf.quasiErgodic.ae_empty_or_univ₀ hs ?_
  exact (ae_eq_of_ae_subset_of_measure_ge hs' (hf.measure_preimage hs).le hs h_fin).symm

theorem ae_empty_or_univ_of_image_ae_le' (hf : Ergodic f μ) (hs : NullMeasurableSet s μ)

proof:
:= by
  replace hs' : s ≤ᵐ[μ] f ⁻¹' s :=
    (subset_preimage_image f s).eventuallySubset.trans
      (hf.quasiMeasurePreserving.preimage_mono_ae hs')
  exact ae_empty_or_univ_of_ae_le_preimage' hf hs hs' h_fin

name: exists_mem_iterate_mem
statement:
theorem exists_mem_iterate_mem (hf : Conservative f μ)
    (hsm : NullMeasurableSet s μ) (hs₀ : μ s ≠ 0) :
    ∃ x ∈ s, ∃ m ≠ 0, f^[m] x ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  rcases hsm.exists_measurable_subset_ae_eq with ⟨t, hsub, htm, hts⟩
  rcases hf.exists_mem_iterate_mem' htm (by rwa [measure_congr hts]) with ⟨x, hxt, m, hm₀, hmt⟩
  exact ⟨x, hsub hxt, m, hm₀, hsub hmt⟩

name: frequently_measure_inter_ne_zero
statement:
theorem frequently_measure_inter_ne_zero (hf : Conservative f μ) (hs : NullMeasurableSet s μ)
    (h0 : μ s ≠ 0) : ∃ᶠ m in atTop, μ (s ∩ f^[m] ⁻¹' s) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  set t : ℕ → Set α := fun n ↦ s ∩ f^[n] ⁻¹' s
  
  by_contra H
  
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hmax⟩ : ∃ N, μ (t N) ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ n > N, μ (t n) = 0 := by
    rw [Nat.frequently_atTop_iff_infinite, not_infinite] at H
    convert! exists_max_image _ (·) H ⟨0, by simpa⟩ using 4
    rw [gt_iff_lt, ← not_le, not_imp_comm, mem_ofPred]
  have htm {n : ℕ} : NullMeasurableSet (t n) μ :=
    hs.inter <| hs.preimage <| hf.toQuasiMeasurePreserving.iterate n
  
  set T := t N \ ⋃ n > N, t n with hT
  have hμT : μ T ≠ 0 := by
    rwa [hT, measure_sdiff_null]
    exact (measure_biUnion_null_iff {n | N < n}.to_countable).2 hmax
  have hTm : NullMeasurableSet T μ := htm.diff <| .biUnion {n | N < n}.to_countable fun _ _ ↦ htm
  
  rcases hf.exists_mem_iterate_mem hTm hμT with ⟨x, hxt, m, hm₀, hmt⟩
  
  
  refine hxt.2 <| mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨N + m, ?_, hxt.1.1, ?_⟩
  · simpa [pos_iff_ne_zero]
  · simpa only [iterate_add] using! hmt.1.2

name: exists_gt_measure_inter_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_gt_measure_inter_ne_zero (hf : Conservative f μ) (hs : NullMeasurableSet s μ)
    (h0 : μ s ≠ 0) (N : ℕ) : ∃ m > N, μ (s ∩ f^[m] ⁻¹' s) ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  let ⟨m, hm, hmN⟩ :=
    ((hf.frequently_measure_inter_ne_zero hs h0).and_eventually (eventually_gt_atTop N)).exists
  ⟨m, hmN, hm⟩

name: measure_mem_forall_ge_image_notMem_eq_zero
statement:
theorem measure_mem_forall_ge_image_notMem_eq_zero (hf : Conservative f μ)
    (hs : NullMeasurableSet s μ) (n : ℕ) :
    μ ({ x ∈ s | ∀ m ≥ n, f^[m] x ∉ s }) = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra H
  have : NullMeasurableSet (s ∩ { x | ∀ m ≥ n, f^[m] x ∉ s }) μ := by
    simp only [ofPred_forall, ← compl_ofPred]
    exact hs.inter <| .biInter (to_countable _) fun m _ ↦
      (hs.preimage <| hf.toQuasiMeasurePreserving.iterate m).compl
  rcases (hf.exists_gt_measure_inter_ne_zero this H) n with ⟨m, hmn, hm⟩
  rcases nonempty_of_measure_ne_zero hm with ⟨x, ⟨_, hxn⟩, hxm, -⟩
  exact hxn m hmn.lt.le hxm

name: ae_mem_imp_frequently_image_mem
statement:
theorem ae_mem_imp_frequently_image_mem (hf : Conservative f μ) (hs : NullMeasurableSet s μ) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ s → ∃ᶠ n in atTop, f^[n] x ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  simp only [frequently_atTop, @forall_comm (_ ∈ s), ae_all_iff]
  intro n
  filter_upwards
    [measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.1 (hf.measure_mem_forall_ge_image_notMem_eq_zero hs n)]
  simp

name: inter_frequently_image_mem_ae_eq
statement:
theorem inter_frequently_image_mem_ae_eq (hf : Conservative f μ) (hs : NullMeasurableSet s μ) :
    s ∩ { x | ∃ᶠ n in atTop, f^[n] x ∈ s } =ᵐ[μ] s
proof:
:=
  inter_eventuallyEqSet_left.2 <| hf.ae_mem_imp_frequently_image_mem hs

name: measure_inter_frequently_image_mem_eq
statement:
theorem measure_inter_frequently_image_mem_eq (hf : Conservative f μ) (hs : NullMeasurableSet s μ) :
    μ (s ∩ { x | ∃ᶠ n in atTop, f^[n] x ∈ s }) = μ s
proof:
:=
  measure_congr (hf.inter_frequently_image_mem_ae_eq hs)

name: ae_forall_image_mem_imp_frequently_image_mem
statement:
theorem ae_forall_image_mem_imp_frequently_image_mem (hf : Conservative f μ)
    (hs : NullMeasurableSet s μ) : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ k, f^[k] x ∈ s → ∃ᶠ n in atTop, f^[n] x ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  refine ae_all_iff.2 fun k => ?_
  refine (hf.ae_mem_imp_frequently_image_mem
    (hs.preimage <| hf.toQuasiMeasurePreserving.iterate k)).mono fun x hx hk => ?_
  rw [← map_add_atTop_eq_nat k, frequently_map]
  refine (hx hk).mono fun n hn => ?_
  rwa [add_comm, iterate_add_apply]

name: frequently_ae_mem_and_frequently_image_mem
statement:
theorem frequently_ae_mem_and_frequently_image_mem (hf : Conservative f μ)
    (hs : NullMeasurableSet s μ) (h0 : μ s ≠ 0) : ∃ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ s ∧ ∃ᶠ n in atTop, f^[n] x ∈ s
proof:
:=
  ((frequently_ae_mem_iff.2 h0).and_eventually (hf.ae_mem_imp_frequently_image_mem hs)).mono
    fun _ hx => ⟨hx.1, hx.2 hx.1⟩

name: ae_frequently_mem_of_mem_nhds
statement:
theorem ae_frequently_mem_of_mem_nhds [TopologicalSpace α] [SecondCountableTopology α]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace α] {f : α → α} {μ : Measure α} (h : Conservative f μ) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ s ∈ 𝓝 x, ∃ᶠ n in atTop, f^[n] x ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  have : ∀ s ∈ countableBasis α, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ s → ∃ᶠ n in atTop, f^[n] x ∈ s := fun s hs =>
    h.ae_mem_imp_frequently_image_mem (isOpen_of_mem_countableBasis hs).nullMeasurableSet
  refine ((ae_ball_iff <| countable_countableBasis α).2 this).mono fun x hx s hs => ?_
  rcases (isBasis_countableBasis α).mem_nhds_iff.1 hs with ⟨o, hoS, hxo, hos⟩
  exact (hx o hoS hxo).mono fun n hn => hos hn

name: iterate
statement: protected theorem iterate (hf : Conservative f μ) (n : ℕ) : Conservative f^[n] μ
proof:
:= by
  
  rcases n with - | n
  · exact Conservative.id μ
  refine ⟨hf.1.iterate _, fun s hs hs0 => ?_⟩
  rcases (hf.frequently_ae_mem_and_frequently_image_mem hs.nullMeasurableSet hs0).exists
    with ⟨x, _, hx⟩
  /- We take a point `x ∈ s` such that `f^[k] x ∈ s` for infinitely many values of `k`,
    then we choose two of these values `k < l` such that `k ≡ l [MOD (n + 1)]`.
    Then `f^[k] x ∈ s` and `f^[n + 1]^[(l - k) / (n + 1)] (f^[k] x) = f^[l] x ∈ s`. -/
  rw [Nat.frequently_atTop_iff_infinite] at hx
  rcases Nat.exists_lt_modEq_of_infinite hx n.succ_pos with ⟨k, hk, l, hl, hkl, hn⟩
  set m := (l - k) / (n + 1)
  have : (n + 1) * m = l - k := by
    apply Nat.mul_div_cancel'
    exact (Nat.modEq_iff_dvd' hkl.le).1 hn
  refine ⟨f^[k] x, hk, m, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hm
    rw [hm, mul_zero, eq_comm, tsub_eq_zero_iff_le] at this
    exact this.not_gt hkl
  · rwa [← iterate_mul, this, ← iterate_add_apply, tsub_add_cancel_of_le]
    exact hkl.le

name: mulShift_apply
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)] lemma mulShift_apply (g : G) (x : G → A) (h : G) :
    mulShift g x h = x (g * h)
proof: := rfl

name: mulShift_one
statement: @[to_additive (attr := simp)] lemma mulShift_one (x : G → A) : mulShift (1 : G) x = x
proof:
:= by
  ext h; simp [mulShift]

name: mulShift_mul
statement:
lemma mulShift_mul (g₁ g₂ : G) (x : G → A) :
    mulShift (g₁ * g₂) x = mulShift g₂ (mulShift g₁ x)
proof:
:= by
  ext h; simp [mulShift, mul_assoc]

name: mem_cylinder
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := fun_prop)
/
lemma continuous_mulShift (g : G) :
    Continuous (mulShift (A := A) g) := by
  
  unfold mulShift
  fun_prop

end ShiftDefinition

/-! ## Cylinders -/

section Cylinders

variable {A G : Type*}

/
reference configuration `x` on a fixed finite subset `U` of the index set `G`.

The set `U` is called the *support* of the cylinder.

Intuitively, cylinders specify the "letters" on finitely many coordinates, while
leaving all other coordinates free. For example, in the full shift `{0, 1}^ℤ`,
the cylinder determined by `U = {0, 1}` and `x 0 = 1, x 1 = 0` consists of all
bi-infinite sequences of `0`s and `1`s whose entries on positions `0` and `1`
respectively are `1` and `0`.

When `A` has the discrete topology, cylinder sets form a basis of clopen sets
for the product topology on `G → A`. -/
def cylinder (U : Finset G) (x : G → A) : Set (G → A) :=
  { y | ∀ i ∈ U, y i = x i }

/
viewed as a subset of `G → A`. Equivalently, it is the preimage of that product
of singletons in `U → A` under the restriction map `(G → A) → (U → A)`. -/
lemma cylinder_eq_set_pi (U : Finset G) (x : G → A) :
    cylinder U x = Set.pi (↑U : Set G) (fun i => ({x i} : Set A)) := by
  ext y; simp [cylinder, Set.pi]

lemma mem_cylinder {U : Finset G} {x y : G → A} :
    y ∈ cylinder U x ↔ ∀ i ∈ U, y i = x i
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: isOpen_cylinder
statement:
lemma isOpen_cylinder [DiscreteTopology A] (U : Finset G) (x : G → A) :
    IsOpen (cylinder U x)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [cylinder_eq_set_pi U x] using isOpen_set_pi (U.finite_toSet) (by simp)

name: isClosed_cylinder
statement:
lemma isClosed_cylinder [T1Space A] (U : Finset G) (x : G → A) :
    IsClosed (cylinder U x)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [cylinder_eq_set_pi U x] using isClosed_set_pi (by simp)

name: mulShift_apply_mul_left_of_mem
statement:
lemma mulShift_apply_mul_left_of_mem
    (p : Pattern A G) (v w : G) (hw : w ∈ p.support) :
    p.mulShift v (v * w) = p.config w
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hmem : (v * w) ∈ p.support.image (v * ·) :=
    Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
  
  have ex : ∃ w', w' ∈ p.support ∧ v * w' = v * w := by
    simpa [Finset.mem_image] using hmem
  
  have h1 : p.mulShift v (v * w) = p.config (Classical.choose ex) := by
    simp [Pattern.mulShift, hmem]
  
  have hwv' : v * Classical.choose ex = v * w := (Classical.choose_spec ex).2
  have h_eq : Classical.choose ex = w := mul_left_cancel hwv'
  rw [h1, h_eq]

name: mulOccursInAt_mulShift
statement:
@[to_additive occursInAt_shift
/

Formally: a pattern `p` occurs in the shifted configuration `shift h x` at
position `g` if and only if it occurs in the original configuration `x` at
position `g + h`. -/]
lemma mulOccursInAt_mulShift {A G : Type*} [Inhabited A] [Monoid G]
    (p : Pattern A G) (x : G → A) (g h : G) :
    p.mulOccursInAt (mulShift g x) h ↔ p.mulOccursInAt x (g * h)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Pattern.mulOccursInAt, mulShift_apply, mul_assoc]

name: mapsTo_mulShift_mulForbidden
statement:
@[to_additive mapsTo_shift_forbidden
  /

Formally: if `x` avoids every `p ∈ F` at every position, then for any `h : G`,
the shifted configuration `shift h x` also avoids every `p ∈ F` at every position. -/]
lemma mapsTo_mulShift_mulForbidden {A G : Type*} [Inhabited A] [Monoid G]
    (F : Set (Pattern A G)) (h : G) :
    Set.MapsTo (mulShift h) (mulForbidden (A := A) (G := G) F) (mulForbidden F)
proof:
:= by
  
  intro x hx p hp g
  specialize hx p hp (h * g)
  contrapose! hx
  simpa [mulOccursInAt_mulShift] using hx

name: mulOccursInAt_eq_cylinder
statement:
lemma mulOccursInAt_eq_cylinder
    (p : Pattern A G) (g : G) :
    { x | p.mulOccursInAt x g } = cylinder (p.support.image (g * ·)) (p.mulShift g)
proof:
:= by
  ext x; constructor
  · 
    intro H u hu
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hu with ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    
    have hx : x (g * w) = p.config w := H w hw
    simpa [Pattern.mulShift_apply_mul_left_of_mem (p := p) (v := g) (w := w) hw] using hx
  · 
    intro H u hu
    
    have hx : x (g * u) = p.mulShift g (g * u) :=
      H (g * u) (Finset.mem_image_of_mem (g * ·) hu)
    
    simpa [Pattern.mulShift_apply_mul_left_of_mem (p := p) (v := g) (w := u) hu] using hx

name: isOpen_mulOccursInAt
statement:
lemma isOpen_mulOccursInAt [DiscreteTopology A] (p : Pattern A G) (g : G) :
    IsOpen { x | p.mulOccursInAt x g }
proof:
:= by
  simpa [mulOccursInAt_eq_cylinder] using isOpen_cylinder _ _

name: isClosed_mulForbidden
statement:
@[to_additive isClosed_forbidden /
condition (in the product topology on `G → A`).

Since each occurrence set `{ x | p.occursInAt x v }` is open (when `A` is discrete),
its complement `{ x | ¬ p.occursInAt x v }` is closed; `forbidden F` is the intersection
of these closed sets over `p ∈ F` and `v ∈ G`. -/]
lemma isClosed_mulForbidden [DiscreteTopology A] (F : Set (Pattern A G)) :
    IsClosed (mulForbidden F)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mulForbidden]
  
  have h_eq : {x | ∀ p ∈ F, ∀ v : G, ¬ p.mulOccursInAt x v}
    = ⋂ (p : Pattern A G) (hp : p ∈ F) (v : G), {x | ¬ p.mulOccursInAt x v} := by ext; simp
  rw [h_eq]
  
  refine isClosed_iInter (fun p => ?_)
  refine isClosed_iInter (fun hp => ?_)
  refine isClosed_iInter (fun v => ?_)
  
  have : {x | ¬ p.mulOccursInAt x v} = {x | p.mulOccursInAt x v}ᶜ := by ext; simp
  simpa [this, isClosed_compl_iff] using isOpen_mulOccursInAt (A := A) (G := G) p v

name: isClosed_mulOccursInAt
statement:
lemma isClosed_mulOccursInAt [T1Space A] (p : Pattern A G) (g : G) :
    IsClosed { x | p.mulOccursInAt x g }
proof:
:= by
  simpa [mulOccursInAt_eq_cylinder] using isClosed_cylinder _ _

name: finite_setOfPred_pattern_support_eq
statement:
lemma finite_setOfPred_pattern_support_eq
    {A G : Type*} [Finite A] [Inhabited A]
    (U : Finset G) :
    ({p : Pattern A G | p.support = U}).Finite
proof:
:= by
  
  cases nonempty_fintype A
  classical
  
  let e : { p : Pattern A G // p.support = U } ≃ (U → A) :=
  { toFun := fun p i => p.1.config i.1
    invFun := fun f => ⟨{ config := fun g => if h : g ∈ U then f ⟨g, h⟩ else default,
                           support := U,
                           condition := fun g hg => by simp [hg] }, rfl⟩
    left_inv := by
      rintro ⟨⟨cfg, dom, cond⟩, hU⟩
      simp only at hU; subst hU
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp only [Pattern.mk.injEq, and_true]
      funext g
      by_cases hg : g ∈ dom
      · simp [hg]
      · simp [hg, cond g hg]
    right_inv := fun f => by ext i; simp [i.2] }
  let : Fintype { p : Pattern A G | p.support = U } := Fintype.ofEquiv (U → A) e.symm
  apply toFinite

name: languageOn_mono
statement:
lemma languageOn_mono {X Y : Set (G → A)} (h : X ⊆ Y) (U : Finset G) :
    LanguageOn X U ⊆ LanguageOn Y U
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  rcases hp with ⟨x, hxX, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨x, h hxX, rfl⟩

name: languageOn_union
statement:
lemma languageOn_union {X Y : Set (G → A)} (U : Finset G) :
    LanguageOn (X ∪ Y) U = LanguageOn X U ∪ LanguageOn Y U
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  simp only [LanguageOn, mem_union, mem_ofPred_eq]
  grind

name: languageOn_inter_subset
statement:
lemma languageOn_inter_subset (X Y : Set (G → A)) (U : Finset G) :
    LanguageOn (X ∩ Y) U ⊆ LanguageOn X U ∩ LanguageOn Y U
proof:
:= by
  rintro p ⟨x, ⟨hxX, hxY⟩, hp⟩
  exact ⟨⟨x, hxX, hp⟩, ⟨x, hxY, hp⟩⟩

name: directed_ptsOfPeriod_pnat
statement: theorem directed_ptsOfPeriod_pnat (f : α → α) : Directed (· ⊆ ·) fun n : ℕ+ => ptsOfPeriod f n
proof:
:=
  fun m n => ⟨m * n, fun _ hx => hx.mul_const n, fun _ hx => hx.const_mul m⟩

name: bijOn_periodicPts
statement: theorem bijOn_periodicPts : BijOn f (periodicPts f) (periodicPts f)
proof:
:=
  iUnion_pnat_ptsOfPeriod f ▸
    bijOn_iUnion_of_directed (directed_ptsOfPeriod_pnat f) fun i => bijOn_ptsOfPeriod f i.pos

name: minimalPeriod_eq_prime_iff
statement:
theorem minimalPeriod_eq_prime_iff {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] :
    minimalPeriod f x = p ↔ IsPeriodicPt f p x ∧ ¬IsFixedPt f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Function.isPeriodicPt_iff_minimalPeriod_dvd, Nat.dvd_prime hp.out,
    ← minimalPeriod_eq_one_iff_isFixedPt.not, or_and_right, and_not_self_iff, false_or,
    iff_self_and]
  exact fun h ↦ ne_of_eq_of_ne h hp.out.ne_one

name: minimalPeriod_eq_sInf_n_pos_IsPeriodicPt
statement:
theorem minimalPeriod_eq_sInf_n_pos_IsPeriodicPt :
    minimalPeriod f x = sInf { n > 0 | IsPeriodicPt f n x }
proof:
:= by
  dsimp +instances [minimalPeriod, periodicPts, sInf]
  grind

name: minimalPeriod_eq_prime
statement:
theorem minimalPeriod_eq_prime {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hper : IsPeriodicPt f p x)
    (hfix : ¬IsFixedPt f x) : minimalPeriod f x = p
proof:
:=
  minimalPeriod_eq_prime_iff.mpr ⟨hper, hfix⟩

name: minimalPeriod_eq_prime_pow
statement:
theorem minimalPeriod_eq_prime_pow {p k : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hk : ¬IsPeriodicPt f (p ^ k) x)
    (hk1 : IsPeriodicPt f (p ^ (k + 1)) x) : minimalPeriod f x = p ^ (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.eq_prime_pow_of_dvd_least_prime_pow hp.out <;>
    rwa [← isPeriodicPt_iff_minimalPeriod_dvd]

name: Commute.minimalPeriod_of_comp_dvd_mul
statement:
theorem Commute.minimalPeriod_of_comp_dvd_mul {g : α → α} (h : Commute f g) :
    minimalPeriod (f ∘ g) x ∣ minimalPeriod f x * minimalPeriod g x
proof:
:=
  dvd_trans h.minimalPeriod_of_comp_dvd_lcm (Nat.lcm_dvd_mul _ _)

name: Commute.minimalPeriod_of_comp_eq_mul_of_coprime
statement:
theorem Commute.minimalPeriod_of_comp_eq_mul_of_coprime {g : α → α} (h : Commute f g)
    (hco : Coprime (minimalPeriod f x) (minimalPeriod g x)) :
    minimalPeriod (f ∘ g) x = minimalPeriod f x * minimalPeriod g x
proof:
:= by
  apply h.minimalPeriod_of_comp_dvd_mul.antisymm
  suffices ∀ {f g : α → α},
      Commute f g →
        Coprime (minimalPeriod f x) (minimalPeriod g x) →
          minimalPeriod f x ∣ minimalPeriod (f ∘ g) x from
    hco.mul_dvd_of_dvd_of_dvd (this h hco) (h.comp_eq.symm ▸ this h.symm hco.symm)
  intro f g h hco
  refine hco.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left (IsPeriodicPt.left_of_comp h ?_ ?_).minimalPeriod_dvd
  · exact (isPeriodicPt_minimalPeriod _ _).const_mul _
  · exact (isPeriodicPt_minimalPeriod _ _).mul_const _

name: minimalPeriod_le_card
statement: theorem minimalPeriod_le_card [Fintype α] : minimalPeriod f x ≤ card α
proof:
:= by
  rw [← periodicOrbit_length]
  exact List.Nodup.length_le_card nodup_periodicOrbit

name: isPeriodicPt_factorial_card_of_mem_periodicPts
statement:
theorem isPeriodicPt_factorial_card_of_mem_periodicPts [Fintype α] (h : x ∈ periodicPts f) :
    IsPeriodicPt f (card α)! x
proof:
:=
  isPeriodicPt_iff_minimalPeriod_dvd.mpr
    (Nat.dvd_factorial (minimalPeriod_pos_of_mem_periodicPts h) minimalPeriod_le_card)

name: mem_periodicPts_iff_isPeriodicPt_factorial_card
statement:
theorem mem_periodicPts_iff_isPeriodicPt_factorial_card [Fintype α] :
    x ∈ periodicPts f ↔ IsPeriodicPt f (card α)! x where
  mp
proof:
:= isPeriodicPt_factorial_card_of_mem_periodicPts
  mpr h := minimalPeriod_pos_iff_mem_periodicPts.mp
    (IsPeriodicPt.minimalPeriod_pos (Nat.factorial_pos _) h)

name: Injective.mem_periodicPts
statement: theorem Injective.mem_periodicPts [Finite α] (h : Injective f) (x : α) : x ∈ periodicPts f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, n, heq, hne⟩ : ∃ m n, f^[m] x = f^[n] x ∧ m ≠ n := by
    simpa [Injective] using not_injective_infinite_finite (f^[·] x)
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hlt
  · exact mk_mem_periodicPts (by lia) (iterate_cancel h heq.symm)
  · exact mk_mem_periodicPts (by lia) (iterate_cancel h heq)

name: injective_iff_periodicPts_eq_univ
statement: theorem injective_iff_periodicPts_eq_univ [Finite α] : Injective f ↔ periodicPts f = univ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ eq_univ_iff_forall.mpr h.mem_periodicPts, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [Finite.injective_iff_surjective, ← range_eq_univ, ← univ_subset_iff, ← h]
  apply periodicPts_subset_range

name: injective_iff_iterate_factorial_card_eq_id
statement:
theorem injective_iff_iterate_factorial_card_eq_id [Fintype α] :
    Injective f ↔ f^[(card α)!] = id
proof:
:= by
  simp only [injective_iff_periodicPts_eq_univ, mem_periodicPts_iff_isPeriodicPt_factorial_card,
    funext_iff, eq_univ_iff_forall, IsPeriodicPt, id, IsFixedPt]

name: minimalPeriod_prodMap
statement:
theorem minimalPeriod_prodMap (f : α → α) (g : β → β) (x : α × β) :
    minimalPeriod (Prod.map f g) x = (minimalPeriod f x.1).lcm (minimalPeriod g x.2)
proof:
:=
  eq_of_forall_dvd <| by simp [← isPeriodicPt_iff_minimalPeriod_dvd, Nat.lcm_dvd_iff]

name: minimalPeriod_fst_dvd
statement: theorem minimalPeriod_fst_dvd : minimalPeriod f x.1 ∣ minimalPeriod (Prod.map f g) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [minimalPeriod_prodMap]; exact Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _

name: minimalPeriod_snd_dvd
statement: theorem minimalPeriod_snd_dvd : minimalPeriod g x.2 ∣ minimalPeriod (Prod.map f g) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [minimalPeriod_prodMap]; exact Nat.dvd_lcm_right _ _

name: minimalPeriod_piMap
statement:
theorem minimalPeriod_piMap :
    minimalPeriod (Pi.map f) x = sInf { n > 0 | ∀ i, minimalPeriod (f i) (x i) ∣ n }
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => simp [minimalPeriod_eq_sInf_n_pos_IsPeriodicPt]
  simp [← isPeriodicPt_iff_minimalPeriod_dvd]

name: minimalPeriod_piMap_fintype
statement:
theorem minimalPeriod_piMap_fintype [Fintype ι] :
    minimalPeriod (Pi.map f) x = Finset.univ.lcm (fun i => minimalPeriod (f i) (x i))
proof:
:=
  eq_of_forall_dvd <| by simp [← isPeriodicPt_iff_minimalPeriod_dvd]

name: minimalPeriod_single_dvd_minimalPeriod_piMap
statement:
theorem minimalPeriod_single_dvd_minimalPeriod_piMap (i : ι) :
    minimalPeriod (f i) (x i) ∣ minimalPeriod (Pi.map f) x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [minimalPeriod_piMap]
  by_cases h : {n | 0 < n ∧ ∀ (i : ι), minimalPeriod (f i) (x i) ∣ n}.Nonempty
  · exact (Nat.sInf_mem h).2 i
  · simp [not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp h]

name: IsFixedPt.isPeriodicPt
statement: theorem IsFixedPt.isPeriodicPt (hf : IsFixedPt f x) (n : ℕ) : IsPeriodicPt f n x
proof:
:=
  hf.iterate n

name: is_periodic_id
statement: theorem is_periodic_id (n : ℕ) (x : α) : IsPeriodicPt id n x
proof:
:=
  (isFixedPt_id x).isPeriodicPt n

name: isPeriodicPt_zero
statement: theorem isPeriodicPt_zero (f : α → α) (x : α) : IsPeriodicPt f 0 x
proof:
:=
  isFixedPt_id x

name: of_subsingleton
statement:
@[nontriviality]
theorem of_subsingleton [Subsingleton α] (f : α → α) (n : ℕ) (x : α) : IsPeriodicPt f n x
proof:
:=
  IsFixedPt.of_subsingleton _ _

name: isFixedPt
statement: protected theorem isFixedPt (hf : IsPeriodicPt f n x) : IsFixedPt f^[n] x
proof:
:=
  hf

name: map
statement:
protected theorem map (hx : IsPeriodicPt fa n x) {g : α → β} (hg : Semiconj g fa fb) :
    IsPeriodicPt fb n (g x)
proof:
:=
  IsFixedPt.map hx (hg.iterate_right n)

name: apply_iterate
statement: theorem apply_iterate (hx : IsPeriodicPt f n x) (m : ℕ) : IsPeriodicPt f n (f^[m] x)
proof:
:=
  hx.map <| Commute.iterate_self f m

name: apply
statement: protected theorem apply (hx : IsPeriodicPt f n x) : IsPeriodicPt f n (f x)
proof:
:=
  hx.apply_iterate 1

name: add
statement:
protected theorem add (hn : IsPeriodicPt f n x) (hm : IsPeriodicPt f m x) :
    IsPeriodicPt f (n + m) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsPeriodicPt, iterate_add]
  exact hn.comp hm

name: left_of_add
statement:
theorem left_of_add (hn : IsPeriodicPt f (n + m) x) (hm : IsPeriodicPt f m x) :
    IsPeriodicPt f n x
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsPeriodicPt, iterate_add] at hn
  exact hn.left_of_comp hm

name: right_of_add
statement:
theorem right_of_add (hn : IsPeriodicPt f (n + m) x) (hm : IsPeriodicPt f n x) :
    IsPeriodicPt f m x
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm] at hn
  exact hn.left_of_add hm

name: sub
statement:
protected theorem sub (hm : IsPeriodicPt f m x) (hn : IsPeriodicPt f n x) :
    IsPeriodicPt f (m - n) x
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total n m with h | h
  · refine left_of_add ?_ hn
    rwa [tsub_add_cancel_of_le h]
  · rw [tsub_eq_zero_iff_le.mpr h]
    apply isPeriodicPt_zero

name: mul_const
statement: protected theorem mul_const (hm : IsPeriodicPt f m x) (n : ℕ) : IsPeriodicPt f (m * n) x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IsPeriodicPt, iterate_mul, hm.isFixedPt.iterate n]

name: const_mul
statement: protected theorem const_mul (hm : IsPeriodicPt f m x) (n : ℕ) : IsPeriodicPt f (n * m) x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mul_comm n, hm.mul_const n]

name: trans_dvd
statement: theorem trans_dvd (hm : IsPeriodicPt f m x) {n : ℕ} (hn : m ∣ n) : IsPeriodicPt f n x
proof:
:=
  let ⟨k, hk⟩ := hn
  hk.symm ▸ hm.mul_const k

name: iterate
statement: protected theorem iterate (hf : IsPeriodicPt f n x) (m : ℕ) : IsPeriodicPt f^[m] n x
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsPeriodicPt, ← iterate_mul, mul_comm, iterate_mul]
  exact hf.isFixedPt.iterate m

name: comp
statement:
theorem comp {g : α → α} (hco : Commute f g) (hf : IsPeriodicPt f n x) (hg : IsPeriodicPt g n x) :
    IsPeriodicPt (f ∘ g) n x
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsPeriodicPt, hco.comp_iterate]
  exact IsFixedPt.comp hf hg

name: comp_lcm
statement:
theorem comp_lcm {g : α → α} (hco : Commute f g) (hf : IsPeriodicPt f m x)
    (hg : IsPeriodicPt g n x) : IsPeriodicPt (f ∘ g) (Nat.lcm m n) x
proof:
:=
  (hf.trans_dvd <| Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _).comp hco (hg.trans_dvd <| Nat.dvd_lcm_right _ _)

name: left_of_comp
statement:
theorem left_of_comp {g : α → α} (hco : Commute f g) (hfg : IsPeriodicPt (f ∘ g) n x)
    (hg : IsPeriodicPt g n x) : IsPeriodicPt f n x
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsPeriodicPt, hco.comp_iterate] at hfg
  exact hfg.left_of_comp hg

name: iterate_mod_apply
statement: theorem iterate_mod_apply (h : IsPeriodicPt f n x) (m : ℕ) : f^[m % n] x = f^[m] x
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← Nat.mod_add_div m n, iterate_add_apply, (h.mul_const _).eq]

name: mod
statement:
protected theorem mod (hm : IsPeriodicPt f m x) (hn : IsPeriodicPt f n x) :
    IsPeriodicPt f (m % n) x
proof:
:=
  (hn.iterate_mod_apply m).trans hm

name: gcd
statement:
protected theorem gcd (hm : IsPeriodicPt f m x) (hn : IsPeriodicPt f n x) :
    IsPeriodicPt f (m.gcd n) x
proof:
:= by
  revert hm hn
  refine Nat.gcd.induction m n (fun n _ hn => ?_) fun m n _ ih hm hn => ?_
  · rwa [Nat.gcd_zero_left]
  · rw [Nat.gcd_rec]
    exact ih (hn.mod hm) hm

name: eq_of_apply_eq_same
statement:
theorem eq_of_apply_eq_same (hx : IsPeriodicPt f n x) (hy : IsPeriodicPt f n y) (hn : 0 < n)
    (h : f x = f y) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hx.eq, ← hy.eq, ← iterate_pred_comp_of_pos f hn, comp_apply, comp_apply, h]

name: eq_of_apply_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_apply_eq (hx : IsPeriodicPt f m x) (hy : IsPeriodicPt f n y) (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n)
    (h : f x = f y) : x = y
proof:
:=
  (hx.mul_const n).eq_of_apply_eq_same (hy.const_mul m) (Nat.mul_pos hm hn) h

name: mem_ptsOfPeriod
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_ptsOfPeriod : x ∈ ptsOfPeriod f n ↔ IsPeriodicPt f n x
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Semiconj.mapsTo_ptsOfPeriod
statement:
theorem Semiconj.mapsTo_ptsOfPeriod {g : α → β} (h : Semiconj g fa fb) (n : ℕ) :
    MapsTo g (ptsOfPeriod fa n) (ptsOfPeriod fb n)
proof:
:=
  (h.iterate_right n).mapsTo_fixedPoints

name: bijOn_ptsOfPeriod
statement:
theorem bijOn_ptsOfPeriod (f : α → α) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    BijOn f (ptsOfPeriod f n) (ptsOfPeriod f n)
proof:
:=
  ⟨(Commute.refl f).mapsTo_ptsOfPeriod n, fun _ hx _ hy hxy => hx.eq_of_apply_eq_same hy hn hxy,
    fun x hx =>
    ⟨f^[n.pred] x, hx.apply_iterate _, by
      rw [← comp_apply (f := f), comp_iterate_pred_of_pos f hn, hx.eq]⟩⟩

name: mk_mem_periodicPts
statement: theorem mk_mem_periodicPts (hn : 0 < n) (hx : IsPeriodicPt f n x) : x ∈ periodicPts f
proof:
:=
  ⟨n, hn, hx⟩

name: mem_periodicPts
statement: theorem mem_periodicPts : x ∈ periodicPts f ↔ ∃ n > 0, IsPeriodicPt f n x
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: periodicPts_subset_range
statement: theorem periodicPts_subset_range : periodicPts f ⊆ range f
proof:
:= by
  intro x h
  rw [mem_periodicPts] at h
  rcases h with ⟨n, _, h⟩
  use f^[n - 1] x
  nth_rw 1 [← iterate_one f]
  rw [← iterate_add_apply, Nat.add_sub_cancel' (by lia)]
  exact h

name: isPeriodicPt_of_mem_periodicPts_of_isPeriodicPt_iterate
statement:
theorem isPeriodicPt_of_mem_periodicPts_of_isPeriodicPt_iterate (hx : x ∈ periodicPts f)
    (hm : IsPeriodicPt f m (f^[n] x)) : IsPeriodicPt f m x
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx with ⟨r, hr, hr'⟩
  suffices n ≤ (n / r + 1) * r by
    unfold IsPeriodicPt IsFixedPt
    convert! (hm.apply_iterate ((n / r + 1) * r - n)).eq <;>
      rw [← iterate_add_apply, Nat.sub_add_cancel this, iterate_mul, (hr'.iterate _).eq]
  rw [Nat.add_mul, one_mul]
  exact (Nat.lt_div_mul_add hr).le

name: bUnion_ptsOfPeriod
statement: theorem bUnion_ptsOfPeriod : ⋃ n > 0, ptsOfPeriod f n = periodicPts f
proof:
:=
  Set.ext fun x => by simp [mem_periodicPts]

name: iUnion_pnat_ptsOfPeriod
statement: theorem iUnion_pnat_ptsOfPeriod : ⋃ n : ℕ+, ptsOfPeriod f n = periodicPts f
proof:
:=
  iSup_subtype.trans <| bUnion_ptsOfPeriod f

name: Semiconj.mapsTo_periodicPts
statement:
theorem Semiconj.mapsTo_periodicPts {g : α → β} (h : Semiconj g fa fb) :
    MapsTo g (periodicPts fa) (periodicPts fb)
proof: := fun _ ⟨n, hn, hx⟩ => ⟨n, hn, hx.map h⟩

name: isPeriodicPt_minimalPeriod
statement: theorem isPeriodicPt_minimalPeriod (f : α → α) (x : α) : IsPeriodicPt f (minimalPeriod f x) x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  delta minimalPeriod
  split_ifs with hx
  · exact (Nat.find_spec hx).2
  · exact isPeriodicPt_zero f x

name: iterate_minimalPeriod
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iterate_minimalPeriod : f^[minimalPeriod f x] x = x
proof:
:=
  isPeriodicPt_minimalPeriod f x

name: iterate_add_minimalPeriod_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iterate_add_minimalPeriod_eq : f^[n + minimalPeriod f x] x = f^[n] x
proof:
:= by
  rw [iterate_add_apply]
  congr
  exact isPeriodicPt_minimalPeriod f x

name: iterate_mod_minimalPeriod_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iterate_mod_minimalPeriod_eq : f^[n % minimalPeriod f x] x = f^[n] x
proof:
:=
  (isPeriodicPt_minimalPeriod f x).iterate_mod_apply n

name: minimalPeriod_pos_of_mem_periodicPts
statement: theorem minimalPeriod_pos_of_mem_periodicPts (hx : x ∈ periodicPts f) : 0 < minimalPeriod f x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [minimalPeriod, dite_eq_left hx, (Nat.find_spec hx).1.lt]

name: minimalPeriod_eq_zero_of_notMem_periodicPts
statement:
theorem minimalPeriod_eq_zero_of_notMem_periodicPts (hx : x ∉ periodicPts f) :
    minimalPeriod f x = 0
proof: := by simp only [minimalPeriod, dite_eq_right hx]

name: IsPeriodicPt.minimalPeriod_pos
statement:
theorem IsPeriodicPt.minimalPeriod_pos (hn : 0 < n) (hx : IsPeriodicPt f n x) :
    0 < minimalPeriod f x
proof:
:=
  minimalPeriod_pos_of_mem_periodicPts <| mk_mem_periodicPts hn hx

name: minimalPeriod_pos_iff_mem_periodicPts
statement: theorem minimalPeriod_pos_iff_mem_periodicPts : 0 < minimalPeriod f x ↔ x ∈ periodicPts f
proof:
:=
  ⟨not_imp_not.1 fun h => by simp only [minimalPeriod, dite_eq_right h, lt_irrefl 0, not_false_iff],
    minimalPeriod_pos_of_mem_periodicPts⟩

name: minimalPeriod_eq_zero_iff_notMem_periodicPts
statement:
theorem minimalPeriod_eq_zero_iff_notMem_periodicPts :
    minimalPeriod f x = 0 ↔ x ∉ periodicPts f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← minimalPeriod_pos_iff_mem_periodicPts, not_lt, nonpos_iff_eq_zero]

name: IsPeriodicPt.minimalPeriod_le
statement:
theorem IsPeriodicPt.minimalPeriod_le (hn : 0 < n) (hx : IsPeriodicPt f n x) :
    minimalPeriod f x ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [minimalPeriod, dite_eq_left (mk_mem_periodicPts hn hx)]
  exact Nat.find_min' (mk_mem_periodicPts hn hx) ⟨hn, hx⟩

name: minimalPeriod_apply_iterate
statement:
theorem minimalPeriod_apply_iterate (hx : x ∈ periodicPts f) (n : ℕ) :
    minimalPeriod f (f^[n] x) = minimalPeriod f x
proof:
:= by
  apply
    (IsPeriodicPt.minimalPeriod_le (minimalPeriod_pos_of_mem_periodicPts hx) _).antisymm
      ((isPeriodicPt_of_mem_periodicPts_of_isPeriodicPt_iterate hx
            (isPeriodicPt_minimalPeriod f _)).minimalPeriod_le
        (minimalPeriod_pos_of_mem_periodicPts _))
  · exact (isPeriodicPt_minimalPeriod f x).apply_iterate n
  · rcases hx with ⟨m, hm, hx⟩
    exact ⟨m, hm, hx.apply_iterate n⟩

name: minimalPeriod_apply
statement: theorem minimalPeriod_apply (hx : x ∈ periodicPts f) : minimalPeriod f (f x) = minimalPeriod f x
proof:
:=
  minimalPeriod_apply_iterate hx 1

name: le_of_lt_minimalPeriod_of_iterate_eq
statement:
theorem le_of_lt_minimalPeriod_of_iterate_eq {m n : ℕ} (hm : m < minimalPeriod f x)
    (hmn : f^[m] x = f^[n] x) : m ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! hmn'
  rw [← Nat.add_sub_of_le hmn'.le, add_comm, iterate_add_apply] at hmn
  exact ((IsPeriodicPt.minimalPeriod_le (tsub_pos_of_lt hmn')
    (isPeriodicPt_of_mem_periodicPts_of_isPeriodicPt_iterate
      (minimalPeriod_pos_iff_mem_periodicPts.1 hm.pos) hmn)).trans (Nat.sub_le m n)).not_gt hm

name: iterate_injOn_Iio_minimalPeriod
statement: theorem iterate_injOn_Iio_minimalPeriod : (Iio <| minimalPeriod f x).InjOn (f^[·] x)
proof:
:=
  fun _m hm _n hn hmn ↦ (le_of_lt_minimalPeriod_of_iterate_eq hm hmn).antisymm
    (le_of_lt_minimalPeriod_of_iterate_eq hn hmn.symm)

name: iterate_eq_iterate_iff_of_lt_minimalPeriod
statement:
theorem iterate_eq_iterate_iff_of_lt_minimalPeriod {m n : ℕ} (hm : m < minimalPeriod f x)
    (hn : n < minimalPeriod f x) : f^[m] x = f^[n] x ↔ m = n
proof:
:=
  iterate_injOn_Iio_minimalPeriod.eq_iff hm hn

name: minimalPeriod_id
statement: @[simp] theorem minimalPeriod_id : minimalPeriod id x = 1
proof:
:=
  ((is_periodic_id _ _).minimalPeriod_le Nat.one_pos).antisymm
    (Nat.succ_le_of_lt ((is_periodic_id _ _).minimalPeriod_pos Nat.one_pos))

name: minimalPeriod_eq_one_iff_isFixedPt
statement:
@[simp]
theorem minimalPeriod_eq_one_iff_isFixedPt : minimalPeriod f x = 1 ↔ IsFixedPt f x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
  · rw [← iterate_one f]
    refine Function.IsPeriodicPt.isFixedPt ?_
    rw [← h]
    exact isPeriodicPt_minimalPeriod f x
  · exact
      ((h.isPeriodicPt 1).minimalPeriod_le Nat.one_pos).antisymm
        (Nat.succ_le_of_lt ((h.isPeriodicPt 1).minimalPeriod_pos Nat.one_pos))

name: minimalPeriod_eq_one_of_subsingleton
statement:
@[nontriviality]
theorem minimalPeriod_eq_one_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton α] : minimalPeriod f x = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [nontriviality]

name: IsPeriodicPt.eq_zero_of_lt_minimalPeriod
statement:
theorem IsPeriodicPt.eq_zero_of_lt_minimalPeriod (hx : IsPeriodicPt f n x)
    (hn : n < minimalPeriod f x) : n = 0
proof:
:=
  Eq.symm <|
    (eq_or_lt_of_le <| n.zero_le).resolve_right fun hn0 => not_lt.2 (hx.minimalPeriod_le hn0) hn

name: not_isPeriodicPt_of_pos_of_lt_minimalPeriod
statement:
theorem not_isPeriodicPt_of_pos_of_lt_minimalPeriod :
    ∀ {n : ℕ} (_ : n ≠ 0) (_ : n < minimalPeriod f x), ¬IsPeriodicPt f n x
  | 0, n0, _ => (n0 rfl).elim
  | _ + 1, _, hn => fun hp => Nat.succ_ne_zero _ (hp.eq_zero_of_lt_minimalPeriod hn)

name: IsPeriodicPt.minimalPeriod_dvd
statement: theorem IsPeriodicPt.minimalPeriod_dvd (hx : IsPeriodicPt f n x) : minimalPeriod f x ∣ n
proof:
:=
  (eq_or_lt_of_le <| n.zero_le).elim (fun hn0 => hn0 ▸ Nat.dvd_zero _) fun hn0 =>
    Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero.2 <|
      (hx.mod <| isPeriodicPt_minimalPeriod f x).eq_zero_of_lt_minimalPeriod <|
        Nat.mod_lt _ <| hx.minimalPeriod_pos hn0

name: isPeriodicPt_iff_minimalPeriod_dvd
statement: theorem isPeriodicPt_iff_minimalPeriod_dvd : IsPeriodicPt f n x ↔ minimalPeriod f x ∣ n
proof:
:=
  ⟨IsPeriodicPt.minimalPeriod_dvd, fun h => (isPeriodicPt_minimalPeriod f x).trans_dvd h⟩

name: minimalPeriod_eq_minimalPeriod_iff
statement:
theorem minimalPeriod_eq_minimalPeriod_iff {g : β → β} {y : β} :
    minimalPeriod f x = minimalPeriod g y ↔ ∀ n, IsPeriodicPt f n x ↔ IsPeriodicPt g n y
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [isPeriodicPt_iff_minimalPeriod_dvd, dvd_right_iff_eq]

name: Commute.minimalPeriod_of_comp_dvd_lcm
statement:
theorem Commute.minimalPeriod_of_comp_dvd_lcm {g : α → α} (h : Commute f g) :
    minimalPeriod (f ∘ g) x ∣ Nat.lcm (minimalPeriod f x) (minimalPeriod g x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isPeriodicPt_iff_minimalPeriod_dvd]
  exact (isPeriodicPt_minimalPeriod f x).comp_lcm h (isPeriodicPt_minimalPeriod g x)

name: minimalPeriod_iterate_eq_div_gcd_aux
statement:
private theorem minimalPeriod_iterate_eq_div_gcd_aux (h : 0 < gcd (minimalPeriod f x) n) :
    minimalPeriod f^[n] x = minimalPeriod f x / Nat.gcd (minimalPeriod f x) n
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.dvd_antisymm
  · apply IsPeriodicPt.minimalPeriod_dvd
    rw [IsPeriodicPt, IsFixedPt, ← iterate_mul, ← Nat.mul_div_assoc _ (gcd_dvd_left _ _),
      mul_comm, Nat.mul_div_assoc _ (gcd_dvd_right _ _), mul_comm, iterate_mul]
    exact (isPeriodicPt_minimalPeriod f x).iterate _
  · apply Coprime.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right (coprime_div_gcd_div_gcd h)
    apply Nat.dvd_of_mul_dvd_mul_right h
    rw [Nat.div_mul_cancel (gcd_dvd_left _ _), mul_assoc, Nat.div_mul_cancel (gcd_dvd_right _ _),
      mul_comm]
    apply IsPeriodicPt.minimalPeriod_dvd
    rw [IsPeriodicPt, IsFixedPt, iterate_mul]
    exact isPeriodicPt_minimalPeriod _ _

name: minimalPeriod_iterate_eq_div_gcd
statement:
theorem minimalPeriod_iterate_eq_div_gcd (h : n ≠ 0) :
    minimalPeriod f^[n] x = minimalPeriod f x / Nat.gcd (minimalPeriod f x) n
proof:
:=
  minimalPeriod_iterate_eq_div_gcd_aux <| gcd_pos_of_pos_right _ (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h)

name: minimalPeriod_iterate_eq_div_gcd'
statement:
theorem minimalPeriod_iterate_eq_div_gcd' (h : x ∈ periodicPts f) :
    minimalPeriod f^[n] x = minimalPeriod f x / Nat.gcd (minimalPeriod f x) n
proof:
:=
  minimalPeriod_iterate_eq_div_gcd_aux <|
    gcd_pos_of_pos_left n (minimalPeriod_pos_iff_mem_periodicPts.mpr h)

name: periodicOrbit_def
statement:
theorem periodicOrbit_def (f : α → α) (x : α) :
    periodicOrbit f x = (List.range (minimalPeriod f x)).map fun n => f^[n] x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: periodicOrbit_eq_cycle_map
statement:
theorem periodicOrbit_eq_cycle_map (f : α → α) (x : α) :
    periodicOrbit f x = (List.range (minimalPeriod f x) : Cycle ℕ).map fun n => f^[n] x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: periodicOrbit_length
statement:
@[simp]
theorem periodicOrbit_length : (periodicOrbit f x).length = minimalPeriod f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [periodicOrbit, Cycle.length_coe, List.length_map, List.length_range]

name: periodicOrbit_eq_nil_iff_not_periodic_pt
statement:
@[simp]
theorem periodicOrbit_eq_nil_iff_not_periodic_pt :
    periodicOrbit f x = Cycle.nil ↔ x ∉ periodicPts f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [periodicOrbit.eq_1, Cycle.coe_eq_nil, List.map_eq_nil_iff, List.range_eq_nil]
  exact minimalPeriod_eq_zero_iff_notMem_periodicPts

name: periodicOrbit_eq_nil_of_not_periodic_pt
statement:
theorem periodicOrbit_eq_nil_of_not_periodic_pt (h : x ∉ periodicPts f) :
    periodicOrbit f x = Cycle.nil
proof:
:=
  periodicOrbit_eq_nil_iff_not_periodic_pt.2 h

name: mem_periodicOrbit_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_periodicOrbit_iff (hx : x ∈ periodicPts f) :
    y ∈ periodicOrbit f x ↔ ∃ n, f^[n] x = y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [periodicOrbit, Cycle.mem_coe_iff, List.mem_map, List.mem_range]
  use fun ⟨a, _, ha'⟩ => ⟨a, ha'⟩
  rintro ⟨n, rfl⟩
  use n % minimalPeriod f x, mod_lt _ (minimalPeriod_pos_of_mem_periodicPts hx)
  rw [iterate_mod_minimalPeriod_eq]

name: iterate_mem_periodicOrbit
statement:
theorem iterate_mem_periodicOrbit (hx : x ∈ periodicPts f) (n : ℕ) :
    f^[n] x ∈ periodicOrbit f x
proof:
:= by
  simp [hx]

name: exists_iterate_apply_eq_of_mem_periodicPts
statement:
@[simp]
theorem exists_iterate_apply_eq_of_mem_periodicPts (hx : x ∈ periodicPts f) : ∃ n, f^[n] x = x
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [← mem_periodicOrbit_iff hx] using! iterate_mem_periodicOrbit hx 0

name: self_mem_periodicOrbit
statement: theorem self_mem_periodicOrbit (hx : x ∈ periodicPts f) : x ∈ periodicOrbit f x
proof:
:= by
  simp [hx]

name: nodup_periodicOrbit
statement: theorem nodup_periodicOrbit : (periodicOrbit f x).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  rw [periodicOrbit, Cycle.nodup_coe_iff, List.nodup_map_iff_inj_on List.nodup_range]
  intro m hm n hn hmn
  rw [List.mem_range] at hm hn
  rwa [iterate_eq_iterate_iff_of_lt_minimalPeriod hm hn] at hmn

name: periodicOrbit_apply_iterate_eq
statement:
theorem periodicOrbit_apply_iterate_eq (hx : x ∈ periodicPts f) (n : ℕ) :
    periodicOrbit f (f^[n] x) = periodicOrbit f x
proof:
:=
  Eq.symm <| Cycle.coe_eq_coe.2 <| .intro n <|
    List.ext_get (by simp [minimalPeriod_apply_iterate hx]) fun m _ _ ↦ by
      simp [List.getElem_rotate, iterate_add_apply]

name: periodicOrbit_apply_eq
statement:
theorem periodicOrbit_apply_eq (hx : x ∈ periodicPts f) :
    periodicOrbit f (f x) = periodicOrbit f x
proof:
:=
  periodicOrbit_apply_iterate_eq hx 1

name: periodicOrbit_chain
statement:
theorem periodicOrbit_chain (r : α → α → Prop) {f : α → α} {x : α} :
    (periodicOrbit f x).Chain r ↔ ∀ n < minimalPeriod f x, r (f^[n] x) (f^[n + 1] x)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x ∈ periodicPts f
  · have hx' := minimalPeriod_pos_of_mem_periodicPts hx
    have hM := Nat.sub_add_cancel (succ_le_iff.2 hx')
    rw [periodicOrbit, ← Cycle.map_coe, Cycle.chain_map, ← hM, Cycle.chain_range_succ]
    refine ⟨?_, fun H => ⟨?_, fun m hm => H _ (hm.trans (Nat.lt_succ_self _))⟩⟩
    · rintro ⟨hr, H⟩ n hn
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 hn) with hM' | hM'
      · rwa [hM', hM, iterate_minimalPeriod]
      · exact H _ hM'
    · rw [iterate_zero_apply]
      nth_rw 3 [← @iterate_minimalPeriod α f x]
      nth_rw 2 [← hM]
      exact H _ (Nat.lt_succ_self _)
  · rw [periodicOrbit_eq_nil_of_not_periodic_pt hx, minimalPeriod_eq_zero_of_notMem_periodicPts hx]
    simp

name: periodicOrbit_chain'
statement:
theorem periodicOrbit_chain' (r : α → α → Prop) {f : α → α} {x : α} (hx : x ∈ periodicPts f) :
    (periodicOrbit f x).Chain r ↔ ∀ n, r (f^[n] x) (f^[n + 1] x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [periodicOrbit_chain r]
  refine ⟨fun H n => ?_, fun H n _ => H n⟩
  rw [iterate_succ_apply, ← iterate_mod_minimalPeriod_eq, ← iterate_mod_minimalPeriod_eq (n := n),
    ← iterate_succ_apply, minimalPeriod_apply hx]
  exact H _ (mod_lt _ (minimalPeriod_pos_of_mem_periodicPts hx))

name: period_eq_minimalPeriod
statement:
@[to_additive /
`Function.minimalPeriod (m +ᵥ ·) a` -/]
theorem period_eq_minimalPeriod {m : M} {a : α} :
    MulAction.period m a = minimalPeriod (fun x => m • x) a
proof: := rfl

name: pow_period_smul
statement: theorem pow_period_smul (m : M) (a : α) : m ^ (period m a) • a = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [period_eq_minimalPeriod, ← smul_iterate_apply, iterate_minimalPeriod]

name: isPeriodicPt_smul_iff
statement:

lemma isPeriodicPt_smul_iff {m : M} {a : α} {n : ℕ} :
    IsPeriodicPt (m • ·) n a ↔ m ^ n • a = a
proof:

name: pow_smul_eq_iff_period_dvd
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem pow_smul_eq_iff_period_dvd {n : ℕ} {m : M} {a : α} :
    m ^ n • a = a ↔ period m a ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [period_eq_minimalPeriod, ← isPeriodicPt_iff_minimalPeriod_dvd, isPeriodicPt_smul_iff]

name: zpow_smul_eq_iff_period_dvd
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem zpow_smul_eq_iff_period_dvd {j : ℤ} {g : G} {a : α} :
    g ^ j • a = a ↔ (period g a : ℤ) ∣ j
proof:
:= by
  match j with
  | (n : ℕ) => rw [zpow_natCast, Int.natCast_dvd_natCast, pow_smul_eq_iff_period_dvd]
  | -(n + 1 : ℕ) =>
    rw [zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, inv_smul_eq_iff, eq_comm, Int.dvd_neg, Int.natCast_dvd_natCast,
      pow_smul_eq_iff_period_dvd]

name: pow_mod_period_smul
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem pow_mod_period_smul (n : ℕ) {m : M} {a : α} :
    m ^ (n % period m a) • a = m ^ n • a
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← Nat.mod_add_div n (period m a), pow_add, mul_smul,
    pow_smul_eq_iff_period_dvd.mpr (dvd_mul_right _ _)]

name: zpow_mod_period_smul
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem zpow_mod_period_smul (j : ℤ) {g : G} {a : α} :
    g ^ (j % (period g a : ℤ)) • a = g ^ j • a
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← Int.emod_add_mul_ediv j (period g a), zpow_add, mul_smul,
    zpow_smul_eq_iff_period_dvd.mpr (dvd_mul_right _ _)]

name: pow_add_period_smul
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem pow_add_period_smul (n : ℕ) (m : M) (a : α) :
    m ^ (n + period m a) • a = m ^ n • a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pow_mod_period_smul, Nat.add_mod_right, pow_mod_period_smul]

name: pow_period_add_smul
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem pow_period_add_smul (n : ℕ) (m : M) (a : α) :

statement:

proof:
:= by
  rw [← zpow_mod_period_smul, Int.add_emod_right, zpow_mod_period_smul]

name: zpow_period_add_smul
statement:

name: pow_smul_eq_iff_minimalPeriod_dvd
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem pow_smul_eq_iff_minimalPeriod_dvd {n : ℕ} :
    a ^ n • b = b ↔ minimalPeriod (a • ·) b ∣ n
proof:

name: zpow_smul_eq_iff_minimalPeriod_dvd
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem zpow_smul_eq_iff_minimalPeriod_dvd {n : ℤ} :

name: aeconst_of_forall_preimage_smul_ae_eq
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem aeconst_of_forall_preimage_smul_ae_eq [SMul G α] [ErgodicSMul G α μ] {s : Set α}
    (hm : NullMeasurableSet s μ) (h : ∀ g : G, (g • ·) ⁻¹' s =ᵐ[μ] s) :
    EventuallyEmptyOrUniv s (ae μ)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hm with ⟨t, htm, hst⟩
  refine .congr ?_ hst.symm
  refine ErgodicSMul.aeconst_of_forall_preimage_smul_ae_eq htm fun g : G ↦ ?_
  refine .trans (.trans ?_ (h g)) hst
  exact tendsto_smul_ae _ _ hst.symm

name: aeconst_of_forall_smul_ae_eq
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem aeconst_of_forall_smul_ae_eq (hm : NullMeasurableSet s μ) (h : ∀ g : G, g • s =ᵐ[μ] s) :
    EventuallyEmptyOrUniv s (ae μ)
proof:
:=
  aeconst_of_forall_preimage_smul_ae_eq G hm fun g ↦ by
    simpa only [preimage_smul] using h g⁻¹

name: _root_.MulAction.aeconst_of_aestabilizer_eq_top
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem _root_.MulAction.aeconst_of_aestabilizer_eq_top
    (hm : NullMeasurableSet s μ) (h : aestabilizer G μ s = ⊤) : EventuallyEmptyOrUniv s (ae μ)
proof:
:=
  aeconst_of_forall_smul_ae_eq G hm <| (Subgroup.eq_top_iff' _).1 h

name: _root_.ErgodicSMul.of_aestabilizer
statement:
theorem _root_.ErgodicSMul.of_aestabilizer [Group G] [MulAction G α] [SMulInvariantMeasure G α μ]
    (h : ∀ s, MeasurableSet s → aestabilizer G μ s = ⊤ → EventuallyEmptyOrUniv s (ae μ)) :
    ErgodicSMul G α μ
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hm hs ↦ h _ hm <| (Subgroup.eq_top_iff' _).2 fun g ↦ by
    simpa only [preimage_smul_inv] using! hs g⁻¹⟩

name: ergodicSMul_iterateMulAct
statement:
theorem ergodicSMul_iterateMulAct {f : α → α} (hf : Measurable f) :
    ErgodicSMul (IterateMulAct f) α μ ↔ Ergodic f μ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ergodicSMul_iff, smulInvariantMeasure_iterateMulAct, hf]
  refine ⟨fun ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ ↦ ⟨h₁, ⟨?_⟩⟩, fun h ↦ ⟨h.1, ?_⟩⟩
  · intro s hm hs
    refine h₂ hm fun n ↦ ?_
    nth_rewrite 2 [← Function.IsFixedPt.preimage_iterate hs n.val]
    rfl
  · intro s hm hs
    exact h.quasiErgodic.aeconst_set₀ hm.nullMeasurableSet <| hs (.mk 1)

name: aeconst_of_dense_setOfPred_preimage_smul_ae
statement:
@[to_additive /
Let `μ` be a finite inner regular measure on `X` which is ergodic with respect to this action.
If a null measurable set `s` is a.e. equal
to its preimages under the action of a dense set of elements of `M`,
then it is either null or conull. -/]
theorem aeconst_of_dense_setOfPred_preimage_smul_ae (hsm : NullMeasurableSet s μ)
    (hd : Dense {g : M | (g • ·) ⁻¹' s =ᵐ[μ] s}) : EventuallyEmptyOrUniv s (ae μ)
proof:
:= by
  borelize M
  refine aeconst_of_forall_preimage_smul_ae_eq M hsm ?_
  rwa [dense_iff_closure_eq, IsClosed.closure_eq, eq_univ_iff_forall] at hd
  let f : C(M × X, X) := ⟨(· • ·).uncurry, continuous_smul⟩
  exact isClosed_setOfPred_preimage_ae_eq f.curry.continuous (measurePreserving_smul · μ) _ hsm
    (measure_ne_top _ _)

name: aeconst_of_dense_setOfPred_preimage_smul_eq
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem aeconst_of_dense_setOfPred_preimage_smul_eq (hsm : NullMeasurableSet s μ)
    (hd : Dense {g : M | (g • ·) ⁻¹' s = s}) : EventuallyEmptyOrUniv s (ae μ)
proof:
:=
  aeconst_of_dense_setOfPred_preimage_smul_ae hsm <| hd.mono fun _ h ↦ mem_ofPred.2 <| .of_eq h

name: ergodic_smul_of_denseRange_pow
statement:
@[to_additive /
`g` is an element of `M` such that its natural multiples are dense in `M`,
and `μ` is a finite inner regular measure on `X` which is ergodic with respect to the action of `M`,
then the vector addition of `g` is an ergodic map. -/]
theorem ergodic_smul_of_denseRange_pow {M : Type*} [Monoid M] [TopologicalSpace M]
    [MulAction M X] [ContinuousSMul M X] {g : M} (hg : DenseRange (g ^ · : ℕ → M))
    (μ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [μ.InnerRegular] [ErgodicSMul M X μ] :
    Ergodic (g • ·) μ
proof:
:= by
  borelize M
  refine ⟨measurePreserving_smul _ _, ⟨fun s hsm hs ↦ ?_⟩⟩
  refine aeconst_of_dense_setOfPred_preimage_smul_eq hsm.nullMeasurableSet (hg.mono ?_)
  refine range_subset_iff.2 fun n ↦ ?_
  rw [mem_ofPred, ← smul_iterate, preimage_iterate_eq, iterate_fixed hs]

name: ErgodicSMul.trans_isMinimal
statement:
@[to_additive
  /
then the corresponding action of `M` on `X` is ergodic. -/]
theorem ErgodicSMul.trans_isMinimal (N : Type*) [MulAction M N]
    [Monoid N] [TopologicalSpace N] [MulAction.IsMinimal M N]
    [MulAction N X] [IsScalarTower M N X] [ContinuousSMul N X] [ErgodicSMul N X μ] :
    ErgodicSMul M X μ where
  measure_preimage_smul c s hsm
proof:
:= by
    simpa only [smul_one_smul] using SMulInvariantMeasure.measure_preimage_smul (c • 1 : N) hsm
  aeconst_of_forall_preimage_smul_ae_eq {s} hsm hs := by
    refine aeconst_of_dense_setOfPred_preimage_smul_ae (M := N) hsm.nullMeasurableSet ?_
    refine (MulAction.dense_orbit M 1).mono ?_
    rintro _ ⟨g, rfl⟩
    simpa using hs g

name: aeconst_of_dense_aestabilizer_smul
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem aeconst_of_dense_aestabilizer_smul (hsm : NullMeasurableSet s μ)
    (hd : Dense (MulAction.aestabilizer G μ s : Set G)) : EventuallyEmptyOrUniv s (ae μ)
proof:
:=
  aeconst_of_dense_setOfPred_preimage_smul_ae hsm <|
    (hd.preimage (isOpenMap_inv _)).mono fun g hg ↦ by
    simpa only [preimage_smul] using! hg

name: ergodic_smul_of_denseRange_zpow
statement:
@[to_additive /
`g` is an element of `M` such that its integer multiples are dense in `M`,
and `μ` is a finite inner regular measure on `X` which is ergodic with respect to the action of `M`,
then the vector addition of `g` is an ergodic map. -/]
theorem ergodic_smul_of_denseRange_zpow {g : G} (hg : DenseRange (g ^ · : ℤ → G))
    (μ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [μ.InnerRegular] [ErgodicSMul G X μ] :
    Ergodic (g • ·) μ
proof:
:= by
  borelize G
  refine ⟨measurePreserving_smul _ _, ⟨fun s hsm hs ↦ ?_⟩⟩
  refine aeconst_of_dense_aestabilizer_smul hsm.nullMeasurableSet (hg.mono ?_)
  rw [← Subgroup.coe_zpowers, SetLike.coe_subset_coe, ← Subgroup.zpowers_inv, Subgroup.zpowers_le,
    MulAction.mem_aestabilizer, ← preimage_smul]
  exact hs.eventuallyEq

name: DenseRange.zpow_of_ergodic_mul_left
statement:
@[to_additive /
with respect to a measure which is positive on nonempty open sets,
then the integer multiples of `g` are dense in `G`. -/]
theorem DenseRange.zpow_of_ergodic_mul_left [OpensMeasurableSpace G]
    {μ : Measure G} [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure] {g : G} (hg : Ergodic (g * ·) μ) :
    DenseRange (g ^ · : ℤ → G)
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  by_contra h
  obtain ⟨V, hV₁, hVo, hV⟩ :
      ∃ V : Set G, 1 ∈ V ∧ IsOpen V ∧ ∀ x ∈ V, ∀ y ∈ V, ∀ m : ℤ, g ^ m ≠ a * x / y := by
    rw [← mem_compl_iff, ← interior_compl, mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds] at h
    have : Tendsto (fun (x, y) ↦ a * x / y) (𝓝 1) (𝓝 a) :=
      Continuous.tendsto' (by fun_prop) _ _ (by simp)
    rw [nhds_prod_eq] at this
    simpa [(nhds_basis_opens (1 : G)).prod_self.mem_iff, prod_subset_iff, and_assoc] using this h
  set s := ⋃ m : ℤ, g ^ m • V
  have hso : IsOpen s := isOpen_iUnion fun m ↦ hVo.smul _
  have hsne : s.Nonempty := ⟨1, mem_iUnion.2 ⟨0, by simpa⟩⟩
  have hd : Disjoint s (a • V) := by
    simp_rw [s, disjoint_iUnion_left, disjoint_left]
    rintro m _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
    apply hV y hy x hx m
    simp_all
  have hgs : (g * ·) ⁻¹' s = s := by
    simp only [s, preimage_iUnion, ← smul_eq_mul, preimage_smul]
    refine iUnion_congr_of_surjective _ (add_left_surjective (-1)) fun m ↦ ?_
    simp [zpow_add, mul_smul]
  cases hg.measure_self_or_compl_eq_zero hso.measurableSet hgs with
  | inl h => exact hso.measure_ne_zero _ hsne h
  | inr h =>
    refine (hVo.smul a).measure_ne_zero μ (.image _ ⟨1, hV₁⟩) (measure_mono_null ?_ h)
    rwa [disjoint_right] at hd

name: ergodic_mul_left_of_denseRange_pow
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem ergodic_mul_left_of_denseRange_pow (hg : DenseRange (g ^ · : ℕ → G))
    (μ : Measure G) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [μ.InnerRegular] [μ.IsMulLeftInvariant] :
    Ergodic (g * ·) μ
proof:
:=
  ergodic_smul_of_denseRange_pow hg μ

name: ergodic_mul_left_of_denseRange_zpow
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem ergodic_mul_left_of_denseRange_zpow (hg : DenseRange (g ^ · : ℤ → G))
    (μ : Measure G) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [μ.InnerRegular] [μ.IsMulLeftInvariant] :
    Ergodic (g * ·) μ
proof:
:=
  ergodic_smul_of_denseRange_zpow hg μ

name: ergodic_mul_left_iff_denseRange_zpow
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem ergodic_mul_left_iff_denseRange_zpow (μ : Measure G) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    [μ.InnerRegular] [μ.IsMulLeftInvariant] [NeZero μ] :
    Ergodic (g * ·) μ ↔ DenseRange (g ^ · : ℤ → G)
proof:
:=
  ⟨.zpow_of_ergodic_mul_left, (ergodic_mul_left_of_denseRange_zpow · μ)⟩

name: preErgodic_of_dense_iUnion_preimage_one
statement:
@[to_additive /
of a topological additive group with second countable topology.
If the preimages of `0` under the iterations of `f` are dense,
then it is pre-ergodic with respect to any finite inner regular left invariant measure. -/]
theorem preErgodic_of_dense_iUnion_preimage_one
    {μ : Measure G} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [μ.InnerRegular] [μ.IsMulLeftInvariant]
    (f : G →* G) (hf : Dense (⋃ n, f^[n] ⁻¹' 1)) : PreErgodic f μ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun s hsm hs ↦
    aeconst_of_dense_setOfPred_preimage_smul_eq (M := G) hsm.nullMeasurableSet ?_⟩
  refine hf.mono <| iUnion_subset fun n x hx ↦ ?_
  have hsn : f^[n] ⁻¹' s = s := by
    rw [preimage_iterate_eq, iterate_fixed hs]
  rw [mem_preimage, Set.mem_one] at hx
  rw [mem_ofPred, ← hsn]
  ext y
